textes.Descendre jusqu'au 4e étage du Donjon de: Go down to the 4th floor of the Dungeon of a Thousand Steps
textes.Descendre les cinq étages du Donjon des: Go down the five floors of the Dungeon of a Thousand Steps (the entrance is under the ruined tower, at the foot of the Fangs, in the south-west of the island; Odon keeps the gate) and defeat the Jelly King in the Jelly Throne Room
textes.Descendre sous le Cœur-de-Pierre, dans l: Go down beneath Stoneheart, into the Rose of Seals
textes.Descendre sous le Grand Temple, rallumer: Go down beneath the Great Temple, rekindle the Sun Stone, set the Fifth Sun in motion, defeat Cipactli
Two skewers, and one for the road.
textes.Deux cœurs rendus ; le sort soigne aussi: Two hearts restored; the spell also heals wounded creatures.
textes.Deux fragments sur trois ! Le troisième: Two fragments out of three! The third eye on my map is under the jungle, near the stone head. I drew four serpents in a circle… and an arrow going round. Or a snail.
textes.Deux gros os, rongés et luisants. Les ja: Two big bones, gnawed and shiny. The jaguars of the hills fight over them; throw them to a jaguar, and it will forget to bite you.
textes.Deux mâts, des voiles neuves, une roue d: Two masts, new sails, a gleaming steering wheel: the Schooner is in the water! I think I'm going to cry. (I'm crying.) She's waiting for you at the jetty.
textes.Deux nains se tiennent devant un grand m: Two dwarves stand before a big bronze mirror. They comb their beards while glaring at each other.
textes.Deux offrandes. À Tlaloc, une jarre d'ea: Two offerings. To Tlaloc, a jar of rainwater: Coyotl, the potter, makes them. To Huitzilopochtli, burning copal: Tochtli sells it at the market. Then the round slab will open between the two shrines, and you will go down to the Five Suns. In the deepest depths sleeps the Feather of the Feathered Serpent… and Cipactli, who guards it.
textes.Deux personnes se disputent au milieu du: Two people are arguing in the middle of the living room. The topic:
textes.Deux personnes sont agenouillées devant…: Two people kneel before… a cat. Stretched out on a cushion between two oil lamps, it pretends to sleep.
textes.Deux petites pièces, voyageur. Le destin: Two little coins, traveller. Destiny isn't read for free.
textes.Deux siècles après, Faelar a enfin fini: Two centuries later, Faelar finally finished the story of the humans' tree. The ending was: “And a little elf went to see.” Then he looked at me and smiled. He hadn't fallen asleep by chance that night.
textes.Deux vrais jaguars rôdent sur les pentes: Two real jaguars are prowling the slopes of the Smoking Mountain, to the west. They killed one of Xóchitl's turkeys. Mixtli, the jaguar warrior, wants someone to face them.
textes.Deux yeux d'argent dans la brume… LE GRA: Two silver eyes in the mist… THE GREAT MIST WOLF! You can't see it, you can't touch it. Except, perhaps, by the light of the moon.
textes.Deuxième verrou : sa combinaison de coul: Second lock: its colour combination. Watch the order in which the squares light up, then click them in the same order.
textes.Ding ! Rez-de-chaussée. Les néons du bou: Ding! Ground floor. The boulevard's neon lights, the noise of the cars… back on the street.
textes.Ding ! Une voix polie : « L'ascenseur de: Ding! A polite voice: “The service elevator only serves floors already visited. You have visited nothing. How sad.” The doors stay closed.
textes.Ding, dong, dilin… Les tubes du carillon: Ding, dong, dilin… The chime tubes sing, and the wind joins in. Far below, you can see the yurts, the red fields, the stage, and the sea.
textes.Dire à Mégaphone que c'est le moment (à: Tell Mégaphone it's time (at the sound desk, in the middle of the meadow)
textes.Dis maintenant ta confession devant les: Now speak your confession before the forty-two judges.
textes.Dis-moi, d'où viens-tu, comme ça ?: Tell me, where do you come from, then?
textes.Dis-moi, toi qui vis ici… Tu aimes la fo: Tell me, you who live here… Do you love the forest?
textes.Dis-moi, toi. Une vieille dette, ça s'ef: Tell me, you. An old debt: does time wipe it out, or does it get paid?
textes.Dis-moi, tu as rencontré {qn}. Comment t: Tell me, you've met {qn}. What do you make of {le}?
textes.Dis-moi… tu connais ce vieux fou de Barn: Tell me… do you know that old loon Barnabé, on the other side?
textes.Dites-moi, vous avez rencontré {qn}. Com: Tell me, you've met {qn}. What do you make of {le}?
textes.Dix poissons, du safran et le secret de: Ten fish, saffron and the secret of Paulo's nonna. Restores all hearts.
textes.Dong… La vieille cloche sonne sur toute: Dong… The old bell rings out over the whole island.
textes.Donner les baguettes de batterie à Gédéo: Give the drumsticks to Gédéon (at the Lisse & Fils sales office in the daytime, on the quays in the late afternoon, at the entrance to the Howling Hall in the evening)
textes.Donner un coup de pinceau (le Pinceau de: Make a brushstroke (the island's Brush, dipped in the Palette)
textes.Donner votre avis à Héloïse Manivelle, d: Give your opinion to Héloïse Manivelle, in front of the Academy
textes.Douze, Barnabé ! Et un collier pour Gast: Twelve, Barnabé! And a necklace for Gaston, bro!
Elder, the Heart is beating again.
textes.Doyenne, pourquoi les ponts de lumière c: Elder, why are the bridges of light flickering?
textes.Du bois ! Mon charbon te remercie. {prix: Wood! My charcoal thanks you. {prix} coins a log.
textes.Du bois coupé… Tu sais, chez nous, c'est: Cut wood… You know, where I come from, that's a bit like offering… an arm. No. Thank you.
textes.Du bon bois, coupé à la hache. Octave en: Good wood, cut with the axe. Octave buys it for his forge.
textes.Du cacao battu jusqu'à mousser, avec un: Cocoa whisked until frothy, with a little chilli and vanilla: the drink of the Maya kings, bitter and invigorating. Restores one heart.
textes.Du miel sauvage ! Gaston, pas touche. …: Wild honey! Gaston, paws off. … Fine, one drop.
textes.Du poisson, des patates douces, des bana: Fish, sweet potatoes, bananas… and my grandfather's favorite stone. For the flavor. He says that's the secret. He's made of stone, so naturally he thinks stone tastes good.
textes.Du slime remonte dans les puits de la Ba: Slime is rising in the wells of the Lower Town and in the fountain on the Great Square. Master Hugues knows where it comes from: from the bottom of the Dungeon of a Thousand Steps, at the foot of the Fangs, where the Jelly King reigns. I have to go down the five floors, defeat the King and bring back his Royal jelly heart.
textes.Du verre de volcan, noir et tranchant, q: Volcanic glass, black and sharp, found near the crater. Nori the runesmith carves his runes into it.
From the village, on the island across the way.
textes.Duel à la loyale ! Aux poings, et person: A fair duel! Fists only, and nobody interferes. (F: guard · Ctrl: roll)
textes.Débordée, oui. Le registre des bateaux d: Overwhelmed, yes. The boat register must be up to date for the season, and nobody comes by to declare their boat. Old Fernand, Yannick who hires out boats, and Lucas who has a rowing boat even though he says he doesn't. Ask them the name of their boat. I'll pay you.
textes.Décoiffé ! C'est le mot ! Mon chapeau à: Windswept! That's the word! My feathered hat! The finest! The one for grand occasions, small occasions, and days without any occasion! The wind carried it off from the rampart. It hopped from roof to roof, above the Middle Town, then flew off to the south. Aurore says it will come back on its own. It never comes back on its own. Would you be so kind as to look for it, young person? It has a green feather. It's very distinguished. You'll recognise it.
textes.Dégager l'éboulement de la galerie sous: Clear the rockfall in the tunnel under the sea
textes.Déjà ? Bon. Gaston va encore bouder. Rev: Already? Fine. Gaston's going to sulk again. Come back soon.
textes.Déjà de retour ? Tu ne peux plus te pass: Back already? You can't do without my conversation any more, admit it.
textes.Déjà {nb_poissons} prises ! Et ton plus: {nb_poissons} catches already! And your best: {record}. Not bad for a beginner.
textes.Démasqué ! Ha ha ! Personne ne m'avait j: Caught! Ha ha! Nobody ever found me so fast. Well… except my grandmother. And the cat.
textes.Désormais, quand tu te promèneras en vil: From now on, when you stroll around town, you'll hear me in every loudspeaker: the news, the classifieds, the weather... and you, now and then. You're a radio star now. Here, your fee. And stay tuned!

textes.EURÊKA ! … Non. Raté. Mais quel joli ver: EUREKA! … No. Failed. But what a lovely green!
textes.Elle est intacte ! Ce soir, mon phare br: It's intact! Tonight my lighthouse will shine all the way to the village again. Here… when you keep watch over a lighthouse, you learn to breathe slowly. I'll teach you: you'll last longer underwater.
textes.Elle est là ! Elle flotte au-dessus du b: She's here! She's floating above the pool, with her guilty little look! (Nova wipes away a blue tear.) Thank you, thank you! Do you know what she's singing right now? The gurgles translate to: “I went to see the world. It's big. I prefer it here.” Here: two cosmic jellies from Gloubi, it's all I have that's precious. And you can come see Plume-de-Nuage whenever you like. She'll remember you. Jellyfish never forget those who bring them home.
textes.Elle existe… Elle existe ! Une reine, un: It exists… It exists! A queen, a dome, a crystal that sings… Forty years of mockery, and I was right! Take this, it's all my holiday money. And remember this: the Atlanteans breathed slowly. Do as they did.
textes.Elle m'a demandé de planter un arbre pou: She asked me to plant a tree for every tree I cut down. I said no. Three times. Now I have a nursery behind the forge: twenty-six little kapok trees. Don't tell anyone. Especially not Barnabé.
textes.Elle m'a posé cent dix-sept questions su: She asked me a hundred and seventeen questions about humans in a single evening. I answered by describing Barnabé. Ever since, she's convinced that all humans talk to a parrot. I didn't have the heart to tell her otherwise.
textes.Elle penche un peu. C'est le style, Octa: It leans a little. That's the style, Octave.
textes.Elle revient toujours avec des pétales d: She always comes back with petals in her hair and golden pollen on her cheeks. I say they're real.
textes.Elle ronronne ! Nefer-Miou t'a accepté !: She's purring! Nefer-Miou has accepted you! It's a great honor. Take this honey cake: it's what she would have wanted.
textes.Elle s'est envolée ? Oh, mon petit… Tu a: She flew away? Oh, my dear… You have gentle hands, and a gentle heart too. Here, some coins, and a feather she left on my roof this morning: she came to thank you, I think.
textes.Elle se pose… mais le bouclier d'épines: She lands… but the thorn shield protects her. The roses of light!
textes.Elle se souvient de toi ! Elle ronronne: She remembers you! She's purring even louder than last time.
textes.Elle te suit ! Brioche te suit ! Regarde: She's following you! Brioche is following you! Look at her, sitting at your feet, tail neatly curled, like a queen who has chosen her carriage. (Rosalie wipes her eyes with her apron.) It's the smell of the fish, it stings. Listen to me: she eats one sardine a day, not two, she has her dignity. She chases butterflies, she never catches them. And she has a gift: she can sense hidden treasures. I once saw her meow for an hour in front of a paving stone in the square; underneath, there was an old gold coin. Listen to her when she meows. Here, a few coins. And if you don't have anything yet to call your animals, take this bone whistle: my grandfather, the fisherman, carved it with a dog, a cat, a rat and a pig. He said that one day, someone would have all four. Whistle, and those who love you will come running.
textes.Elle te tend une paire de chaussettes à: She hands you a pair of plaid socks, all warm… and a few coins hidden inside. “For coffee.”
textes.Elles ont chanté pour toi. Je les ai ent: They sang for you. I heard them all the way here. So it's settled: you are a wizard of Arcanelle. Here, your staff: wood from the Twisted Wood and a crystal from the Circle. In your hand, it makes your spells lighter. And your magic is greater from now on. Go, wizard. The world needs light, fire, ice, wind, patience and healing. Healing most of all.
textes.Elles s'inquiètent. (Une grande fleur cl: They're worried. (A big flower blinks three times, very fast.) See? Three quick blinks means “where are the little ones?” The little ones are my glowing seeds. I was drying them in the sun, at the end of the bridge of light... and a gust of wind pushed them into the Zero-Gravity Garden. Over there, nothing falls back down. They float, way up high, between the leaves that fall upward. Me, with my eight-hundred-year-old knees, I jump like an old squash. You're young. Jump! Catch them! Three seeds, round and warm, glowing like night-lights.
textes.Elles se sont toutes arrêtées à une heur: They all stopped at a different time. That way, one of them is always right. Twice a day.
textes.Embêtée ? Je suis CLOUÉE AU SOL ! (Elle: Upset? I'm GROUNDED! (She shows her wing in a sling.) I sprained it on a chimney. I still have three letters: one for Grumbald, at the Diable Repu; one for Ombreline, at the Library of Souls; one for Gorgoth, at the arena. Would you? I'll pay you in stamps. No, in coins.
textes.En garde, créature ! Tu ne sais pas à qu: On guard, creature! You don't know who you're dealing with!
textes.En remontant vers sa cité, je l'ai vu gl: On the way back up to his city, I saw him slip one of my axes into his belt instead of tossing it on the pile. Just one, the best. He probably says it's for showing apprentices what not to do. Me, I know a customer with taste when I see one.
textes.En selle ! Stick gauche : vers l'avant p: Saddle up! Left stick: forward to climb, back to descend, left or right to turn. Right trigger: faster, left trigger: brake. A: land.
textes.En selle ! Z / S : plus vite / freiner,: Saddle up! W / S: faster / brake, A / D: turn, Space: climb, Ctrl: descend, E: land.
textes.Encore ! Dehors ! La boutique est fermée: Again! Out! The shop is closed!
textes.Encore ? Tu as déjà la bouche toute roug: Again? Your mouth is already all red. Wait until the ladle cools down.
textes.Encore ?! Je m'en souviendrai, crois-moi: Again?! I'll remember this, believe me.
Again?! You like explosions, you do. So do I.
textes.Encore ?! Tu as un estomac de Moaï, toi: Again?! You have a Moai's stomach! … Come back tomorrow, it needs to cook some more.
textes.Encore des marches. Tes mollets proteste: More steps. Your calves protest politely.
textes.Encore des marches. Ça sent l'huile de m: More steps. It smells of machine oil and steam.
textes.Encore le virus de Fil ? Donne-moi ton c: Fil's virus again? Give me your journal. (She plugs a pink cable into your journal and types at lightning speed.) There: I'm opening up the system for you. Pick up where you left off.
textes.Encore toi, {surnom}. Tu as des pièces,: You again, {surnom}. You've got coins, I hope.
Three more rows, and then I'll have lunch.
textes.Encore trouvé ! La prochaine fois, je me: Found again! Next time, I'm hiding in the fireplace. No, just kidding. Or maybe not.
textes.Encore un ? Tu as bon appétit, ça fait p: Another one? You've got a good appetite, it's a joy to see!
textes.Encore un tour ! Les rubans s'emmêlent u: One more lap! The ribbons get a bit tangled, but nobody will mind.
textes.Encore une réussite ! Tu devrais ouvrir: Another success! You should open your own shop.
textes.Encore {dernier_cadeau} ? Tu me gâtes !: {dernier_cadeau} again? You spoil me! That's {nb_cadeaux} gifts, I'm counting, you know.
textes.Enfin ! Mes clients réclamaient leurs ta: At last! My customers were demanding their toast. Thank you, and tell Margaux she's an angel.
textes.Enfin quelqu'un de sérieux. Comptant, to: Finally, someone serious. Cash, always cash. Debts are like iron: they don't disappear just because you look the other way.
textes.Enfin quelqu'un qui reconnaît le génie !: At last, someone who recognises genius! I'm coming. Stay behind me when I cast a lightning bolt. Or in front. Well, not too close.
Well… it's not my best day.
textes.Entre deux pots de tomates : une tirelir: Between two tomato pots: a piggy bank shaped like a radish. Radis had forgotten it. He'll say it's for you.
textes.Entre nous… ce n'était peut-être pas que: Between you and me… maybe it wasn't just the map. Maybe I'd dozed off a bit at the helm. Don't EVER tell Barnabé.
textes.Entre nous… j'ai vu des lumières au somm: Between you and me… I saw lights at the top of the tallest rock spire one night. Gaston says it was the moon. Gaston says a lot of things.
textes.Entre, entre ! Et ferme la porte, sinon: Come in, come in! And shut the door, or Filou will slip off again.
textes.Entre, entre ! Ici, la porte est toujour: Come in, come in! Here the door is always open and the teapot always warm. Want some herbal tea? Mint from Lavande's garden, chamomile, and a poppy petal for the color.
textes.Entre, entre, ne reste pas dans le coura: Come in, come in, don't stand in the draft!
textes.Entrer dans Pandémonia, la cité aux mill: Enter Pandémonia, the city of a thousand lanterns
textes.Entrer dans Yggdrasil par la porte aux r: Enter Yggdrasil through the rune door
Enter Yggdrasil through the rune door, cross its three halls to the Crown and receive the seed
textes.Entrer dans l'Usine Grise (au sud-est de: Enter the Grey Factory (in the south-east of the island, behind the Spore Wood), go down the five floors and defeat the Great Digger in the President's Pit
textes.Entrer dans la cité de cristal et de lum: Enter the city of crystal and light
textes.Entrer dans la cité sous la montagne: Enter the city under the mountain
textes.Entrer dans le Rocher du Crâne par sa bo: Enter Skull Rock through its mouth and open Barbe-Sanglante's chest (E)
Come in! … Oh no, it's locked.
Staircase B: reserved for polite robots.
textes.Espace : pédaler E : replier l'Alouett: Space: pedal   E: fold the Alouette
textes.Essayer le Glisseur stellaire : l'appele: Try out the Star Glider: call it, climb aboard and fly off above Astralys
textes.Et Octave, il en dit quoi, de ta cabane: And Octave, what does he say about your shack?
textes.Et de deux ! Plus qu'un, et on le met à: And that's two! Just one more, and into the trash it goes.
textes.Et dérouler la carte. Un jour. Avec Barn: And unroll the map. One day. With Barnabé beside me. We'd finally know. Or we'd argue for another twenty-two years. That'd be something, at least.
And then? Tell me what happened next.
textes.Et grâce à toi, ma collection est complè: And thanks to you, my collection is complete.
textes.Et je sais que tu as fait un cadeau à %s: And I know you gave a present to %s.
textes.Et je sais que vous avez fait un cadeau: And I know you gave a present to %s.
textes.Et la clé, c'est un caillou. Comme tous: And the key is a pebble. Like all the pebbles on the island. Good luck! Hee hee!
textes.Et le disque rare, celui des deux villag: And the rare record, the one about the two villages?
textes.Et le troisième est suave comme la mort: And the third is smooth as death! … No, I'm joking, mostly it's very sweet. Here, keep the mint for the road.
textes.Et moi des bananes. On fait des croissan: And I brought bananas. Shall we make banana croissants?
textes.Et ne viens pas te plaindre si tu casses: And don't come complaining if you break a jaw. Or two. Jaws mend. The Doc is there for that.
textes.Et puis aujourd'hui, je suis de bonne hu: And besides, today I'm in a good mood.
textes.Et puis… un soir, monter à l'échelle d'O: And then… one evening, climbing up Octave's ladder with two coconuts and a pack of cards. Like on the Seagull. He'd cheat, I'd pretend not to see a thing. Don't tell Gaston.
textes.Et salée ! Comme les larmes. Mais en plu: And salty! Like tears. But bigger.
textes.Et si Cerbère n'en veut pas… mange-les !: And if Cerberus doesn't want them… eat them! They're very good for humans too.
textes.Et si on retrouvait les quatre sceaux ?: What if we found the four seals?
textes.Et ta potion avait un goût d'écorce brûl: And your potion tasted of burnt bark.
textes.Et tes voisins, ils sont comment ?: And your neighbours, what are they like?
textes.Et toi, de quoi tu rêves ?: And you, what do you dream of?
textes.Et toi, tu rigoles ?!: And you, you think it's funny?!
textes.Et tu as encore fait boum-boum à mes ban: And have you been going boom-boom at my banana trees again?
textes.Et tu as rendu la vie à l'Arbre sacré. L: And you gave life back to the sacred Tree. Bois-Doré will never forget it.
textes.Et tu l'as mangé, au moins ? Tu es toute: And did you at least eat it? You're all skin and bones!
textes.Et tu m'as frappé %d fois. Je n'oublie p: And you hit me %d times. I don't forget.
textes.Et tu m'as frappé une fois. Je n'oublie: And you hit me once. I don't forget.
textes.Et tu m'as rapporté de quoi faire six ma: And you brought me enough to make six shovel handles. That, I don't forget.
textes.Et un jour, planter une graine de l'Arbr: And one day, plant a seed of the Mother Tree on every island of the archipelago, so that human children can climb in it. Trees quickly learn to love those who climb them.
textes.Et voilà ! L'Alouette. Toile tendue, hau: There! The Alouette. Canvas stretched, stays adjusted, spring harness. I've invented something! Well, the hang glider may already have existed elsewhere… but not in Cliquetis! Go to the end of the runway, and take flight!
textes.Et voilà, tout est par terre. Je la réét: And there you go, everything's on the floor. I'll turn it off again tonight, it's more restful for sleeping.
textes.Et voilà. Attention, c'est chaud. Avec u: There you go. Careful, it's hot. With a cloud of cream. A real cloud, from Rainville.
textes.Et voilà. Prends le temps de le savourer: There you are. Take your time and enjoy it.
textes.Et voilà. Prenez le temps de le savourer: There you are. Take your time and enjoy it.
textes.Et vous m'avez frappé %d fois. Je n'oubl: And you hit me %d times. I don't forget.
textes.Et vous m'avez frappé une fois. Je n'oub: And you hit me once. I don't forget.
textes.Euh… La table, les chaises, le lit, l'ar: Uh… The table, the chairs, the bed, the wardrobe… everything is on the CEILING.
textes.Exact. L'affaire des croissants. Chaque: Exactly. The croissant affair. Every night, half a dozen go missing from the bakery. I have three witnesses: Margaux, her daughter Nina and Bruno the ice-cream seller. Question them. Me, I'm keeping an eye on… the ice-cream seller.
textes.Excellent choix ! Ma grand-mère disait t: Excellent choice! My grandmother always used to say… um… I forget. But it was about that, I'm sure.
textes.Extraordinary ! Elle sera la reine de ma: Extraordinary! She will be the queen of my collection. Here are two gold coins, minted by my great-grandfather. Cheers!
textes.FAUSSE ?! Ma carte était un chef-d'œuvre: WRONG?! My map was a masterpiece! Gaston, remind me never to speak of that fellow again.
textes.Faelar ? Le plus vieil elfe du monde, et: Faelar? The oldest elf in the world, and he knows my song by heart! He thinks the hero is shorter than in the verses. That's poetry, come now!
textes.Faelar a vu pousser presque tous les arb: Faelar has watched almost every tree in Bois-Doré grow. Nobody tells stories better than he does. When he doesn't fall asleep halfway through.
textes.Faelar, tu t'étais endormi exprès, ce so: Faelar, you fell asleep on purpose that night. Admit it.
textes.Faire la connaissance de Pip, le plus je: Meet Pip, the youngest of the apprentices (in the Academy courtyard in the morning, on the village square in the evening)
textes.Faire le tour de la ville en monorail (l: Ride the monorail around the city (all four stations)
textes.Faire les offrandes du Grand Temple d'Az: Make the offerings at the Great Temple of Aztlán
textes.Faire redescendre les quatre livres envo: Bring the four runaway books back down with telekinesis (key 9 then V, aiming at the book; in VR, left trigger): on the library roof, on the highest Moonstone of the Circle, at a window of the Leaning Tower and in a big oak in the Twisted Wood
textes.Faire siffler l'ampli (l'effet Larsen): Make the amp squeal (the Larsen effect)
textes.Faire tourner la vieille vanne de la gra: Turn the old sluice valve of Ramure's big pond with the Cog (key 3 then X; in VR, B), then, at night, take the Seal of Mists from the round stone at the bottom of the pond
textes.Faire venir mon bateau au ponton de Port: Bring my boat to the Port-Azur jetty
textes.Faites glisser pour déplacer, molette po: Drag to move, mouse wheel to zoom.
Drag to move, scroll wheel to zoom.  ▲ you  ★ objective  ⚓ liner
textes.Fatigué. J'ai battu le fer toute la nuit: Tired. I was hammering iron all night. A sword doesn't make itself while you sing.
textes.Fatiguée. Garder un arbre, c'est garder: Tired. Guarding a tree is like guarding a dream: you must never quite close your eyes.
textes.Fer forgé par Octave. En main, clic (gâc: Iron forged by Octave. In hand, click (trigger in VR) to dig in sand or earth: shells, coins… and sometimes a treasure.
Locked. A sign: “FOR SALE. Wisteria Cottage, unbeatable view, wisteria included, frogs optional. Inquire with Monsieur Prosper, Upper Town.”
textes.Fermé à clé. Une petite clé l'ouvrirait…: Locked. A small key would open it… You can find them in other chests, and sometimes in crates and jars.
Hooked! Keep the tension in the green.
textes.Festival du Larsen\nChaque soir à 20 h 3:
Larsen Festival
Every evening at 8:30 PM: “The Sun and the Rain”,
the two villages on the Main Stage!
Fireworks at 11 PM.
textes.Festival du Larsen\nLa Grande Scène se p:
Larsen Festival
The Main Stage is getting ready…
Come back soon: it's going to be loud!
textes.Fin de l'alerte : les navets se sont tou: End of the alert: the turnips have all replanted themselves, looking innocent. Father Gaubert sighs: “They'll do it again. They always do.”
textes.Firmin Cogne a perdu l'engrenage d'or de: Firmin Cogne lost the golden gear of his perpetual-motion engine during a demonstration. It rolled all the way down the cliffs, towards the harbour.
textes.Forgefer, la cité des nains: Forgefer, the city of the dwarves
textes.Forgefer, la cité sous la montagne: Forgefer, the city under the mountain
textes.Forgefer. Une halle immense taillée dans: Forgefer. An immense hall carved into the mountain: pillars engraved with runes, channels of lava lighting everything orange, the smell of coal and hot iron… At the far end, on his throne, King Thorgal.
textes.Forger une épée si belle que même Borin: Forge a sword so beautiful that even Borin Barbe-de-Fer would look at it without a word. Just once. I'd settle for his silence. That, at least, costs nothing.
textes.Forgé par Brutus, trois dents de crocodi: Forged by Brutus, with three crocodile teeth set in the iron. As long as it's in your bag, your punches hit harder in brawls (+1). Fists only.
textes.Forgé par Hector à l'Enclume Bleue : lam: Forged by Hector at L'Enclume Bleue: a curved blade of blued steel, with a brass shell guard. Damage: 10, and the third hit of a combo strikes half again as hard.
textes.Forgée par Borin Barbe-de-Fer dans l'aci: Forged by Borin Barbe-de-Fer from volcano steel: a short, broad blade, a golden guard, a ruby on the pommel. Damage: 9, and the third hit of a combo strikes half again as hard.
textes.Fouiller les caisses au bout du quai, cô: Search the crates at the end of the quay, on the lighthouse side
textes.Frappe le tronc avec le fer de la hache: Strike the trunk with the iron of the axe!
textes.Frapper à la porte des quatre maisons: Knock on the doors of the four houses
textes.Fuiii ! Brioche apparaît sur un muret, s: Weee! Brioche appears on a low wall, stretches for a long time, and joins you without hurrying.
textes.Fuiii-iii ! Sardine arrive au grand galo: Weee-eee! Sardine comes at a full gallop, ears flying (well, one of them).
textes.GERMAINE ! L'AMPLI ! (Elle court cherche: GERMAINE! THE AMP! (She runs to fetch Clou. Clou arrives, takes Germaine, hugs her to his chest and says nothing for a whole minute. Then he nods at you. Just once. Rouille cries.) He nodded at you! Do you know how many people have gotten a nod from Clou? Four! And the drumsticks... you keep them. We don't have a real drummer yet. They're waiting for someone. Maybe you'll find out who.
textes.GORGOTH LE CORNU, le champion de l'arène: GORGOTH THE HORNED, champion of the arena! He charges with lowered horns: step aside at the last moment, strike him in the back. The crowd roars!
textes.GROSSE-DENT ! Le roi du Cirque des Os. S: GROSSE-DENT! The king of the Bone Hollow. His skin is thick… When he ROARS, he's going to charge: dodge at the last moment and let him smash into the rock of the hollow. Stunned, he takes double damage! Don't stay behind him: his tail sweeps everything.
textes.Gagner la Grande Course : prendre le dép: Win the Great Race: start under the arch of the Games Clearing (E), pass under the ten arches in order and come back first
textes.Gagner le troisième morceau contre Sylva: Win the third piece from Sylvain (three wins in a row at the big table of the Shark's Tooth), then take the three pieces to Philémon Lunette, the mapmaker (in front of his tower)
textes.Gagner les quatre manches du Tournoi des: Win the four rounds of the Tournament of Horns (strike the gong, at the edge of the arena sand)
textes.Garde le Bail, mon grand. Non, ne discut: Keep the Lease, kiddo. No, don't argue: the assembly voted. It'll be better with you than in a drawer: that way, it'll travel. The Boucan is ours, forever, and thanks to you. Here, the whole common fund. And a title. We don't like titles here. But this one, we voted for laughing: Hero of Port-Boucan. Tonight, concert. You go to the front of the line.
textes.Garde ça, {surnom}. Tu en auras plus bes: Keep it, {surnom}. You'll need it more than I do. Me, I fight with metaphors.
textes.Garde-le, voyons : on dirait que tu en a: Keep it, come now: looks like you need it.
textes.Gaspard ! Tu as commencé par le plancher: Gaspard! Did you start with the floor this time?
textes.Gaspard ? Mon meilleur élève. Mon seul é: Gaspard? My best pupil. My only pupil, all right, but the best. He nods when I talk: either he's listening, or it's the music.
textes.Gaspard Fusain, le guetteur du Belvédère: Gaspard Fusain, the lookout of the Belvedere, saw a little glint shining at the top of Mount Charcoal through his telescope. He thinks it's the pot of purple (no. 6). He'd like you to look for yourself, then go and fetch it.
textes.Gaspard est monté à mon échelle demander: Gaspard climbed my ladder to ask for nails. He saw my joints, mortise and tenon, not a single nail, as it happens. He stood there with his mouth open for an hour. He even stopped nodding. Now that's a compliment.
textes.Gaspard, vous ne rêviez pas : voici le v: Gaspard, you weren't dreaming: here's the purple!
textes.Gaston : « Barnabé est un génie ! Un gén: Gaston: “Barnabé is a genius! A genius!”
textes.Gaston : « RRRAAAH ! » Il ne te parlera: Gaston: “RRRAAAH!” He won't speak to you for a week. Neither will I, maybe.
textes.Gaston : « Rrrah ! Il a bon goût ! » Il: Gaston: “Rrrah! Good taste!” He adores you now. That's rare.
Gaston has learned his kick drum. “Boom. Boom. Boom.” At five in the morning, right above my pillow. Mistral says it's a remix. I say it's a curse. But I tap my foot all the same.
textes.Gaston dit que c'était une luciole. Gast: Gaston says it was a firefly. Gaston is jealous.
textes.Gaston dit que je suis le meilleur serve: Gaston says I'm the best waiter on the island. I'm the only waiter robot on the island.
textes.Gaston m'a fait un smiley qui tire la la: Gaston made me a smiley sticking out its tongue!
textes.Gaston m'a trouvé, pas l'inverse. Il est: Gaston found me, not the other way round. He came down from a tree and said “Shipwreck”. He was the first to speak to me here.
textes.Gaston ne porte pas de bijoux. … Il est: Gaston doesn't wear jewellery. … What colour is it?
textes.Gaston veut savoir : tu le trouves beau: Gaston wants to know: do you think he's handsome?
textes.Gaston, cache les coquillages, il revien: Gaston, hide the seashells, here comes trouble again!
textes.Gaston, note : Octave m'a parlé. Huit mo: Gaston, write this down: Octave spoke to me. Eight words more than last year.
textes.Gaston, on m'offre {dernier_cadeau}. Oui: Gaston, someone's giving me {dernier_cadeau}. Yes. Don't laugh.
textes.Gaston, tu as vu ? Il m'a frappé ! Note-: Gaston, did you see that? I've been hit! Write it down!
textes.Gaston, tu entends ? Une elfe qui se sou: Gaston, did you hear that? An elf who remembers me!
textes.Germaine, Père Gaubert m'envoie, pour le: Germaine, Père Gaubert sent me, about the little pig.
Glitch says it's a bad idea. But it's almost free…
textes.Glitch, c'était toi, dans l'écran ?: Glitch, was that you, in the screen?
textes.Glorb ! Voici tes holo-photos des quatre: Glorb! Here are your holo-photos from the four corners of the archipelago.
textes.Glorb, le touriste de la planète Gloop,: Glorb, the tourist from the planet Gloop, would like to send his mum photos from the four corners of the archipelago. But he's green and wobbly, and he's afraid of scaring the people down below. He gives you his holo-photo: you need to photograph the mayor of Port-Azur, Mama Grog in Balafre, the Baron of Montjoie and Mamie Barricade in the Boucan, then bring the camera back to him.
textes.Glorb, pourquoi tu photographies tout ?: Glorb, why do you photograph everything?
textes.Glou, glou. L'eau a un goût de… rien du: Glug, glug. The water tastes of… absolutely nothing. Optimised. It still feels good (one more heart).
textes.Gné ?… Si c'est le facteur, posez ça sur: Hmm?… If it's the mailman, put it on the table… zzz…
textes.Gontran Lestrange, dit Jambe-de-Bois, le: Gontran Lestrange, known as Jambe-de-Bois, captain of the Veuve Écarlate, has owed Mama Grog forty coins for three moons. She wants his purse.
textes.Gorgoth baisse les cornes… et charge !: Gorgoth lowers his horns… and charges!
textes.Gorgée d'eau, avec une algue en prime. Q: Soaked through, with a bonus piece of seaweed. Somebody, somewhere, has a cold foot.
textes.Goûter la sauce du volcan avec la louche: Taste the volcano's sauce with the giant ladle
textes.Goûter le néo-ramen du robot du Marché d: Taste the robot's neo-ramen at the Night Market
textes.Goûter le thé stellaire de Gloubi (au Ca: Taste Gloubi's star tea (at the Nebula Café, west of the Agora of Stars)
textes.Grand-Mère Aquarelle est devant la Palet: Grandma Watercolour is in front of the Palette, Gaspard at the Lookout.
textes.Grand-Mère Aquarelle, l'île a retrouvé t: Grandmother Watercolour, the island has all its colours back!
textes.Grand-Mère Aquarelle, le brun est revenu: Grandmother Watercolour, the brown has returned to the clearing!
textes.Grand-Mère Aquarelle, pourquoi l'île est: Grand-Mère Aquarelle, why is the island all grey?
textes.Grand-père Ébène raconte que Cerbère, le: Grandpa Ébène says that Cerberus, the three-headed dog of the Nine Circles, can't resist honey cakes: one per head. Bobor, the baker, is happy to bake three… if he has honey.
Scratch behind the ear. No, the other one. THERE.
textes.Gravé sur une poutre : « Le trésor de Pa: Carved on a beam: “Grandpa's treasure: to share with whoever finds it. Except the chocolate coins: those are for me.”
textes.Grimper au Belvédère des Couleurs, en ha: Climb to the Lookout of Colours, at the top of the Great Oak
textes.Grimper au sommet des Crocs (les colline: Climb to the top of the Fangs (the rocky hills in the south-west, above the dungeon entrance) and pick up three storm crystals
textes.Grosse-Dent est furieux : il va plus vit: Grosse-Dent is furious: he's faster now… and he's calling his raptor pals!
textes.Grosse-Dent s'est cogné la tête contre l: Grosse-Dent bumped his head on the rock! He's seeing stars: STRIKE HIM NOW!
textes.Grosse-Dent s'écroule… et se met à RONFL: Grosse-Dent collapses… and starts SNORING. He sleeps like a baby (an eight-ton baby). The Clan will talk about it for generations! Go back and see Ougha at the Camp.
textes.Grouik ! Truffe a déterré une truffe ! I: Oink! Truffle dug up a truffle! He sets it at your feet, snout full of dirt.
textes.Grouik ! Ça veut dire « je suis content: Oink! That means “I'm happy”. Oink oink means “very”.
textes.Grouik grouik ! Truffe arrive au petit t: Oink oink! Truffle arrives at a little trot, ears flopping.
textes.Grrrrinc… Deuxième vanne. Les jets de ce: Grrrrinc… Second valve. The jets in this corridor switch off; the gauge reads “MEDIUM”. One more!
textes.Grrrrinc… PFFFFSSSHHH ! Toute la chauffe: Grrrrinc… PFFFFSSSHHH! The whole boiler room lets out a long sigh of relief. The gauge falls to “SLIPPERS” (that's the minimum).
textes.Grrrrinc… Tu tournes le gros volant roug: Grrrrinc… You turn the big red wheel. The pipes sigh, and the jets in this corridor fall silent. The pressure gauge, near the door, drops a notch: “HIGH”.
Grrr… It smells of bolts around here.
textes.Grâce à tes bâtons, j'ai de quoi travail: Thanks to your sticks, I've got enough work for the whole winter. Well, there's no winter here. The whole year, then.
Thanks to you, my collection is complete. Well, until I find a bigger one to complete.
textes.Grésille ? Elle ne grésille même plus !: Crackling? It doesn't even crackle anymore! It does... nothing! Pschhh... nothing at all! The storm ripped my antenna off the Rusty Whale's mast. I saw it fly off like a scrap-metal seagull, over the town, and land at the very top of the painted water tower, in the east. Twenty-eight metres! Fusible gets dizzy on the second rung, Boulon is too heavy for the ladder, and me... I'm a radio host, not a mountaineer. Would you go fetch it? I'll do a special show for you. Four hours long. All about you.
textes.Gâchette : boire un verre d'eau: Trigger: drink a glass of water
textes.Gâchette : consulter le Tableau des Quêt: Trigger: look at the Quest Board
textes.Gâchette : danser autour de l'arbre à ru: Trigger: dance around the ribbon tree
textes.Gâchette : descendre dans le Donjon des: Trigger: go down into the Dungeon of a Thousand Steps
textes.Gâchette : descendre dans les Neuf Cercl: Trigger: descend into the Nine Circles
textes.Gâchette : déplier l'Alouette et s'élanc: Trigger: unfold the Alouette and take off

Gédéon, Mr Lisse's son, taps out rhythms on everything he touches. Every evening, he listens to the Bilge Rats from behind the door of the Howling Hall. He's a brilliant drummer, but he has neither drumsticks nor courage. As for the drumsticks, you've kept them since the Great Boucan…

textes.HA HA ! C'est mon chef-d'œuvre ! Je l'ap: HA HA! It's my masterpiece! I'll call it “The Visitor Who Ate a Lemon.”
textes.HA HA HA ! Tu as remarqué ! On fait ce c: HA HA HA! You noticed! We've been holding this contest for a thousand years, and it's a tie every time. Here, you have a good eye: a seashell medal!
textes.Ha ! De la fontaine de la place jusqu'à: Ha! From the fountain in the square to the lighthouse door, in under sixty seconds. The clock starts when you pass near the fountain. Ready?
textes.Ha ! Enfin quelqu'un qui le voit ! Je co: Ha! Finally someone who sees it! I was starting to wonder.

textes.Ha ha ! La machine a parlé ! Elle a dit: Ha ha! The machine has spoken! It said “BOOM,” but it spoke! Keep this little souvenir.
textes.Ha ha ! Tu parles comme Faelar. Il a déj: Ha ha! You sound like Faelar. He once slept three years straight, you know. He says it's the best way not to age too fast.
textes.Ha ha ! Tu vois, mon trésor, les humains: Ha ha! See, my treasure, humans make faces too! They're just like us… only paler.
textes.Ha ha ! Un Pied-Lourd qui aime flotter !: Ha ha! A Heavyfoot who likes floating! You're almost a Lumen. Come back anytime, gravity is overrated.
textes.Ha ha ! À la prochaine !: Ha ha! See you next time!

textes.Hm hm. Tu es plus malin que mes petits-e: Hm hm. You're smarter than my grandchildren. … Look: they're all asleep. As usual. Go, traveler. And if you find the eyes… the Great Moai is waiting for you.
textes.Hm. Hm, hm. (Il prend le pot, le regarde: Hm. Hm, hm. (He takes the pot and examines it through the spyglass, from very close up, which is no use at all.) I wasn't dreaming. Well. In spring, the mountain heather will be purple again. I'll be able to draw it in charcoal. It'll be grey on the paper, but I'll know. Here: my old compass. It points north. Almost.
textes.Hm. Peut-être. Ce matin, tout là-haut, a: Hm. Maybe. This morning, way up high, at the top of Mount Charcoal: a glint. Not a stone, not water. A pot. The purple one, I bet: number six, the heather's. But my legs don't climb the mountain anymore. First look through my spyglass, there, at the edge of the Lookout. If you see it too, then I'm not dreaming.
textes.Hmm ? J'ai perdu le fil. Ça m'arrive. So: Hmm? I lost my train of thought. It happens. Often.

textes.Ho ho ! Le Grand Troc, c'est une chaîne,: Ho ho! The Great Swap is a chain, my friend. I give you this singing pebble: listen, when the wind passes through it, it whistles. You'll swap it for something better, then that something for something better still… Pomme-de-Pin, the carpenter, loves singing pebbles. Start with her. And at the end, come back and see me: I want to know what my pebble became!
textes.Honorine est seule au four ce matin. Il: Honorine is alone at the oven this morning. There are three loaves left to deliver: one to Mamie Rissole, at the Guild tavern; one to Aurore, at the castle; one to Gilles, at the North Gate. If she leaves the oven, everything burns.
textes.Hou ! Un gland d'or ! Je le mettrai sur: Hoo! A golden acorn! I'll put it on my counter, it'll bring luck to the post. Here's a moon feather: it falls from our wings on full-moon nights. Which is to say every night, here. Pivoine is looking for some for her vials.
textes.Hugo a perdu son alliance dans le sable,: Hugo has lost his wedding ring in the sand, near the Coco Loco beach hut, where the waves come in.
textes.Huit pièces la chambre, thé du matin com: Eight coins a room, morning tea included. Caravaneers pay in dates; you don't even have dates.
Hmm. We'll need a new roof. Again.
Hmm… I don't see a boat.

textes.Hé ! Rends-moi mes fenêtres !: Hey! Give me back my windows!
textes.Hé ! Tout le monde parle de toi, tu sais: Hey! Everyone's talking about you, you know?
textes.Hé ! Tout le monde parle de vous, vous s: Hey! Everyone's talking about you, you know?
textes.Hé ! Tu tombes bien. On répète pour… pou: Hey! Perfect timing. We're rehearsing for… for nothing, actually. There's no festival anymore. But we rehearse anyway. Want to turn up the amp? The knob goes up to eleven.

textes.Il est parfait… Attendez… Écoutez ! Tic,: It's perfect… Wait… Listen! Tick, tock… and… DONG! It chimes! After so many years! Thank you, thank you… You've given the square its heart back.
textes.Il est tard, oui. Mais la nuit a ses sec: It's late, yes. But the night has its secrets.
textes.Il est venu me saluer dans la clairière,: He came to greet me in the clearing, Gaston on his shoulder and only one boot on. He asked me if elves ate shells. I said we mostly ate flowers. The next day, he brought me a bouquet. Of shells. I kept it.
textes.Il fait bon. Les heures passent tranquil: It's pleasant out. The hours drift by.
textes.Il fait noir… Tu entends ce bruit ? C'ét: It's dark… Do you hear that noise? That was my tummy. I think.

textes.Il m'a dessiné une carte du Bois-Doré sa: He drew me a map of Bois-Doré without ever having been there. Everything's wrong: the trees, the walkways, the number of moons. Except the Mother Tree, exactly in its place. I hung it at home, above my bed.
textes.Il m'a frappé ! Vous avez vu ?!: He hit me! Did you see?!
textes.Il m'a taillé un peigne dans une branche: He carved me a comb from a branch that fell from his kapok tree. He repeated three times: “Fallen. Not cut.” I wear it every day. In Bois-Doré, people ask me which elf carved it. I answer: a bear.
textes.Il manque encore {manque_liste}. Ne te p: We're still missing {manque_liste}. Don't hurry: the Tree is patient, even when it's ill.
textes.Il me faut du bois, oui. Une voie d'eau: I need wood, yes. A leak has opened under the forge, on the port side: nothing serious, but if I don't plug it, Jos will end the week with his feet in the water. Four logs. Good wood, not driftwood. An axe, a tree, and back you come.
textes.Il me faut encore {manque_liste}. Courag: I still need {manque_liste}. Courage: the Tree is waiting for you. It never complains, but I can hear it sigh.
textes.Il me manque encore {manque_liste}. La f: I'm still missing {manque_liste}. The moonflower only grows at the top of the little jungle peak, the one that looks over the bay. The water: draw it with the vial from the pool of the big waterfall, in the north-east of this island. And the golden seed… the waves carried it off long ago. Perhaps a collector picked it up?
textes.Il ment. Comme tous les arbres. Et tous: It's lying. Like all trees. And all customers.
textes.Il n'y a personne. Le parquet craque sou: There's nobody. The floorboards creak under your steps. Especially near the rug.
textes.Il n'y a personne. Une maison bien rangé: There's nobody here. A tidy house that smells of wax and bread.
textes.Il n'y a personne… juste une théière sur: There's nobody here… just a teapot on the low table. A teapot with… a bushy tail?
textes.Il n'y a plus rien sous le coussin. Just: There's nothing left under the cushion. Just a bit of cat fur.

textes.Il paraît qu'on peut voir le Grand Spagh: They say you can see the Great Spaghetti through the holes in the ceiling. I'm looking for the right hole.
textes.Il paraît qu'on trouve des petites croix: They say you can find little wooden crosses on the beaches. Castaways more far-sighted than me buried their savings there.

There's one thing I've never told anyone. Someday, maybe. When I trust you.
textes.Il s'appelle Moustache ! Regarde ses mou: His name is Moustache! Look at his whiskers!
textes.Il s'est arrêté net au bord de la plate-: He stopped dead at the edge of the platform! Strike!
textes.Il s'est assommé contre la paroi ! C'est: He knocked himself out against the wall! Now's the moment!
textes.Il sort une lame ! Le lâche !: He's drawing a blade! The coward!
textes.Il sort, tout au fond, un disque dans un: From the very back, he pulls out a record in a handmade sleeve: a sun and a cloud holding hands. “Vinyle kept this one for the day the two villages made peace. That day has come.” The music starts: djembes, a fuzzy guitar, and two girls' voices… those of Granny Sunflower and Mother Downpour, fifty years ago.
textes.Il t'a touché ? Avec son Appendice Nouil: He touched you? With his Noodly Appendage? (The Reverend takes off his golden colander, presses it to his heart, and puts it back on crooked.) My child… In forty years, he has touched only three people. A fisherman, a baker, and Nonno Tortellini, in 1987 — he says it was a wink, but it was a noodle. You are the fourth. Here: two plates of Mamma's spaghetti, two focaccias fresh from the oven, and a title, which I'll write myself in the great book. Ramen, my child. Ramen!
textes.Il te manque des pièces… Bon. Je te l'of: You're short of coins… Fine. It's on me. But don't tell Spleen, he'd say I'm too nice. He'd be right.
textes.Il te manque quelques pièces. Reviens qu: You're a few coins short. Come back when you've got enough to pay.
textes.Il te réveille d'un coup : endurance au: It wakes you up in one go: stamina at maximum.
textes.Il te suit ! Regarde-le, le groin collé: He's following you! Look at him, snout glued to your shoes! (Père Gaubert laughs, then blows his nose loudly.) It's the pollen. Listen carefully, lad: he eats anything, but not the golden turnips, no, those are my little ones. In the woods and meadows, let him sniff around: he'll find you truffles, and sometimes some old buried thing, a coin, a ring… He has a golden snout, I'm telling you. Here, two truffles he found for me yesterday, and a few coins. And if you don't already have a whistle to call your animals, take my father's, carved from bone: a dog, a cat, a rat and a pig all around it. Whistle, and your pig will come back. Gently with my little one, all right!
textes.Il va battre son record… Non… Si… NON !: He's going to beat his record… No… Yes… NO!
textes.Il vous manque quelques pièces. Revenez: You're a few coins short. Come back when you can pay.
textes.Il y a deux chutes d'eau ici. L'eau de l: There are two waterfalls here. The water of the bigger one, in the north-east, comes from very deep under the ground. It tastes of stars.
textes.Il y a dix jours, la Grande Averse (une: Ten days ago, the Great Downpour (a shower of clear water from a pure white cloud) washed over Sketched Island: the Stone Palette overflowed, and the island's nine pots of colour were carried off by the water to the four corners of the island. Since then, everything has been black and white. Grandma Aquarelle, the village elder, has entrusted you with the island's Brush. You need to find the nine pots and pour each one into its numbered paint well.
textes.Il y a douze ans, j'ai chargé une barque: Twelve years ago, I loaded a boat with shovels and axes and rowed all the way to the Fire Reefs. The beach guard wouldn't let me in. Borin came down, struck one of my axes on a rock and said: “Not bad, for a tall one.” He bought the lot, in gold. To melt it down.
textes.Il y a du vent aujourd'hui, ça va secoue: It's windy today, it's going to be bumpy.
textes.Il y a très, très longtemps, le Grand Mo: A very, very long time ago, the Great Moai had eyes. Two eyes of white coral that saw everything: the sky, the sea, and what sings beneath the earth. Beneath him, a staircase leads down to the Hall of Song, where the island's memory sleeps.
textes.Il y a un arbre si grand que ses racines: There's a tree so tall that its roots drink from every island. The fairies call it Yggdrasil.
textes.Il y a un coffre sur le dais de mousse…: There's a chest on the moss dais… I'm not allowed to touch it. You are!
textes.Il y a un trou dans le mur. Et des caill: There's a hole in the wall. And pebbles everywhere. And a very pleased-with-himself dwarf.
textes.Il y a un trésor enterré quelque part su: There's a treasure buried somewhere on this island. The Stubborn Seagull's pay chest. It was never found. Dig, {surnom}. Dig.
textes.Ils bougent, mon gars. Ils dorment, mais: They're moving, lad. They're asleep, but they're moving. Soon, Mélusine will ring her bell, and they'll all run off at once! The Great Turnip Alert! With my knees, I can't catch a single one anymore. Germaine can, with her net, but she keeps them to annoy Babette. When the bell rings, run to the fields and catch five for me. Just a light touch, no more! They turn golden when you catch them. Gently with my little ones.
textes.Ils n'ont pas fondu. Vous avez marché do: They haven't melted. You walked gently. Good. Hold your palm open. Blow on it, slowly, like on a soup that's too hot. … There. The cold listens to you. Now, the lake. On the islet sleeps the Frost Crystal. Ask the lake to harden beneath your steps, and go and touch it.
textes.Ils rient encore de leur dispute de la d: They're still laughing about their last quarrel.
textes.Ils sont déjà bien bordés. L'un d'eux so: They're already well tucked in. One of them smiles in his sleep.
textes.Ils te reconnaissent ! Amiral te fait un: They recognize you! Admiral winks at you. Well, I think so.
textes.Ils éclatent de rire tous les deux. « Me: They both burst out laughing. “Thanks, referee! Here, for your trouble.”
textes.Immense ? Plus grande que le Grand Moaï: Immense? Bigger than the Great Moai? … BIGGER?! … I don't believe you. Do I? Oh my. Oh my oh my.

textes.Inquiète, oui. Yggdrasil n'a plus donné: Worried, yes. Yggdrasil hasn't given a seed in a hundred years. A bramble has crept into its heart, and all the plants of the tree have turned nasty. Without a seed, no new World Tree… and one day, the islands will wither. We fairies are too small for this fight. You, perhaps… If you accept, the tree will open its door to you. Climb to its crown, and bring us back the seed.
textes.Inquiète. Chaque jour, une branche de pl: Worried. Every day, one more branch turns grey. But you're helping me: I'm starting to hope again.
textes.Inquiète… Chaque matin, je salue Rê qui: Worried… Every morning, I greet Ra being reborn. For moons now, he has risen pale, as if he had slept badly. I think Apophis harasses him at night, deep in the Duat. The Pyramid of Ra, across the river, guards the path of the night; but its door is sealed, and the Sphinx opens only to those who know how to answer. Go and see it. Think before you speak. And if you go down… protect the barque of the sun.
textes.Inscrit au registre, et le thé bu jusqu': Registered in the register, and the tea drunk down to the last sparkle? Then welcome, little star. Welcome for real. Here, also, a little tea for the road, and a few discs. I don't know what they're for, but they say that down below, they're very much appreciated.

Marley grows his bananas in my corner, Mistral set up his sound wall thanks to my rowing boat, and young Gaspard comes to learn about shacks. For a hermit, I get far too many visitors.

textes.J'ai joué. J'ai JOUÉ ! (Il tapote ton ép: I played. I PLAYED! (He taps your shoulder in rhythm, not even noticing.) Rouille asked me if I wanted to come back tomorrow. And the day after. He says it was a cramp. (He laughs.) I'm the drummer of the Bilge Rats. And the “Son” of Lisse & Son. Both. Thank you. Here: my first musician's coins. I don't have many yet. But these, I earned by playing.

The mountain path goes right above it.

I'm taking a nap. Well, I was.
textes.Je fais ma fameuse soupe aux cailloux. L: I'm making my famous pebble soup. My great-great-grandmother's recipe. All I'm missing is… a pebble. Or something that stings.

textes.Je fais une pause. Les androïdes ont dro: I'm taking a break. Androids have the right to breaks, ever since the mayor's law.
I'm taking a break. A little one.
textes.Je garde la forme. Tu veux faire un tour: I'm keeping fit. Want to do a lap with me?
I'm keeping it. I'm keeping everything. Even you.
I'm gardening. Plants are patient. I'm trying to be, too.
textes.Je joue ! Tu veux jouer avec moi ?: I'm playing! Want to play with me?
textes.Je joue aux boules. Tu sais pointer, toi: I'm playing boules. Can you roll one close?

textes.Je l'ai composé moi-même ! Il s'appelle: I composed it myself! It's called “Symphony for a Sneezing Cat.” Want to hear it?
textes.Je l'ai entendue ! Toute l'île l'a enten: I heard it! The whole island heard it! Even Borée looked up! Here, some coins for you. And come levitate with me at sunset: from up high, the sea turns all pink.
textes.Je l'ai entendue quatre cents fois. Elle: I've heard it four hundred times. It's still beautiful.
textes.Je l'ai senti. Toute l'île l'a senti. (L: I felt it. The whole island felt it. (The bridges of light shine, the fountain finally chooses its planet, and way up there, the Spire beats like a happy drum.) For a thousand years the Heart has carried us, and it was a Heavyfoot who healed it. The elders of Ondelune wouldn't believe it. I do. (She stands up, very straight, and places both hands on your shoulders.) In the name of the Council, of Tempo who cried at exactly the right hour, of Écliptique who is preparing a two-hour speech, and of Volt who says it's nothing: you are now the Friend of the Lumens. The first one. Hee hee. Here, some washers, since you all like those, and three cosmic jellies from Gloubi. He cried into them. They're a little salty.
textes.Je l'ai vu ! La couleur est sortie de la: I saw it! The colour came out of the Palette like a drop of ink on blotting paper, and the clearing got back its brown, its grass, its old tree trunks. (She wipes her eyes: they run a little.) Now, the Brush: dip it in the Palette, and it will drink the colour. Then hold it in your hand, and paint what you like, where you like. For the other eight pots, ask the families: Basile is looking for the blue at the Rubbed-Out Pond, Rosalie the green in the Hatching Wood, Capucine the red in the White Meadows, Lili the yellow on the Strand, Gaspard is watching for the purple from the top of the Lookout, and Achille dreams of the orange at the foot of the waterfall. The last two… you'll have to hunt for them. Augustin surely has an idea: he always does.
textes.Je l'ai écrit quelque part… sur un coqui: I wrote it down somewhere… on a shell, I think.
textes.Je la vois ! Elle est toujours là ! Elle: I see it! It's still there! It moves all the time! Doesn't it ever get tired? … Thank you, friend. Thank you.

I knew it! You have good taste.

Here: bread from Mérit, and enough to fill your purse. And the Eye of Horus, keep it well: in the highlands, in the middle of the island, a niche awaits it.
textes.Je le sens jusqu'au bout de mes cornes :: I feel it down to the tips of my horns: it's warm! (The Archduchess laughs, and the whole throne room laughs with her.) Pandémonia owes you her fire, little flame. From today, you're at home here. Here: buns from the Eternal Oven, and enough to fill your purse. And this title, which will be engraved on the great door.
textes.Je les ai bien emmêlés, hein ?: I tangled them up nicely, didn't I?
textes.Je les ai vus ! (Elle a des étoiles dans: I saw them! (She has stars in her eyes. And a bit of green paint.) They're... alive! You've got the touch! The supple wrist, the bold pschhht! The wall says thank you. So do I. Here, a little reward, and know this: on the water tower, there's a spot for your name. I'll write it tonight. In green. Don't argue.
textes.Je lis un peu. Les livres, ça fait voyag: I'm reading a bit. Books let you travel without moving.
I'm reading. Well, I was reading.
textes.Je lui ai montré ma carte des Anciens. E: I showed her my map of the Ancients. She put her finger on the stain I'd taken for coffee and said: “That's my home.” Since then, I've gone over the stain in gold leaf. Well, in mango juice. It's what I had.
textes.Je lui ai rapporté un coquillage de la p: I brought her back a shell from the humans' beach, and told her you could hear the sea in it. She slept with it against her ear for a month. Since then, she asks everyone for one. That's a bit my fault.
textes.Je lui ai taillé un peigne dans une bran: I carved her a comb from a branch of my kapok tree. Fallen, not cut. Free. It's the only free thing I've made in twenty-two years. She wears it in her hair. It pleases me. A little.
textes.Je m'assois un instant. La foudre, ça fa: I'll sit down for a moment. Lightning is tiring.
textes.Je m'entraîne. Le souffle, c'est comme l: I'm training. Breath is like friendship: you have to keep it up.

I mostly fight with my bare hands.

textes.Je ne dors pas. Je surveille la ville av: I'm not sleeping. I'm watching the town with my eyes closed.
textes.Je ne fais que passer. À bientôt !: I'm just passing through. See you soon!

I thought it was a biscuit crumb. I didn't copy it out. Twenty-two years I've been shouting that my map was right. It was. Give or take a crumb.
textes.Je ne le dirai qu'une fois, {surnom}. Le: I'll only say this once, {surnom}. The day after the shipwreck, the sea left a leather case at the foot of my kapok tree. Inside: the helm's map. It's been under my anvil for twenty-two years. I've never unrolled it. If the rock is on it, I'm to blame. If it isn't, he is. I don't know which would hurt me more.
textes.Je ne les compte plus. C'est eux qui me: I don't count them anymore. They're the ones who count me, in the evening.
I can't read maps, I get lost.
textes.Je ne mange pas. Je viens pour l'odeur d: I don't eat. I come for the smell of ginger. It's very highly rated.
I never get tired of this view.

Me, I'm not moving: if I leave, someone will move an amp.

textes.Je suis allé la saluer dans sa clairière: I went to greet her in her clearing, with my boot and Gaston. I bowed very low. Too low: I fell into the ferns. She lifted me up with one hand, like a feather. And Gaston didn't say a word for the whole visit. A first in twenty-two years!
textes.Je suis arrivé ici il y a vingt-deux ans: I arrived here twenty-two years ago, on a raft made of rolled-up sea charts. Excellent buoyancy, terrible reading.
textes.Je suis déjà à tes côtés, compagnon ! To: I'm already at your side, companion! Always! Proudly!
textes.Je suis désolé, une chambre coûte dix pi: I'm sorry, a room costs ten coins. The hotel isn't a charity. Alas.

textes.Je suis le fantôôôme de la maisoooon…: I am the ghooost of the hooouse…
