textes.Le Royaume des Racines. L'air sent la te: The Kingdom of Roots. The air smells of earth and honey; everywhere, roots as thick as tree trunks, and dancing lights…
textes.Le Ruisseau Pointillé — il file vers la: The Dotted Stream — it runs to the sea in little waves traced in ink
textes.Le Sceau d'Airain ! Il se met à tourner: The Bronze Seal! It starts spinning on its own in your hand, its teeth clicking… A mechanism awakens within you: the Cogwheel (key 3, then X; in VR: B). Behind you, a sound of metal: the two statues are moving!
textes.Le Sceau des Sables est chaud dans ta po: The Seal of Sands is warm in your pocket… The Flame (key 2, then X)?
textes.Le Sceau des Vents : une stèle gravée d': The Seal of Winds: a stele engraved with a compass rose, with two empty slots. The great door of the keep doesn't budge. Missing:
textes.Le Scorpion-Roi frappe le sol de sa queu: The Scorpion King slams its tail on the ground: scorpions crawl out of the sand!
textes.Le Sixième Cercle : des rangées de tombe: The Sixth Circle: rows of open tombs, from which flames burst, each in its turn.
textes.Le Sloop : six mètres et demi, une petit: The Sloop: six and a half metres, a little cabin with portholes, a tall mast, a mainsail and a jib on its bowsprit. Steadier, faster (10 m/s under sail), and you can bring your four-legged friends along.
textes.Le Soleil de Pluie de feu. Le plafond es: The Sun of the Rain of Fire. The ceiling is split with embers. At times, the floor glows red… then fire stones fall. Two stone shelters, in the middle.
textes.Le Soleil de l'Eau. Un grand bassin pres: The Sun of Water. A large, nearly empty basin, chinampas stranded at the very bottom, and three bronze wheels on the walls.
textes.Le Soleil des Jaguars : le premier monde: The Sun of the Jaguars: the first world, which the jaguars devoured. Growls between the pillars…
textes.Le Soleil du Vent : des passerelles étro: The Sun of the Wind: narrow walkways above the void, and a wind that rises in gusts. In the bends of the walkways, the wind blows the right way… Shelter and wait; then run.
textes.Le Sphinx gronde, et le sable tremble :: The Sphinx rumbles, and the sand trembles: “No. Go, think, and come back when you know.”
textes.Le Sphinx ne bouge pas. Mais tu jurerais: The Sphinx doesn't move. But you could swear that, for an instant, its stone lips smiled.
textes.Le Styx, un marais de boue tiède. Des da: The Styx, a marsh of lukewarm mud. Basalt slabs form a path… but some of them bubble. At the far end, the red walls of Dité.
textes.Le Séchoir à pâtes — des rideaux de spag: The Pasta Drying Shed — curtains of spaghetti drying in the sun
textes.Le TOUR des maisons ?! Ce n'est pas un m: A TOUR of the houses?! This isn't a museum! OUT!
textes.Le TROISIÈME fragment de l'amulette, gra: The THIRD fragment of the amulet, engraved with a moon! With the other two, the Serpent Gate awaits you, on the village side…
textes.Le Temple englouti. Des siècles de silen: The Sunken Temple. Centuries of silence… and somewhere, water dripping.
textes.Le Temple-Passoire — le soleil passe par: The Colander Temple — the sun shines through all the holes of the colander and rains down little spots of light
textes.Le Titan de Givre vacille… se fige… et v: The Frost Titan wavers… freezes… and bursts into a thousand shards of ice! On the altar at the back, a golden flame lights up in a crystal pillar: the Eternal Flame.
textes.Le Titan frappe la glace de sa massue :: The Titan strikes the ice with his club: the lake trembles!
textes.Le Titan rugit : des spectres de givre s: The Titan roars: frost specters rise from the lake!
textes.Le Titan souffle un vent de givre !: The Titan blows a freezing wind!
textes.Le Vestibule des Quatre Peuples. Quatre: The Vestibule of the Four Peoples. Four stone statues: a sailor, a caravan woman, a shepherd, a fox woman. Above the staircase, a fresco. Before you, a balcony… and below, an immense hall where a red light pulses.
textes.Le Vieux Silas jure que la carte du trés: Old Silas swears that Barbe-Sanglante's treasure map exists, torn into three pieces: one in the dungeon of the Cursed Fort, one in the mausoleum in the graveyard, and the third up the sleeve of Sylvain, the croupier. Philémon Lunette will know how to put it back together.
textes.Le Village des Arbres-Maisons\nLes habit:
The Treehouse Village
The villagers have gone to find their colours. Come on up and see!
textes.Le Village des Arbres-Maisons — des mais: The Treehouse Village — round houses perched in giant oaks, stairs winding around the trunks… but not a single villager
textes.Le Village des Fées ! Des maisons dans d: The Fairy Village! Houses in giant mushrooms, a cascade of light, and little wings glittering everywhere…
textes.Le bambou se remplit d'eau goutte à gout: The bamboo fills with water drop by drop, tips over… CLACK! Then all is calm again. Above the cherry trees, the towers shine, but here you can barely hear the city.
textes.Le bandeau doré entre les yeux ne trompe: The golden band between the eyes gives it away. Restores one and a half hearts.
textes.Le beffroi. Quatre cloches de bronze pen: The belfry. Four bronze bells hang beneath the spire, each marked with a sign: the Wave, the Sun, the Moon, the Wind. They wait to be rung… in the right order.
textes.Le bleu ! Et il n'a même pas pris l'eau: The blue! And it didn't even get wet! (He turns the pot every which way and sniffs it.) It smells like the sky. Quick, go pour it into the Palette: paint cup number one, the very first. I want to see the pond turn blue from here. Here, for your trouble: two apples from my apple tree. They're still white, but they taste very good.
textes.Le bleu de l'Étang Gommé: The blue of the Rubbed-Out Pond
textes.Le bleu. Là-bas, tu vois ? Sur le grand: The blue. Over there, see? On the big water lily, in the middle. Pot number one, the island's blue. It floated out there the day after the Downpour, and it hasn't budged since. Me, I swim like a pebble. A painted pebble, but a pebble. Would you fetch it for me? With the blue, the pond will find its sky again, and the stream its water. And I'll get my trade back.
textes.Le bloc ne bouge plus : le mur, ou l'aut: The block won't budge: the wall, or the other block, is holding it.
textes.Le blé est bien haut cette année. Nonno: The wheat is really tall this year. Nonno says it's thanks to the volcano.
textes.Le bois, c'est surtout utile pour se cha: Wood is mostly good for keeping warm.
textes.Le bol fumant du robot des nouilles du M: The steaming bowl from the noodle robot at the Night Market: noodles, a golden broth, an egg, vegetables, and a smiley face drawn in sauce. Restores two and a half hearts.
textes.Le bras du robot plonge dans la marmite,: The robot's arm dives into the pot, stirs, drains, pours… “A NEO-RAMEN! CAREFUL, IT'S HOT!” It even takes a little bow.
textes.Le brasero de l'est flambe : le soleil s: The east brazier blazes: the sun rises.
textes.Le brasero de l'ouest flambe : le soleil: The west brazier blazes: the sun sets.
textes.Le brasero du nord s'allume : le soleil: The north brazier lights: the sun sleeps. All four flames roar together… and the great slab at the back slides upward.
textes.Le brasero du sud flambe : le soleil brû: The south brazier blazes: the sun burns at noon.
textes.Le bâton des sorciers d'Arcanelle, remis: The staff of the wizards of Arcanelle, presented at the Circle of Moonstones: wood from the Twisted Wood and a purple crystal. In hand, each spell costs one less point of magic. Damage: 6.
textes.Le bénitier géant s'entrouvre lentement…: The giant clam slowly opens a crack… In the hollow of its blue mantle shines the Pearl of the Garden, the age of life.
textes.Le cacao, c'est la boisson des dieux !: Cacao is the drink of the gods!
textes.Le cadeau de Lyra : son aiguille de cris: Lyra's gift: its crystal needle points towards the Mother Tree, to the east. With it, the boat can cross the mist of Bois-Doré.
textes.Le café du Café de la Bielle, passé sous: Coffee from the Crankshaft Café, pressure-brewed in a copper boiler. It would wake the dead, and it restores one heart.
textes.Le capitaine est toujours à l'heure. Enf: The captain is always on time. Well, almost.
textes.Le carrefour. Quatre chemins partent ver: The crossroads. Four paths lead south: a red one, a black one, a white one, a yellow one. Which one leads to the Lords?
textes.Le cercle de lumière te dépose dans la c: The circle of light sets you down in the fairy glade. Queen Oriane is waiting for you: the seed of Yggdrasil glows at the bottom of your bag.
textes.Le cerf-volant de Théo s'est envolé vers: Théo's kite has flown off towards the western hills.
textes.Le chant du berger, peint à la chaux sur: The shepherd's song, whitewashed on a board: “Three sheep on the ridge, in the morning sun; one in the valley, sulking in the thyme; two in the sheepfold, asleep by the fire. Count them in order, and the wind will open for you.”
textes.Le chantier naval de Port-Azur : ça sent: The Port-Azur shipyard: it smells of sawdust and tar. On the slipway, a schooner is taking shape, rib after rib…
The cat is looking at me. I'm looking away. It started it.
textes.Le chat ouvre un œil, te juge, et se ren: The cat opens one eye, judges you, and goes back to sleep. You're accepted.
textes.Le chat ronronne. Puis il te mord gentim: The cat purrs. Then it bites you gently, just for show. Then it purrs again.
textes.Le chef gobelin agite sa bannière en hur: The goblin chief waves his banner, yelling: “To me, gang!” Two goblins burst out of the bushes!
textes.Le chef gobelin baisse sa hampe… et char: The goblin chief lowers his pole… and charges, bellowing!
textes.Le chef-d'œuvre d'Octave : acier trempé,: Octave's masterpiece: tempered steel, brass guard. Damage: 6, and the third hit of a combo strikes half again as hard. Ready for the battles to come.
textes.Le chemin de Xibalba… on peut y descendr: The road to Xibalba… can we go down there?
textes.Le chemin tourne, tourne… et te ramène a: The path turns, and turns… and brings you back to the crossroads. Somewhere, dry laughter echoes. That wasn't the right path.
textes.Le chocolat chaud du Café Feedback, avec: Hot chocolate from the Feedback Café, with a cloud of cream. It warms your hands, your tummy and your heart. Restores one and a half hearts.
textes.Le cidre doux du verger de Père Gaubert,: Père Gaubert's sweet sparkling apple drink from his orchard, alcohol-free and fizzy, served nice and cold at "La Grenouille Repue". The bubbles tickle your nose. Restores one heart.
textes.Le ciel s'allume : des rideaux de lumièr: The sky lights up: curtains of green, pink and blue light ripple above Astralys. The Night of the Auroras begins!
textes.Le ciel s'assombrit d'un coup. Un éclair: The sky suddenly darkens. A bolt of lightning strikes the centre of the platform… An immense suit of armour steps out of it: LORD STORM, THE KNIGHT OF STORMS!
textes.Le cinquième soleil brille au-dessus du: The fifth sun shines above the fire… but it doesn't move. The gods had the same trouble: a motionless sun burns everything. It would need a great breath, that of Ehécatl, the wind.
textes.Le cinquième étage de l'Usine Grise: The fifth floor of the Grey Factory
textes.Le cinquième étage des Mille Marches: The fifth floor of the Thousand Steps
textes.Le codex des soleils, sur une peau de ce: The codex of the suns, painted on deerskin: in the middle, our sun, the fifth. Around it, the four suns before, each with its number in red dots, and arrows turning: 1, 2, 3, 4… then 5, at the centre.
textes.Le coffre bâille. Très grand. Avec une l: The chest yawns. Very wide. With a tongue. It wasn't a chest!
textes.Le coffre de la Mouette ! Tu l'as trouvé: The Seagull's chest! You found it right where I said? MY MAP WAS RIGHT! Gaston, write down the date!
textes.Le coffre de la chandelle s'ouvre… sur u: The candle's chest opens… to an old boot, and a note: “Missed! But at least this one doesn't bite.”
textes.Le coffre des livres est honnête, et pau: The books' chest is honest, and poor: a few coins, a vial of sap, and a bookmark.
textes.Le coffre du capitaine grince… Entre les: The captain's chest creaks… Among the moldy coins gleams the Pearl of the Wreck, the age of men.
textes.Le coffre du hibou ne mord pas : il grin: The owl's chest doesn't bite: it only creaks. Inside, on a velvet cushion, a silver key engraved with little owls.
textes.Le coffret qui est monté du sol contient: The casket that rose from the floor holds a piece of Osiris!
textes.Le copal crépite sur les braises, et une: The copal crackles on the embers, and a white, fragrant smoke rises toward the sun. Huitzilopochtli is pleased.
textes.Le corail ! Le miel ! La noix de coco !: The coral! The honey! The coconut! I'll grind, mix, and… look at that red! Here, it's all I have, but I'm also giving you my eternal admiration.
textes.Le couloir des lames : quatre grandes la: The corridor of blades: four great blades swinging from wall to wall, some flagstones darker than the others… and sand at the end. Watch closely, and go at the right moment.
textes.Le crabe amoureux. Je l'ai inventé ce ma: The Crab in Love. I invented it this morning.
textes.Le cristal a brillé. Je l'ai vu d'ici. I: The crystal shone. I saw it from here. It doesn't shine for everyone. Here. Some coins. And when you feel hot, in summer, think of the lake. It will think of you.
textes.Le cristal bleu s'illumine, et le hall s: The blue crystal lights up, and the hall dissolves with a chime… You're back in the sun, in front of the ruined tower. (Odon, without looking up: “Floor 1. Noted.”)
textes.Le cristal est glacé. Il ne se passe rie: The crystal is icy. Nothing happens… for now.
textes.Le cœur de bois est tiède. La lumière l': The wooden heart is warm. The light reaches it, but too weakly: it must first pass through the three mirror-flowers.
textes.Le cœur du Roi Gélatineux : une grosse g: The heart of the Jelly King: a big green jelly that glows softly, with a tiny gold crown stuck on top. It still beats a little, like a happy pudding. Master Hugues has dreamed of it for twenty years.
textes.Le dernier bouquet retombe en pluie d'or: The last bouquet falls back in a golden rain. The whole meadow applauds. Clapotis shouts: “I SAW SOME! REAL ONES!” And Bouton-d'Or places a crown of daisies on his head.
textes.Le dernier coup d'un enchaînement frappe: The last blow of a combo hits twice as hard, and every blow has a one-in-eight chance to be critical.
textes.Le dernier couplet ! Il n'existe pas enc: The last verse! It doesn't exist yet: first you need a King. The Brawl King is the one who puts the three champions of the harbor on the mat. Gros-Louis, of the Requin Borgne. Le Muet, of the Veuve Écarlate. Belle-Humeur, of the Morue Enragée. With fists, no blades: otherwise it doesn't count. A fair duel, or a good brawl, as you like. And after that… I sing!
textes.Le dernier cristal s'illumine ! Très loi: The last crystal lights up! Far away, in the Rose of Seals, a long rumble… The circle of light beside the dais will take you there.
textes.Le dernier jaguar tombe. Dans le silence: The last jaguar falls. In the silence, the jaguar head on the altar opens its mouth: a small casket has appeared in it.
textes.Le deuxième verre est fort comme l'amour: The second glass is strong as love… Here.
textes.Le diamant se pose, ça crépite… « Flaque: The needle drops, it crackles… “Puddles in Minor,” by the Gutters. A guitar creaking softly, a voice whispering. Outside, the rain keeps the beat.
textes.Le dire au capitaine Charbonnel (à la ca: Tell Captain Charbonnel (at the port's harbour master's office)
textes.Le dire au capitaine Pyrus (à la porte d: Tell Captain Pyrus (at the palace gate, or at the barracks)
textes.Le dire à Crochet (sur le quai le matin,: Tell Crochet (on the quay in the morning, at the forge in the afternoon, at the Shark's Tooth in the evening)
textes.Le dire à Cuauhtli, le grand prêtre (au: Tell Cuauhtli, the high priest (at the foot of the Great Temple)
textes.Le dire à Ix Kanul, la grande prêtresse: Tell Ix Kanul, the high priestess (at the temple, or at the Cenote in the morning)
textes.Le dire à Madame Hurla (au guichet de l': Tell Madame Hurla (at the arena ticket booth, or on the square)
textes.Le dire à Mixtli, le guerrier-jaguar (su: Tell Mixtli, the jaguar warrior (on the square of Aztlán)
textes.Le dire à Néferet, la prêtresse de Rê (a: Tell Néferet, the priestess of Ra (at the temple of Per-Hâpy)
textes.Le dire à Pigment (au Mur d'Expression l: Tell Pigment (at the Expression Wall in the morning, near the water tower or the skatepark in the afternoon, at the print shop in the evening)
textes.Le dire à Tom le Violoneux (au Crâne Fen: Tell Tom the Fiddler (at the Crâne Fendu, in the evening)
textes.Le dire à Yvon (sur son ponton de pêche,: Tell Yvon (on his fishing jetty, by the lake)
textes.Le dire à Zébuline (à son étal d'épices: Tell Zébuline (at her spice stall in the Great Market)
textes.Le dire à l'Archiduchesse Ignatia (au pa: Tell Archduchess Ignatia (at the palace, on the Citadel)
textes.Le disque des deux villages: The disc of the two villages
textes.Le disque tourne, le diamant crépite…: The record spins, the needle crackles…
textes.Le distributeur affiche : « Merci ! Bonn: The machine displays: “Thank you! Have a nice evening, human!” Clonk! A Synth-Soda.
textes.Le distributeur hésite, réfléchit, puis: The machine hesitates, thinks, then: clonk! “On the house.” It's nice, this machine.
textes.Le dragon… il a mangé mes chaussettes…: The dragon… he ate my socks…
textes.Le drap tombe : c'est un enfant du quart: The sheet falls: it's a kid from the neighborhood, delighted. “Really? Great! Here, my treasure, for your courage!”
textes.Le fanzine de Port-Boucan, imprimé par A: Port-Boucan's fanzine, printed by Agrafe at the Spinning Mill print shop: drawings by Pigment, Lentille's soup recipe, gossip from Radio Boucan, and a whole page about this week's stand-in drummer.
textes.Le feu ! Enfin quelqu'un qui demande le: Fire! At last, someone who asks for fire and not light! Fine. Rule number one: fire must be fed. Go and fetch me three logs of twisted wood from the Twisted Wood, to the southwest. Twisted wood burns long and without smoke. Bring them back, and I'll teach you.
textes.Le feu de Teotihuacan, où les dieux atte: The fire of Teotihuacan, where the gods waited for one of their own to throw himself in and become the sun. On one altar, the rich offerings of Tecciztécatl; on the other, the humble offerings of Nanahuatzin. What will you throw into the fire?
textes.Le flacon brun du Doc Saignée : rhum, mi: Doc Saignée's brown flask: molasses, honey, feverweed and a secret. One sip, and you get back up from almost any brawl. Restores four hearts.
textes.Le fleuve de la nuit se met à bouillonne: The river of night begins to boil. An enormous head rises from the black water, eyes red as embers: APOPHIS, the serpent of chaos, who wants to swallow the sun!
textes.Le flotteur est à l'eau. Patience…: The float is in the water. Patience…
textes.Le fond du puits. Au nord, une caverne s: The bottom of the well. To the north, a cavern opens onto still, black water. (The chain lets you climb back up in one go.)
textes.Le four de terre ! On creuse, on chauffe: The earth oven! We dig, we heat the stones, we bury, we wait, we dig it up. It's ready in three hours. Or three hundred years. I never remember.
textes.Le fromage des chèvres des cendres de Hi: Cheese from Hilda's ash goats. It smells strong. Restores two hearts.
textes.Le gel. Hm. Il faut de la patience. Vous: Frost. Hm. It takes patience. Do you have any? We'll see. On the northern cliffs, where the wind never stops, fall flakes that never melt: the eternal frost. Bring me three. Without running. Frost doesn't like it when you run.
textes.Le gobelet en plastique dit : « Un seul: The plastic cup says: “One glass per visit. Hydration is a cost.”
textes.Le gobelin lâche un cri aigu… et détale: The goblin lets out a shrill cry… and scurries off squealing! How brave.
textes.Le godet est planté dans le sol ! Les du: The bucket is stuck in the ground! The hoses are exposed: STRIKE THEM!
textes.Le godet se lève… Un cercle rouge au sol: The bucket rises… A red circle on the ground: get out of it!
textes.Le gong ne veut rien dire tant qu'on n'e: The gong means nothing until you're signed up. Madame Hurla runs the arena's ticket window: she registers the contestants (and she shouts very loudly).
textes.Le grand air, enfin… s'il sentait autre: The open air, at last… if only it smelled of something other than sulphur.
textes.Le grand serpent s'est réveillé ? Alors: The great serpent has woken up? Then you'll need a good blade and lots of coconuts. I'll give you a discount. No, I'm joking, I never give discounts.
The big shipyard register is open. Yannick wrote in it: “Orders to be noted here, payment in the box, I build at night (and I sing).”
textes.Le hall du Donjon des Mille Marches: The hall of the Dungeon of a Thousand Steps
textes.Le hamac du fond, à bâbord. Le Léviathan: The hammock at the back, on the port side. The Léviathan will rock you to sleep. Good night!
textes.Le hamac du fond, à côté des tonneaux. S: The hammock at the back, next to the barrels. If Tonneau snores, give him a thump, he's used to it.
textes.Le hibou, parce que sa femme est chouett: The owl, because his wife is a hoot!
textes.Le jaune ! Le bleu, on dirait la mer un: The yellow one! The blue one looks like the sea on a rainy day!
textes.Le jaune de la Grève Blanche: The yellow of the White Strand
textes.Le jeu de balle des Seigneurs. Une allée: The Lords' ball court. An alley, two slopes, two stone rings high up on the walls. The rubber ball, in the middle. “Play against us, traveller. Three times through the ring, and you pass.”
textes.Le journal du dernier capitaine du Lévia: The journal of the last captain of the Léviathan, bound in leather that still smells of salt. Whole pages are blank… Moon ink, Ba Sidi used to say: it can only be read by the light of a moon you carry with you.
textes.Le jury ? Oh ! Écoutez… (Le piano joue u: The jury? Oh! Listen… (The piano plays a waltz. The keys press themselves down. At the end, the piano takes a bow.) It plays better in the morning. It's a bit under the weather in the evening.
The jury sent me to see your automaton.
The jury sent me to see your machine.
The jury sent me to see your piano.
textes.Le maire ? Hm. Il envoie tout le monde m: The mayor? Hm. He sends everyone to say hello to me. Fine. Hello. The port is yours, don't get up to any mischief.
textes.Le maire fera citoyen d'honneur celui qu: The mayor will make whoever helps out the whole town an honorary citizen.
The mayor sent me to say hello.
textes.Le maire veut que je fasse connaissance: The mayor wants me to get to know the town: the harbour master's office, the hotel and the tavern.
textes.Le masque des Rois-Ciel : tu respires so: The Sky Kings' mask: you can breathe underwater! Explore the depths… southwest of the village, a light shines at the bottom.
textes.Le masque des Rois-Ciel, trouvé dans le: The mask of the Sky Kings, found in Lord Storm's treasure: crystal lenses rimmed with brass. As long as it's in your bag, you can breathe underwater. The Sky Kings used it to visit… a sunken city?
textes.Le matin après le rocher, j'étais assis: The morning after the rock, I was sitting on the sand, soaked, my hammer on my knees. A raft of rolled-up maps drifted past offshore, Barnabé on top, shouting: “The map was right!” I shouted: “Row!” Those were the last kind words we said to each other.
textes.Le matin, j'ai toujours plein d'idées. L: In the morning I'm full of ideas. By the afternoon, I've forgotten them.
textes.Le matin, je suis un scarabée qui pousse: In the morning, I am a scarab pushing a ball of fire. At noon, a falcon shining above the world. In the evening, an old man with a ram's head who descends into the night. Who am I?
textes.Le matin, l'air sent bon. C'est le meill: The air smells lovely in the morning. It's the best time for thinking.
textes.Le maître est redevenu normal ! Enfin… i: The master is back to normal! Well… he still feels like eating flies sometimes. Thanks again!
textes.Le maître sorcier, redevenu humain, rega: The master wizard, human again, looks sternly at his apprentice. His skin is still a little green.
textes.Le milieu ! Regarde : tout autour, j'ai: The middle! Look: all around, I've drawn the coasts, the moors, the marshes, the dunes… and in the centre, a big blank. Stoneheart. At the foot of its west face there's a door, the Door of the Four Seals. I've never dared go up there alone: they say the mountain breathes. You, you don't look afraid. Go and see it, examine it closely, and come back and tell me.
textes.Le moment ? LE moment ? (Elle pose sa ta: The time? THE time? (She puts down her cup.) One, two… (She looks at the stage, the canvas, you.) … THREE. (She puts her finger on the middle button, the one with no name, and pushes it all the way up. The speakers switch on with a great gust, all over the meadow.) Ten years I've been waiting. Tonight, at eight thirty, we play. Both villages. Come, and stand at the front: I want to see someone dancing in the first row.
textes.Le monte-charge grince, cliquette et mon: The freight lift creaks, rattles and climbs… and climbs… (with a little elevator tune, very optimised)… then opens in the Grey Factory courtyard, in broad daylight. The Lisse-Center plans are in your bag. Port-Boucan is going to party!
textes.Le moteur s'essouffle… et s'arrête. Les: The engine wheezes… and stops. The platforms come to a halt.
textes.Le moteur à cristal des Lumens : silenci: The Lumens' crystal engine: silent as a dreaming fish, it leaves a trail of light behind it. Seventy percent faster than sail alone!
textes.Le moteur à cristal se monte à la place: The crystal engine goes in where the steam engine was. Steam first, stars after!
textes.Le moteur à vapeur, d'après les plans de: The steam engine, from Cliquetis's plans: a boiler, a smoking chimney, a propeller that churns the water. Thirty percent faster. Choo-choo… er, sorry: toot-toot!
textes.Le musée secret du canard en caoutchouc: The secret rubber duck museum! One hundred forty-four ducks, arranged by size. And a sign: “DO NOT SQUEAK THEM.”
textes.Le même prix que la semaine dernière, l': Same price as last week, my friend.
textes.Le nectar doré de Mélisse, cueilli au cœ: Mélisse's golden nectar, gathered from the heart of the giant flowers. Restores four hearts.
textes.Le noyau encore chaud d'un élémentaire d: The still-warm core of a magma elemental. Grimli the miner uses them to light his tunnels.
textes.Le pain ! (Elle soupire de soulagement.): The bread! (She sighs with relief.) The Baron had already taken out his mourning hat. I'll take it to him right away. Thank you. You've saved the castle's morning. That's no small thing: it's often in danger.
textes.Le pain de Trèfle, la boulangère de Ramu: Bread from Trèfle, the baker of Ramure: soft, golden, made with carrots from the rabbits' vegetable garden. Restores two hearts.
textes.Le pain doré de Sylwen, la boulangère du: The golden bread of Sylwen, the baker of Bois-Doré. It smells of honey and sunshine. Restores two hearts.
textes.Le pain, on le range dans le tiroir ou d: Do we keep bread in the drawer or in the bread box?
textes.Le panier de livraison de Margaux, rempl: Margaux's delivery basket, full of baguettes and croissants. No helping yourself.
textes.Le panier remonte en grinçant… Au fond,: The basket creaks up… At the bottom, a small, dented paint pot with a label: “5”. + Pot of brown (no. 5). To be poured into its well in the Stone Palette!
textes.Le papillon s'envole. Brioche le regarde: The butterfly flutters away. Brioche watches it go, very dignified: “I was letting it go.”
textes.Le papyrus de Thot, le dieu à tête d'ibi: The papyrus of Thoth, the ibis-headed god, scribe of the gods. Thoth points to a cartouche — the king's name, written from top to bottom: three signs, one beneath the other. Look at them carefully.
textes.Le parvis du Temple-Passoire — une fourc: The forecourt of the Colander Temple — a giant fork and spoon, a sauce fountain… and, up there, the Great Flying Spaghetti
textes.Le passage est libre ! La galerie sous l: The way is clear! The gallery under the sea now links the two islands.
textes.Le perroquet a vendu la mèche… Le trésor: The parrot spilled the beans… The captain's treasure is hidden somewhere around here!
textes.Le petit Gaspard construit des cabanes c: Young Gaspard builds huts the way Barnabé draws maps: with heart, and crooked. But he listens. That's rare.
textes.Le petit démon court vers toi : « C'est: The little demon runs toward you: “It's my friend the human!”
The foot of the Mother Oak.
textes.Le pinceau des doyens du Village des Arb: The brush of the elders of the Treehouse Village, entrusted to you by Grandma Aquarelle. It only paints with the colours of the Stone Palette: dip it in the Palette (20 strokes), then, in hand, E (trigger in VR) to put a dab of colour in front of you, on Sketched Island.
textes.Le pinceau est sec. Trempe-le dans la Pa: The brush is dry. Dip it in the Stone Palette, in the middle of the clearing (a colour must have come back to it).
textes.Le poisson rouge fait des tours. Il a l': The goldfish does tricks. It looks like it's thinking. About what? A mystery.
textes.Le poisson rouge te regarde. Glouglou. T: The goldfish looks at you. Blub blub. You feel like it's judging you.
The fish came off the hook.
textes.Le port, c'est mon royaume. Les poubelle: The harbour is my kingdom. The bins are my pantry.
textes.Le prochain monorail arrive dans… mainte: The next monorail arrives in… now. No. Now.
textes.Le professeur Boum a encore perdu le toi: Professor Boum has lost the roof of his workshop again. For the fifteenth one, he needs iron ore.
textes.Le professeur Moreau rêve de la cité eng: Professor Moreau dreams of the sunken city. Someone needs to find it, rekindle its crystal, and tell him all about it.
textes.Le public te lance des pièces (et un coq: The audience throws coins at you (and a seashell).
The quetzal one is the most precious.
textes.Le ragoût de Mama Grog : poisson, banane: Mama Grog's stew: fish, plantains, red beans, chilli and a ladle of molasses. Nobody asks what else is in it. Restores three hearts.
textes.Le rat ? Ce voleur ? Ce brigand à mousta: The rat? That thief? That whiskered bandit? (He bangs his ladle on the table.) Three cheeses! My three finest aged cheeses, the ones that smell so strong even the seagulls faint! Gone! I saw him dash off into the port with a piece bigger than he is. He's hidden them somewhere, the wretch! (He grumbles.) … Well. If you take him far from my kitchen, I'll say no more. Find my cheeses: wherever he hid them, he'll come back. Put them near the hold, and he'll come out. That rat would do anything for cheese. So would I, come to think of it. Maybe that's why we don't get along.
textes.Le rat du Requin Borgne: The rat of the Requin Borgne
textes.Le rayon de soleil frappe la Fleur-Porte: The sunbeam strikes the Door Flower! Its petals quiver… and slowly open, like on the first morning of the world.
textes.Le rayon te repose, tout doucement, sur: The beam sets you back down, very softly, on the buoy. Your rowboat is waiting, a little surprised.
textes.Le rayon te soulève, doucement, comme un: The beam lifts you, gently, like a soap bubble… 380 metres higher up, the Lumens wave hello.
textes.Le requin s'enfuit dans les profondeurs…: The shark flees into the depths… It lost a shark tooth (picked up).
textes.Le reste, c'est un secret. Je ne le conf: The rest is a secret. I only share it with a friend. A true one, {surnom}.
textes.Le rhum brun du Crâne Fendu, vieilli dan: The brown tonic of Le Crâne Fendu, aged in barrels from a sunken ship. It smells of wood, molasses and a little of gunpowder. Restores one heart.
textes.Le rhum noir de La Murène Ivre. Les pira: The dark tonic of La Murène Ivre. Pirates say it warms the heart; Anouk would say otherwise. Restores one heart.
textes.Le rocher était MAL PLACÉ !: The rock was in the WRONG PLACE!
textes.Le roi m'a envoyé dessiner les mers du s: The king sent me to chart the southern seas, my grandfather's seas, aboard the Stubborn Seagull. Octave was the ship's carpenter: we played cards every evening, he cheated, I measured his beard. Then one moonless night, the rock. I woke up on a raft of rolled-up maps, one boot short, and a parrot said “Shipwreck” to me from the top of a tree. Great barnacles, what a night.
textes.Le rouge ! (Elle le tient à bout de bras: The red! (She holds it at arm's length, in the sun.) My poppies will be able to blush again. With joy, this time. Hurry and pour it in: paint cup number three. And here: a bunch of sunflowers. They're white for now, but they won't stay that way for long.
textes.Le royaume des fées ! Une prairie en fle: The fairy kingdom! A flowering meadow floats above a sea of golden clouds. Fireflies dance in broad daylight… and to the north stands an immense tree, so tall its crown touches the sky: Yggdrasil, the World Tree. Fairies are waiting for you in the glade, to the south.
textes.Le sable t'avale… Tu te débats, et tu re: The sand swallows you… You struggle free and come out, out of breath, at the entrance of the hall.
textes.Le sanctuaire bleu de Tlaloc, le dieu de: Tlaloc's blue shrine, the god of rain, with round eyes and fangs. In front, a chacmool holds an empty bowl on its belly. Tlaloc is thirsty… for a jar of rainwater, no doubt. Coyotl, the potter, makes lovely blue jars.
textes.Le sanctuaire rouge de Huitzilopochtli,: Huitzilopochtli's red shrine, the warrior hummingbird, the sun that fights every night to return. In front, an unlit brazier. You burn copal in it, the white incense; Tochtli sells some at the market.
textes.Le sceau roule sur le côté. Un escalier: The seal rolls aside. A staircase plunges into the dark, around a bottomless well…
textes.Le secret de la forme ? Cent pompes le m: The secret to fitness? A hundred push-ups in the morning, a hundred in the evening, and a pie at noon. Want to join in?
textes.Le secret de la pêche ? Garder la ligne: The secret of fishing? Keep the line taut, but not too taut. Like a conversation with Gaston.
textes.Le silence. Au milieu de la pièce, quelq: Silence. In the middle of the room, someone with a very pale face makes big gestures… without a sound.
textes.Le soir (à partir de 21 h), retrouver Gé: In the evening (from 9 p.m.), meet Gédéon at the entrance to the Howling Hall and walk him to the drum kit: let him play his first concert with the Bilge Rats
textes.Le soir où je suis partie veiller l'Arbr: The evening I left to watch over the Tree, he gave me his old blanket and a single piece of advice: “Talk to the humans. They live shorter lives than we do, but they go further.” The blanket smelled of moss and old books. I still sleep under it.
textes.Le soir tombe. C'est l'heure où les gens: Evening is falling. It's when people get together.
textes.Le soir, sous la treille, avec les lampi: In the evening, under the trellis, with the lanterns… It's my favourite moment.
textes.Le sol fait « blop ». Une gelée verte gr: The floor goes “blop”. A green jelly as big as a house rises before the throne, a tiny crown perched crookedly: THE JELLY KING! “Who dares walk on my clean tiles?” he gurgles.
textes.Le sol tremble ! La Marmite bouillonne d: The ground trembles! The Cooking Pot bubbles harder and harder… An eruption is coming!
textes.Le sol tremble. L'eau noire des douves b: The ground shakes. The black water of the moat bubbles, and a gigantic crocodile rises from it, covered in spines, with jaws at every joint: CIPACTLI, the Earth monster, from whom the gods made the world!
textes.Le sol tremble. Quelque part dehors, un: The ground shakes. Somewhere outside, a bird falls off its branch, offended.
textes.Le soleil s'est levé… mais il ne bouge p: The sun has risen… but it doesn't move. It burns, motionless, above the fire. The gods, long ago, had the same trouble.
textes.Le soleil se lève. Une journée toute neu: The sun's rising. A brand-new day, not a scratch on it yet.
textes.Le soleil, là-bas. Il est pour moi. Pous: The sun, over there. It's mine. Move over.
textes.Le sommet du Mont Fusain — toute l'île,: The summit of Mount Charcoal — the whole island, in black and white, like a drawing laid on the blue sea
textes.Le souterrain du Grand Moaï (yeux rendus: The underground of the Great Moai (eyes restored, going down)
textes.Le souterrain du Grand Moaï — un escalie: The underground of the Great Moai — a staircase that winds down into the dark… and, at the very bottom, something singing
textes.Le style. C'est ce que disait Barnabé de: The style. That's what Barnabé said about his map.
textes.Le tableau est couvert d'affiches : slim: The board is covered in posters: slimes, frogs, goblins, a feathered hat… A sign: “Contracts reserved for registered adventurers. See Églantine at the counter. (She doesn't bite.)”
textes.Le tajine de Lalla Zohra : dorade, olive: Lalla Zohra's tagine: sea bream, olives, preserved lemon and saffron, cooked for three hours over the embers. Restores four hearts.
textes.Le tambour bat toujours, quelque part…: The drum is still beating, somewhere…
textes.Le tapis des étoiles ? Il n'est pas à ve: The carpet of the stars? It's not for sale. Fine. For you, I'll show it. Look: the city gate, down here. Then three stars, one after the other, walking northeast, toward the dunes. Those are the old caravan markers: at night they still light up all by themselves, who knows why. After the third, the crescent dune: the walking dune. And beneath the dune, a sun. On the border, three signs, always in the same order: the star, the dune, the sun. My grandmother used to say: “that's the key.” Me, I say: it's pretty.
textes.Le temps ? Vingt-deux ans que j'attends: Time? Twenty-two years I've been waiting for it to wipe things out, and nothing. It must be on strike. Or it's waiting to get paid too.
Time wipes everything out in the end.
textes.Le terminal clignote : « > REMONTER ? [O: The terminal blinks: “> GO BACK UP? [Y]”. You type “Y”. Beep! The glass doors open… and there you are again in broad daylight, in front of the Grey Factory gate.
textes.Le thé de bienvenue ! Assieds-toi ! (Ses: The welcome tea! Sit down! (His four arms flutter: a teapot, a cup, a saucer, a teaspoon, all at once.) Stellar tea, served midnight blue, with gold sparkles. Drink slowly: it tastes of mint, of rain, and of something else nobody can quite name. So? You can't find the name either? Welcome to our home!
Tea is not to be rushed.
textes.Le tic-tac de vingt horloges remplit la: The ticking of twenty clocks fills the room. It sounds like a very steady rain.
textes.Le tombeau de la Dune qui Marche. L'air: The tomb of the Walking Dune. The air is dry, still. Sandstone columns, sarcophagi, and at the very back, on a dais, in a ray of light fallen from who knows where… a golden disc.
textes.Le tour de la ville en monorail: A monorail tour of the city
textes.Le trident des rois de l'Atlantide, offe: The trident of the kings of Atlantis, a gift from Queen Néréa. Gold, mother-of-pearl and a glowing sea stone. Damage: 14, and the third hit of a combo strikes half again as hard. Underwater, it strikes from afar.
textes.Le trophée du Tournoi des Cornes : une c: The trophy of the Tournament of Horns: a ram's horn of solid gold, engraved with the names of all the champions. Yours is at the very bottom, in letters that still shine.
textes.Le trésor de Barbe-Sanglante… raconte-mo: Barbe-Sanglante's treasure… tell me about it.
textes.Le trésor des Rois-Ciel ! Deux cents piè: The treasure of the Sky Kings! Two hundred coins, three gold coins, two rubies, the Crown of the Clouds, the Sword of the Clouds whose blade crackles with lightning… and a strange diving mask with crystal lenses. With it, you can breathe underwater! Far below, beneath the sea, south-west of the village, a light shines…
textes.Le trésor du Cœur du Chant !: The treasure of the Heart of the Song!
textes.Le vent a dispersé les trois pages de la: The wind has scattered the three pages of Django's most beautiful song across the quay, the square and the beach.
textes.Le vent dans les cheveux, c'est le bonhe: Wind in your hair, pure happiness!
textes.Le vent tourbillonne trop fort au-dessus: The wind swirls too fiercely above the Citadel: Ventaile will wait for you at the Wind Perch. Whistle for her from the esplanade.
The wind swirls far too hard above the Citadel. Go to the Wind Field.
textes.Le vent tourne, moussaillon. Le vent tou: The wind is turning, cabin boy. The wind is always turning.
textes.Le vent… il a emporté ma partition. Troi: The wind… it carried off my score. Three pages. One went off to the beach, one to the square, one to the east end of the quay. Without them, I can't play “The Azure Waltz” any more. If you find them…
textes.Le vert ! Et le hibou ? Il n'a rien dit: The green! And the owl? He didn't say anything? He never says anything, that's what's scary. (She hugs the pot to her chest.) Thank you, thank you. Hurry and pour it into paint cup number two. I want to see my leaves wake up. Here: a packet of my seeds. Plant them wherever you like, they even grow in black and white.
textes.Le vert du Bois des Hachures: The green of the Hatching Wood
textes.Le vert. Le pot numéro deux. Sans lui, m: The green. Pot number two. Without it, my plants no longer know they're plants. I think it rolled all the way to the Hollow Stump, deep in the woods, to the west. But a big owl lives there. It looks at me sideways, with eyes as round as coins. It doesn't know you: it won't have time to look at you sideways.
textes.Le vestibule de la Pyramide de Rê. L'air: The vestibule of the Pyramid of Ra. The air is cool and still, and smells of stone and incense. On the walls, thousands of painted signs; on the left, the sun's barque sailing through the night.
textes.Le vieil appareil photo de Gérard Dupuis: Gérard Dupuis's old camera. Three hundred photos of sunsets inside.
textes.Le village ! Je vois parfois vos lantern: The village! Sometimes I see your lanterns at night. It keeps me company.
textes.Le virus est parti ! Glitch t'attend (pr: The virus is gone! Glitch is waiting for you (near the Arcade Station, or in the arcade hall in the afternoon).
textes.Le voisin du village ! Dis-moi, ils mang: The neighbour from the village! Tell me, do they still eat their soup cold over there?
textes.Lentille agite sa louche géante : « Tu a: Lentille waves her giant ladle: “You've already had your bowl today! Come back tomorrow, there'll be another soup. Well, the same one, with different vegetables.”
textes.Lentille remplit un bocal de soupe fuman: Lentille fills a jar with steaming soup. “Enjoy your meal!”
textes.Les Bureaux. Un open-space gris à perte: The Offices. A grey open-plan space as far as the eye can see: desks in rows, plastic plants, buzzing neon lights… and bailiff drones reading eviction notices out loud. At the far end, a turnstile. Near the entrance, a staff memo.
textes.Les Caves Gluantes. Des couloirs de pier: The Sticky Caves. Corridors of mossy stone that twist every which way, and everywhere, little puddles going “blop”. Slimes! The staircase down is somewhere to the southeast.
textes.Les Champs de Blé Dur — le blé des pâtes: The Durum Wheat Fields — pasta wheat rippling in the wind
textes.Les Clous Rouillés ! Avant, on s'appelai: The Rusty Nails! We used to be called The New Nails, but we got old.
textes.Les Falaises du Clan — les grottes du Cl: The Clan Cliffs — the Clan's caves are dug into the rock
textes.Les Furies ! Elles planent au-dessus de: The Furies! They hover above the gate of Dis, then swoop at you. Step aside when they dive, strike when they climb back up.
textes.Les Hauts — les grandes tours de bureaux: The Heights — the great office towers, their ribbons of light, and the cars zipping between them
textes.Les Huit Recommandations des Pâtes\n1. T:
The Eight Recommendations of Pasta
1. Thou shalt not overcook the pasta.
2. Thou shalt share thy sauce with thy neighbour.
3. Thou shalt not break spaghetti in two.
4. Thou shalt taste before salting.
5. Thou shalt not throw pasta at the wall to see if it sticks.
6. Thou shalt leave a place at the table for the stranger.
7. Thou shalt do the dishes (even the pot).
8. Thou shalt smile: it tastes better with a smile.
textes.Les Limbes, le Premier Cercle. Des ombre: Limbo, the First Circle. Shadows glide between the columns. A stone sage holds a golden light; three bronze mirrors, a dark crystal, and a closed door.
textes.Les Prés Blancs — des milliers de fleurs: The White Meadows — thousands of flowers… all white, waiting for their colours
textes.Les Ruelles — de vieux immeubles serrés,: The Alleys — old buildings packed close, signs everywhere, steam rising from the ground
textes.Les Récifs de Feu, à l'ouest ! J'y suis: The Fire Reefs, to the west! I sailed by there when I was young. Well, near there. Smoke everywhere, black rocks spitting sparks… We turned back. A dwarf made a gesture at us from the beach. Not a friendly one.
textes.Les Résidences — des immeubles d'habitat: The Residences — apartment buildings, balconies, water tanks on the roofs
textes.Les Taupes Hurlantes. On répétait dans u: The Howling Moles. We used to rehearse in a cellar. The moles moved out.
textes.Les abeilles de l'Arbre-Mère sont de bon: The Mother Tree's bees are in a good mood.
textes.Les accessoires du chantier : chacun s'i: The shipyard accessories: each one is installed once and for all.
textes.Les araignées de cristal laissent des éc: The crystal spiders leave shards behind. Grommelot loves them. Shh, it's a secret.
The trees hear everything, you know.
textes.Les arbres qui portent une entaille clai: The trees with a pale notch, I marked those myself: soft wood, easy to fell. Leave the others alone.
textes.Les arbres, hein ? Et l'elfe qui danse d: The trees, eh? And the elf dancing behind them, does she like it too?
textes.Les armures s'effondrent dans un fracas: The armour collapses with a crash of scrap metal. At the back of the armoury, a chest has appeared.
textes.Les avares, dit-on, poussent ces poids d: The misers, they say, have been pushing these weights forever. You, though, have a goal: the golden slabs.
textes.Les bananiers sont mes amis. Ils ne dise: The banana trees are my friends. They never say anything, but they're very good listeners.
textes.Les beaux rêves passent par le trou du m: Good dreams pass through the hole in the middle.
textes.Les bons ! Tu as l'œil. Donne-moi tes ma: The right ones! You have a good eye. Give me your hands. They're warm, that's good. Think of someone you love, very hard, and put your hand on your heart. … Do you feel it? That's healing. Now, go and see the wounded owl, near Agathe's caravan, in the Twisted Wood. She lets no one come near her. You, perhaps.
textes.Les braseros, la fresque… Les Anciens ad: The braziers, the fresco… The Ancients loved riddles. Read carefully what's carved under the pictures: for them, night always comes first.
textes.Les carpes changent de couleur toutes le: The carp change color every ten minutes. I timed it.
textes.Les cartes ne mentent jamais. Moi, parfo: The cards never lie. I sometimes do.
textes.Les cartes sont blanches… Tu as aidé tou: The cards are blank… You've helped everyone. All that's left is to live happily. That's the hardest part.
textes.Les cercles rouges au sol : des ronces v: The red circles on the ground: brambles are about to burst out! Get out of the circle, quick!
textes.Les champs de chanvre — de hautes tiges: The hemp fields — tall green stalks: they're made into ropes and canvas
textes.Les champs de coquelicots — un grand tap: The poppy fields — a great red carpet rippling in the wind
textes.Les chaussettes : avant ou après le pant: Socks: before or after the trousers?
textes.Les chênes attirent la foudre. Je dis ça: Oaks attract lightning. I'm just saying… for no reason.
textes.Les cinq braseros de l'Aire des Duels fl: The five braziers of the Duelling Ground blaze! Pyra Flammèche applauds from afar.
textes.Les cinq pierres chantent ensemble ! Des: The five stones sing together! Thousands of fireflies burst out of the pool and swirl up to the ceiling… With a long creak, the roots blocking the staircase draw back.
textes.Les cloches vibrent ensemble, discordant: The bells ring out together, jangling, then fall silent… That was not the right order.
textes.Les coups qui enlèvent un cœur ou plus p: Blows that take a heart or more lose half a heart.
textes.Les cristaux s'allument et chantent tout: The crystals light up and sing softly… The crystal engine is in place. Look behind you as you sail: a wake of stars!
textes.Les crocodiles de l'embouchure de l'Iter: The crocodiles at the mouth of the Iterou keep stealing the nets of Khéty, the fisherman. He wants someone to bring him two of their teeth, so they get the message.
textes.Les derniers feux s'éteignent dans le ci: The last fireworks fade in the sky, the flying lanterns turn into stars. Lumina cries with joy in Bobor's arms. “The most beautiful Night of Lanterns in a thousand years!” (The party itself will go on until dawn.)
textes.Les deux ? … Les deux. Mais oui ! Pourqu: Both? … Both. Of course! Why didn't we think of that?
textes.Les deux dalles d'Isis s'illuminent ! Co: Both of Isis's slabs light up! Against the back wall, a casket slowly rises from the floor.
textes.Les deux gardiens de bronze s'effondrent: The two bronze guardians collapse with one last clatter. The sheepfold goes quiet again… At the back of the niche, a small fresco.
textes.Les deux gardiens de pierre s'arrachent: The two stone guardians tear themselves free from their pedestals!
textes.Les deux gardiens sont tombés. Dans un c: Both guardians have fallen. With a rattle of chains, the grate rises!
textes.Les deux poids sont sur les dalles d'or: Both weights are on the golden slabs! A deep “clack” somewhere in the walls: the south door sinks into the floor.
textes.Les deux villages ensemble, en direct de: Both villages together, live from the Main Stage. The crowd sings. It whistles, it crackles, it's magnificent.
textes.Les deux yeux de corail du Grand Moaï: The Great Moai's two coral eyes
textes.Les deux yeux de corail s'envolent de te: The two coral eyes fly out of your hands, rise high up and settle into the Great Moai's face. He blinks. Once. Slowly.
textes.Les donjons ont une acoustique formidabl: Dungeons have wonderful acoustics for thunder.
textes.Les elfes n'oublient rien. Surtout pas l: Elves forget nothing. Least of all kind people.
textes.Les elfes ne quittent presque jamais le: Elves almost never leave Bois-Doré. The mist protects us… and shuts us in a little, too. I'm the first in a long time to speak to a human.
textes.Les engrenages du Colosse se bloquent !: The Colossus's gears jam! Its furnace opens: strike!
textes.Les engrenages grincent… et se mettent à: The gears creak… and start turning! The bronze gate lifts, the water of the big pond rushes into the old canal with a roar. The level drops, drops… In the middle of the pond a big round stone appears.
textes.Les feuilles qui bougeaient se redressen: The moving leaves stand upright: carnivorous plants! And a bundle of brambles that walks…
textes.Les flammes vacillent… puis toutes s'éte: The flames flicker… then all go out at once. That was not the right order.
textes.Les fusées de Zigomar prêtes, revenir la: With Zigomar's rockets ready, come back at night (after 8 p.m.) to the Great Lantern Square for the party
textes.Les fées du village ont toutes un servic: The village fairies all have a favour to ask of you. In exchange, they give fairy dust!
textes.Les fées m'ont dit que la musique de Mis: The fairies told me Mistral's music rises all the way to their kingdom, when the wind blows the right way.
textes.Les gardiens de corail… Des soldats chan: The coral guardians… Soldiers turned to stone. My sword cuts through them like stale bread. Especially the third hit.
textes.Les gargouilles ne plongeront plus sur v: The gargoyles won't dive onto your sails anymore.
The gargoyles crumble to dust. The courtyard is yours… To the east, the library; to the west, the armoury; to the north, the keep, sealed.
textes.Les gens d'ici ? J'en connais quelques-u: The folks around here? I know a few. Which one interests you?
The folks around here? I know a few. Which one interests you?
textes.Les gens d'ici ont leurs habitudes : le: People here have their habits: at work in the morning, elsewhere in the evening. If you can't find someone, come back at another time.
textes.Les gens qui se connaissent parlent les: People who know each other talk about each other. Listen closely: that's often where you learn the most.
textes.Les graines lumineuses de Photon se sont: Photon's glowing seeds have flown off to the Zero-Gravity Garden: over there nothing falls back down, and they're floating right at the top. Photon's knees are too old to jump that high. They must be caught (three seeds) and brought back to him so you can plant them together.
textes.Les humains ont des oreilles rondes. C'e: Humans have round ears. It's cute.
textes.Les humains vivent si peu de temps… Dis-: Humans live such a short time… Tell me: if you had three hundred years ahead of you, what would you do with them?
Your thoughts settle back into place.
textes.Les jaguars du Mont Fumant: The jaguars of the Smoking Mountain
textes.Les jaguars du volcan ne tueront plus de: The volcano's jaguars will kill no more turkeys.
textes.Les jaguars du volcan… je viens avec toi: The volcano jaguars… I'm coming with you.
Young Moai don't know anything anymore.
textes.Les lianes, ne t'y pends pas trop. Celle: The vines: don't hang off them too much. The one on the right dropped me three times. We're not speaking any more.
textes.Les lucioles sont en avance, cette année: The fireflies are early this year.
textes.Les mains d'ombre reculent devant la Lue: The shadow hands recoil before the Moonglow and sink back under the flagstones!
textes.Les marches de lumière tintent sous tes: The steps of light chime under your feet, one by one… A thousand steps, but they climb all by themselves. And here you are in the ruined tower, in broad daylight, the Royal jelly heart in your bag.
textes.Les marches sentent la pomme verte. Ce n: The steps smell of green apple. That's not a good sign.
textes.Les marches tremblent un peu. Tout en ba: The steps tremble a little. Way down at the bottom, a huge engine goes “vroom”. Politely.
textes.Les mouettes volent les frites, ici. Gar: The seagulls steal the fries here. Guard your snack.
textes.Les mâts se lèvent… les voiles se déplie: The masts rise… the sails unfold… PERFECT! You have fairy fingers! Here, this one's for you.
textes.Les nains sont bourrus, mais ce sont les: The dwarves are gruff, but they're the best blacksmiths in the world. Grommelot says that's not true. Grommelot is jealous.
textes.Les navires ont un problème, capitaine ?: Are the ships in trouble, captain?
textes.Les neuf couleurs sont revenues ! Toute: All nine colours are back! All of Sketched Island regains its colours at once, like a watercolour spreading…
textes.Les nouilles de Hiro… ou de Gaston. Peu: Hiro's noodles… or Gaston's. Doesn't matter: they're perfect.
textes.Les offrandes du Grand Temple: The offerings of the Great Temple
textes.Les paniers de légumes des Jardins Parta: The vegetable baskets from the Shared Gardens haven't arrived at the Pay-What-You-Can Canteen. No vegetables, no soup, and no soup means half of the Boucan will go hungry tonight. Three baskets must be fetched from the Shared Gardens.
textes.Les pattes de Ramure sont rapides… Une r: Ramure's paws are quick… A rematch?
textes.Les perles pour ta robe de fête: The pearls for your party dress
textes.Les perles pour ta robe de fête…: The pearls for your party dress…
textes.Les petites ! (Il les prend dans ses mai: The little ones! (He takes them in cupped hands. All the flowers in the Gardens blink twice. Twice means thank you.) Come, let's plant them together. A hole made with a finger, a seed, a little soil, a little water... and a kind word. That's the most important part, the kind word. Say something to it. ... There. Did you see? It blinked. It heard you. Tomorrow morning, at sunrise, they'll sing. Off-key, surely. But with a great deal of heart.
textes.Les petits Moaïs, beaux joueurs, te donn: The little Moai, good sports, give you their treasure.
textes.Les pierres s'éteignent toutes d'un coup: All the stones go dark at once… That wasn't the right order. (The firefly pool can show you the song again.)
textes.Les pierres s'éteignent une à une. Les f: The stones go out one by one. Perhaps the corridor frescos tell the story in the right order…
textes.Les pitons de pierre, je les escaladais,: I used to climb the stone peaks. Now I have a ladder, and creaky knees.
textes.Les plantes retombent, fanées. La Salle: The plants wilt and fall. The Hall of Seasons grows calm again… The stele, near the staircase, is waiting to be read.
textes.Les portes de verre se ferment. L'ascens: The glass doors close. The elevator shoots up to the sky: 50 floors, 100, 150… you can feel your ears pop. Ding!
textes.Les portes vitrées coulissent dans un «: The glass doors slide open with a polite “pshhh”. The air of Port-Boucan smells of sea, soup and fresh paint. It feels good.
textes.Les pouvoirs des sceaux se rechargent 30: Seal powers recharge 30% faster. (You need at least one seal.)
textes.Les pâtes de Mamma… La sauce de la Marmi: Mamma's pasta… The sauce from the Cooking Pot… and the Golden Grater! It still shines! (The Reverend cooks the tagliatelle in the fountain on the square, coats them in sauce, grates a snow of parmesan over them, then sets it all on a big golden dish.) There. The Dish of the Great Reconciliation. It's not for me to offer it to him, my child: you're the one who gathered everything. Go and place it on the altar, next to the eternal plate. And smile. He likes it when people smile.
textes.Les quarante couplets, Barnabé. Le héros: All forty verses, Barnabé. In it, the hero is ten feet tall.
textes.Les quatre cloches chantent ensemble ! L: All four bells sing together! The Song of the Sky Kings rolls across the whole island… At the centre of the belfry, a slab opens and a chest rises up.
textes.Les quatre cristaux brillent ensemble !: All four crystals shine together! The Heart seal spins on itself with a long rumble, and a column of red light rises from the floor where it was sealed. (E, in the centre: descend into the Hall of the Heart)
textes.Les quatre flammes rugissent ensemble !: All four flames roar together! With a rumble, the stone door sinks into the floor.
textes.Les quatre fleurs s'ouvrent ensemble : l: The four flowers open together: spring in the east, summer in the south, autumn in the west, winter in the north. A scent of every season at once fills the hall… The roots of the last staircase draw back. At the very top, the Crown.
textes.Les quatre passerelles de corde, toutes: All four rope bridges crossed! They creak a little, but they hold fast.
textes.Les quatre runes sont brisées ! Le Gardi: All four runes are shattered! The Guardian falls to his knees… his chest opens: the fire heart is exposed. Strike it!
textes.Les quatre sceaux ? Tu veux… vraiment ?: The four seals? You want to… really? Ha! I knew you were one of those who finish their maps! Listen: nobody here knows where they are. But Old Corentin knows all the old stories of Carène. Go and see him: on the bridge by the bell during the day, at La Dernière Bordée in the evening. Me, I'm keeping a nice clean corner of the map for Stoneheart.
textes.Les quatre sceaux s'allument ensemble. L: The four seals light up together. The great circle blazes… The mountain rumbles, far away, very deep, like a heart waking up. Then, in a crash of stone, the Gate of the Four Seals sinks into the ground.
textes.Les quatre sceaux… Assieds-toi, petit. I: The four seals… Sit down, lad. Two hundred years ago the mountain woke up: the Stoneheart beat so hard that the sea trembled all the way here. The four peoples went down beneath the mountain and put to sleep whatever was beating down there. Then they shut the door, and each one went home with a seal. Ours, the Seal of Sea Spray, was hidden somewhere aboard by the Leviathan's last captain. Where? He wrote it in his logbook… which my grandfather sold, one winter of famine, to a storyteller from Tazira. Ba Sidi, he was called. He must be very old by now, if he's still alive.
textes.Les quatre serpents fixent l'autel. Leur: The four serpents stare at the altar. Their eyes blaze… and the lid slides open with a rumble!
textes.Les racines ne bougent pas. Les quatre f: The roots don't move. The four stone flowers are not yet in the order the stele asks for.
textes.Les robots de la cour de l'usine: The robots of the factory yard
textes.Les robots déménageurs de Monsieur Lisse: Mr Lisse's mover robots stole the Bilge Rats' gear just before the Great Boucan, the biggest concert of the year: Germaine the Terrible (Clou's guitar), the tube amp and the drumsticks. You need to find everything, give the guitar and the amp back to Rouille, then come to the Great Boucan, in the evening, at the Howling Hall.
textes.Les robots repartent vers l'Usine Grise,: The robots head back to the Grey Factory in single file, apologising as they go. The Boucan applauds! The furniture stays right where it was.
textes.Les ronces au nord du jardin… c'est le d: The brambles to the north of the garden… that's the domain of the Bramble Queen. We'll need five pinches of fairy dust to get through.
textes.Les ronces s'effondrent… Le bois de la C: The brambles collapse… The wood of the Crown trembles. In the middle, something enormous pushes through the bark!
textes.Les ronces se fanent, les roses refleuri: The brambles wither, the roses bloom again. Before you floats an immense fairy, gentle and luminous: Églantine, the true Fairy Queen. Speak to her.
textes.Les ronces se referment derrière toi. Su: The brambles close behind you. On the throne, a figure rises… THE BRAMBLE QUEEN spreads her black wings!
textes.Les roses de lumière brûlent la Reine !: The roses of light burn the Queen! Her shield shatters, she falls: STRIKE!
textes.Les runes du Cercle s'allument une à une: The runes of the Circle light up one by one… The nine Moonstones sing. You are a wizard of Arcanelle!
textes.Les scorpions ne bougent plus. Le tombea: The scorpions stop moving. The tomb falls silent again… On the back wall, a great fresco.
textes.Les seaux sont près de la porte. Place-l: The buckets are by the door. Place them under the three drips.
textes.Les sept Grandes Lanternes brillent sur: The seven Great Lanterns shine over the city… but Lumina shakes her head: “No Night of Lanterns without Zigomar's rockets! I think he's missing his sulphur crystals.”
textes.Les soirs de brume, je fais un plus gros: On misty evenings, I build a bigger fire, so my smoke can be seen clearly from his kapok tree. Why? So he knows I'm still here. It must annoy him tremendously. That's reason enough.
textes.Les spaghettis qui restent ne sont pas e: The spaghetti that's left isn't dry yet. It takes patience (and sunshine).
textes.Les spectres se défont en lambeaux de br: The specters fall apart into shreds of mist. The big pond grows calm again… The old sluice gate closes gently: the water rises back.
textes.Les toilettes ? Au fond à gauche. … NON: The bathroom? At the back on the left. … NO! Not at all! OUT!
textes.Les trois ! (Philémon les étale, les tou: All three! (Philémon spreads them out, turns them, flips them, and sews them back together with silk thread.) Look: the Peak, the Balafre… and there, at the end, a skull, and a red cross. Skull Rock! But read the margin: “My second keeps watch.” Captain Fleshless… Beware, young man.
textes.Les trois ! Et pas une seule cornée. (El: All three! And not a single dog-ear. (She gives you a little curtsy, with just one wing.) If you ever want a job, the post office is hiring. Even without wings.
textes.Les trois ! Respect, champion. Je les re: All three! Respect, champ. I'll put them back in the water, they're better off down there. And you, your lungs have grown, I can tell.
textes.Les trois Perles s'élèvent toutes seules: The three Pearls rise by themselves toward the tower… and the Great Crystal blazes! A blue light floods the city, the dome begins to sing. Atlantis is saved!
textes.Les trois affiches ont voyagé, Agrafe !: The three posters have travelled, Agrafe!
textes.Les trois fragments de jade, soudés auto: The three jade fragments, joined around a green eye. Underground, it lights up the darkness around you. It hums near the seal of the Abyss.
textes.Les trois morceaux recousus au fil de so: The three pieces sewn back together with silk thread by Philémon Lunette: One-Eye Peak, the Balafre, and at the end of the ravine a skull marked with a red cross. In the margin, in shaky handwriting: "My first mate keeps watch."
textes.Les trois pains sont livrés, Honorine !: All three loaves are delivered, Honorine!
textes.Les trois rayons frappent Nâga ! Sa tête: The three beams strike Nâga! His head crashes onto the platform: STRIKE!
textes.Les trois runes ! « Fiat lux » : « que l: The three runes! “Fiat lux”: “let there be light.” It's the motto of the Academy, and from now on it's a little bit yours. Keep these coins. And come back and watch the stars with me one night: it's even more beautiful with someone who can make light.
textes.Les trois runes de la crypte brillent !: The three runes in the crypt are shining!
textes.Les trois runes de la crypte brillent d': The three runes of the crypt shine gold: “Fiat lux”. Aurélien Lumen will want to know.
textes.Les trois soleils se lèvent ensemble ! R: The three suns rise together! Ra, Kinich Ahau and Tonatiuh greet you: you are the Child of the Three Suns.
textes.Les tuyaux qui s'allument en bleu sont d: The pipes lit up in blue are already connected to the battery. Start from the battery, on the left, and go one tile at a time.
textes.Les têtes de la Carrière regardent l'hor: The Quarry heads look at the horizon, or at their feet… All of them? No: a little lower down, one of them has its nose in the air, watching the clouds go by.
textes.Les vrais Seigneurs ont crié, et les aut: The real Lords cried out, and the others called them by name! Two of them didn't flinch: wooden dummies.
textes.Les yeux de pierre brillent. « Tiens. Je: The stone eyes shine. “Here. I found it in my dream. It's for you.”
textes.Les étoiles : on les compte ou on les re: The stars: do you count them or watch them?
textes.Lever les yeux vers le Grand Spaghetti V: Look up at the Great Flying Spaghetti
textes.Le… le poisson-lune doré ? Pour moi ? Je: The… the golden sunfish? For me? I… I don't know what to say. Neither does Gaston. That's a first.
textes.Le… le poisson-lune doré. Ma parole. {pr: The… the golden sunfish. Well I never. {prix} coins, and that's a bargain for you. Clou, close your mouth.
textes.Lili Pinceau, la fille de Basile (neuf a: Lili Pinceau, Basile's daughter (nine and a half), saw the pot of yellow (no. 4) roll along the beach to the big sandcastle at the far end of the shore, to the west. But the tide has covered everything, and she can't remember where the castle door is.
textes.Lili, j'ai trouvé le jaune ! Il était au: Lili, I found the yellow! It was at the foot of the tower.
textes.Lire les pages blanches du journal de bo: Read the blank pages of the logbook by Moonglow (key 4 then X; in VR, B), with the logbook in your bag
textes.Lisse & Fils vous remercie de votre coop: Lisse & Fils thanks you for your cooperation.
textes.Livraison pour… erreur. Livraison pour p: Delivery for… error. Delivery for nobody. Bzz.
textes.Livrer le pain à Edmond (Grand Hôtel): Deliver the bread to Edmond (Grand Hotel)
textes.Livrer le pain à Gisèle (Café de la Plac: Deliver the bread to Gisèle (the Square Café)
textes.Livrer le pain à Paulo (Chez Paulo, sur: Deliver the bread to Paulo (Chez Paulo, on the quay)
textes.Longue-vue : clic droit (ou stick droit): Spyglass: right click (or right stick) to look around; L to put it away.
textes.Lord Pemberton paierait cher une vraie c: Lord Pemberton would pay a lot for a real curiosity: a feather from the giant eagle, a naga scale, or a shark tooth.
textes.Lourde et bien équilibrée. Elle abat les: Heavy and well balanced. It fells young trees (a pale notch on the trunk) and coconut palms: logs, coconuts, honey… Damage: 5.
textes.Lui, il a de l'humour !: Now he's got a sense of humor!
textes.Lulu, c'est vrai, ton histoire de royaum: Lulu, is it true, your story about the fairy kingdom?
textes.Lumina, la lanternière, prépare la Nuit: Lumina, the lantern-maker, is preparing the Night of Lanterns: the seven Great Lanterns of the city must be lit. When they're all shining, and Zigomar's rockets are ready, Pandémonia will dance all night long on the Great Square.
textes.Lyra dit qu'il a sauvé l'Arbre sacré. Al: Lyra says they saved the sacred Tree. So they're kind.
textes.Là-bas, au-dessus de l'océan : l'île flo: Over there, above the ocean: the floating island! Waterfalls pour from it down to the sea, and on its summit, the Citadel of the Clouds. You can land on the esplanade, to the south.
textes.Là-haut, au-dessus de la passoire, flott: Up there, above the colander, floats the Great Flying Spaghetti: an enormous tangle of spaghetti, two meatballs, and two eyes on stalks… looking at you. It just blinked. It really did.

Up there, above the colander, floats the Great Flying Spaghetti: an enormous tangle of spaghetti, two meatballs, and two eyes on stalks… half closed. Its noodles hang limp. It looks like it's sulking.
textes.Lâche mon compagnon, batracien ! Tu vas: Let go of my companion, you amphibian! You'll taste my sword!
textes.Lève ta garde (F, ou grip gauche en VR): Raise your guard (F, or left grip in VR) at the last moment, just before the blow: no damage, the enemy is stunned and your riposte hits double.
textes.Légendaire. Barnabé dit qu'il n'en exist: Legendary. Barnabé says there is only one. He was wrong.
textes.Légère comme une graine au vent ! L'Arbr: Light as a seed on the wind! The Tree is singing again. Can you hear it?
textes.M'aider ? Avec les crocodiles ? Ha ! … T: Help me? With the crocodiles? Ha! … You're serious. Well. At the river mouth, to the east, three big crocodiles lie on the sandbanks. They eat my fish out of my nets, and sometimes the nets along with them. Bring me two of their teeth: I'll hang them on my boat. The others will understand.
textes.MA BOTTE ! Ma botte gauche ! Vingt-deux: MY BOOT! My left boot! Twenty-two years I've been hopping on one foot! {surnom}, you're my hero!
textes.MA CARTE ! Un peu mâchonnée, un peu sent: MY MAP! A bit chewed, smelling a bit of sardine… but it's the one! Look: the cliff, the caves, the cross. Behind the Skala, I knew it! Here, your share, little sailor. And a bottle of Mama Lou's best tonic. If you ever want to sign on aboard the Murène, there's always a hammock for you.
textes.MIOU ! (Le chat saute de tes bras dans l: MIOU! (The cat leaps from your arms into hers and purrs like a mill.) You smell of the tomb, naughty cat! … Thank you, thank you! Here, it's my lucky scarab. Ptahmose made it for me. It'll bring you luck too, now.
textes.MON ANTENNE ! (Il la serre dans ses bras: MY ANTENNA! (He hugs it, climbs the mast, screws it back on, climbs down, throws himself at his mic.) Pschhh... Pschhh... THIS IS RADIO BOUCAN, 98.7, THE RADIO THAT NEVER GOES OFF... EXCEPT WHEN THE ANTENNA FALLS! AND IT'S BACK UP! Ladies and gentlemen, dear listeners, dear seagulls, the antenna was saved by a hero you all know! ... Well, that you're about to know. I'll be talking about it until tomorrow.
textes.MON CERF-VOLANT ! Merci merci merci ! Ti: MY KITE! Thank you thank you thank you! Here, my prettiest shells. And Dad said to give you this too.
textes.MON CHAPEAU ! (Il le pose sur sa tête, l: MY HAT! (He puts it on his head, takes it off, kisses it, puts it back.) On the windmill! It wanted to see the countryside, the rascal. It has a bit of flour on the feather. It makes it look wise. Thank you, thank you, thank you! Aurore! AURORE! My hat has come back! All on its own! … With some help.
textes.Ma barque ? « La Marguerite ». Comme ma: My boat? “La Marguerite”. Like my wife. Tell Odette, and tell her she can come over for a cool drink too.
textes.Ma bourse ! Quarante pièces, le compte e: My purse! Forty coins, the count is right. (She bites a coin.) And they're real, too. You, dearie, are welcome at the Crâne Fendu. Here: your share, and two hot drinks from my personal stock. Don't tell anyone I have a personal stock.
textes.Ma canne ? Rends-moi d'abord ce petit se: My rod? First do me that little favour: my pearly shells. Then we'll talk fish.
textes.Ma carte ! La carte de mon grand-père, l: My map! My grandfather's map, Captain Sel's! I'd put it down on a barrel, on the quay, while I tied my bootlaces. A ginger cat jumped on it, grabbed it in its mouth, and hop: one crate, another crate, a roof. I don't climb on roofs, I'm afraid of heights. Find it, and you'll get your share. A small share. But a share.
textes.Ma chanson sur le vainqueur de Nâga, je: My song about the conqueror of Nâga, I sang it to the mist every evening for a whole month. Forty verses, at the top of my lungs. How it got across is a mystery: the wind, or Gaston whistling it to every bird. The fact is that a nine-hundred-and-eighty-seven-year-old elf knows it. I'm published!
textes.Ma collection a un trou, {surnom}. Un tr: My collection has a hole in it, {surnom}. A gaping hole! I'm missing {manque} pearly shells. There are some on your village beach. Would you bring me some?
textes.Ma hache ! Tu en prends soin ? Pas sur l: My axe! Are you taking care of it? Not on the rocks, eh.
textes.Ma jarre ! Elle venait de ma grand-mère: My jar! It came from my grandmother!
My whiskers tell me you're nice.
textes.Madame Hurla : « ABANDON ! Il a quitté l: Madame Hurla: “FORFEIT! He has left the sand!” The crowd boos (kindly). We'll replay the round whenever you like.
textes.Madame Hurla : « DEUXIÈME MANCHE ! Ils o: Madame Hurla: “SECOND ROUND! They have fangs, they have flames, they have no manners: TWO HELLHOUNDS!”
textes.Madame Hurla : « K.O. ! On le ramasse !: Madame Hurla: “K.O.! Someone pick him up!” Two demons carry you to the arena door, and Bulle brings you a mug of hot sulphur tea. We'll replay the round whenever you like.
textes.Madame Hurla : « LA FINALE ! Sept ans in: Madame Hurla: “THE FINAL! Undefeated for seven years, two metres forty of horns, a heart of butter: GORGOTH THE HORNED!” The crowd leaps to its feet.
textes.Madame Hurla : « TROISIÈME MANCHE ! Du b: Madame Hurla: “THIRD ROUND! Walking bronze and sniggering imps: TWO AUTOMATONS AND TWO IMPS!”
textes.Madame Hurla, dans son porte-voix : « ME: Madame Hurla, through her megaphone: “LADIES AND GENTLEMEN, DEMONS! First round of the Tournament of Horns: THREE IMPS, more annoying than nasty!”
textes.Madame Hurla, la maîtresse de l'Arène de: Madame Hurla, mistress of the Arena of Horns, is looking for a contender for the great tournament: four rounds, the last one against Gorgoth the Horned, the undefeated champion.
textes.Madame Olga a ouvert sa fenêtre pour fai: Madame Olga opened her window to let out a draught spell. The spell got out, along with three pages of her spellbook. They've been scattered all over town.
textes.Madame Olga, votre grimoire a l'air bien: Madame Olga, your spellbook looks rather thin
Madame Olga, your spellbook looks rather thin…
textes.Mademoiselle Lyra ! Je vous salue bien b: Miss Lyra! I bow most deeply to you!
textes.Mademoiselle Lyra ? Une vraie elfe, {sur: Miss Lyra? A real elf, {surnom}! Three hundred and twelve years old and not a single wrinkle. I get one per tide, and she finds me charming all the same.
textes.Mae govannen, voyageur. Chez nous, les p: Mae govannen, traveler. At our place, plants grow when you sing to them. Want to sing with me?
textes.Magnifique ! Du fer bien lourd. Avec ça,: Magnificent! Nice heavy iron. With that, my roof will last at least… a week!
textes.Magnifique ! Ils sentent encore la mer !: Magnificent! They still smell of the sea! Here, three bowls of my bouillabaisse, and for you, at Paulo's, it will always be a friend's price.
textes.Magnifique ! Tu as l'air de réfléchir à: Magnificent! You look like you're thinking about something very important. What were you thinking about? … Snack time? Perfect.
textes.Magnifique ! Tu as une voix de pierre !: Magnificent! You have a voice of stone!
textes.Magnifique, le plus beau perroquet du mo: Magnificent, the most beautiful parrot in the world.
textes.Magnifiques ! Jaunes comme des canaris !: Magnificent! Yellow as canaries! (He crushes them in a mortar, he mixes, he sneezes, he laughs.) The rockets are ready! Tell Lumina the Night of Lanterns will have its fireworks!
textes.Magnifiques ? Il leur manque le principa: Magnificent? They're missing the main thing: ember flowers! Flame petals, yellow in the middle, red at the tips. They only grow on the slopes of the Great Blaze, where the ground is warm. Bring me five. Don't step on the lava flows, mind you: I'm too old to be treating burns.
textes.Maintiens pour mouliner, relâche si ça t: Hold to reel, release if it pulls too hard
textes.Mais le Sceau d'Airain cliquette dans ta: But the Bronze Seal clicks in your pocket… The Cogwheel (key 3, then X)?
textes.Mais… QU'EST-CE QUE TU FICHES CHEZ MOI ?: But… WHAT ON EARTH ARE YOU DOING IN MY HOUSE?!
textes.Mais… comment ça tient ?: But… how does it stay up?
textes.Mais… je suis déjà là, juste derrière to: But… I'm already here, right behind you! I have been all along!
textes.Majesté ! C'est vous ! Vous êtes revenue: Majesty! It's you! You've come back!
textes.Mal. Clou a caché mon marteau. Et il ne: Bad. Clou hid my hammer. And he won't say where.
textes.Mal. Très mal. Mais tu n'y es pour rien…: Bad. Very bad. But it's not your fault… well, hardly your fault.
textes.Malebolge, le Huitième Cercle : trois fo: Malebolge, the Eighth Circle: three ditches of fire, three turning iron bridges. And little imps, the Malebranches, sniggering as they wait for you.
Mama Grog is demanding her forty coins.
textes.Mama Grog, une holo-photo pour un touris: Mama Grog, a holo-photo for a space tourist?
textes.Maman dit qu'on n'a pas le droit d'y tre: Mum says we're not allowed to dip our bread in it. But she says nothing about fingers.
textes.Mamie Barricade, une holo-photo pour un: Mamie Barricade, a holo-photo for a space tourist?
Mamie Kiku sent you a message! (No. But click anyway.)
textes.Mamie Tournesol et Mère Averse ont fait: Granny Sunflower and Mother Downpour have made peace: the Larsen Festival can come back! Jack, the head roadie, has been repairing the Main Stage for years. He's missing Galet's ropes, Lune's canvas… and someone to tell Mégaphone to finally press his third button.
textes.Mamie Tournesol, Mère Averse vous a fait: Granny Sunflower, Mother Downpour made you this umbrella.
textes.Mamie Tournesol, la doyenne du Camp des: Granny Sunflower, the eldest of the Flower Camp, and Mother Downpour, the eldest of Rainville, were the best friends in the world. Fifty years ago, they fell out over the weather (sun or rain for the festival?), and since then nobody has dared to step onto the Main Stage.
