textes.Quatre creux ronds… vides. Et un cercle: Four round hollows… empty. And a circle that glows! So Corentin was telling the truth: four seals, one for each people of the island. Here, that's for your trouble, and my map of the island, copied out for you. One day, you'll have to go and see the shepherds of the north, the mist people and the caravaneers of the south. And find our own seal.
textes.Quatre petits Moaïs, immobiles au fond d: Four little Moai, motionless at the back of the room. Very motionless. Too motionless.
textes.Quatre pièces. Le fil n'est pas gratuit,: Four coins. Thread isn't free, and neither is the disinfectant. Especially the disinfectant.
textes.Quatre serpents qui tournent deux par de: Four serpents turning two by two? Ah, the Ancients and their pranks… Start with the one that's already in the right place, and see which one it drags along.
textes.Quatre statues de pierre, chacune avec s: Four stone statues, each with its medallion: a sailor (the wave), a caravan woman (the sun), a shepherd (the cogwheel), a fox woman (the moon). On the fresco above the staircase, the four peoples hold hands before the great gate; above them, a red stone heart, linked by four rays to four crystals.
textes.Quatre symboles gravés, dans l'ordre : I: Four symbols engraved, in order: I, II, III, IIII. And beneath: “When the night lifts the sea, the day rises, and the guardian awakes.”
textes.Que cherchez-vous sur cette carte ?: What are you looking for on that map?
textes.Que cherchez-vous, milord ?: What are you looking for, milord?
textes.Que de livres ! Tous bien rangés… sauf u: So many books! All neatly arranged… except one, a red one, that isn't quite in its place.
textes.Que demande Charon pour passer l'Achéron: What does Charon ask for to cross the Acheron?
textes.Que dit un caillou à un autre caillou ?: What does one pebble say to another pebble?
textes.Que dit un oignon quand il se cogne ?: What does an onion say when it bumps itself?
textes.Que dit une imprimante dans l'eau ?: What does a printer say when it's sinking?
textes.Que fait une fraise sur un cheval ?: What does a strawberry do on a horse?
textes.Que faut-il faire, au sommet du Grand Te: What must be done at the top of the Great Temple?
textes.Que faut-il pour soigner l'arbre ?: What does the tree need to heal?
textes.Que les siennes sont mieux. Hé oui. Il d: That his are better. Oh yes. He says that about everything.
textes.Que puis-je faire pour Port-Azur ?: What can I do for Port-Azur?
textes.Que se passe-t-il, avec l'horloge ?: What's going on with the clock?
textes.Que sont ces lanternes bleues, sur les p: What are those blue lanterns on the bridges?
That you're less grumpy in the mornings.
textes.Quel est le métier préféré des petits Mo: What's the favorite job of little Moai?
textes.Quel pavillon hisser ? La Mouette rieuse: Which flag to hoist? The Laughing Seagull, the Sailor's Star, the Grinning Skull, the Brave Heart, the Golden Anchor or the Moonfish.
textes.Quel âge ?! On ne demande pas son âge à: How old?! You don't ask a stone lady her age! … One thousand two hundred and forty years. And a half. But I look a thousand, don't I?
What a lovely day for sailing.
textes.Quelle chanson joue le juke-box ?: Which song does the jukebox play?
textes.Quelle couleur pour la coque ? (On peut: Which colour for the hull? (You can change it for free, I've got pots all over the workshop.)
textes.Quelle heure il est ? … Oh, c'est encore: What time is it? … Oh, it's still very early. Or very late. Good night!
textes.Quelle mousse ! Tu es doué ! Un peu en a: What foam! You're gifted! A little splashed onto the ceiling, but that's the sign of a good cacao. Here, taste!
textes.Quelqu'un ! Plume-de-Nuage, ma plus jeun: Someone! Plume-de-Nuage, my youngest sky jellyfish! She's as big as an umbrella, transparent, with little pink glints, and she sings very softly, like a rubbed wine glass. This morning, I opened the Greenhouse roof to air it out... and poof. She's gone. She has a jellyfish's sense of direction: none. She must be floating somewhere around the island. Sextant spends his days sketching from the lookouts: ask him if he's seen her. And if you find her, approach gently. She follows light, and kindness.
textes.Quelqu'un ? TOUT LE MONDE me doit de l'a: Someone? EVERYBODY owes me money, dearie. But only one has owed me forty coins for three moons: Gontran Lestrange, Jambe-de-Bois, captain of the Veuve Écarlate. Go and demand my purse from him. Politely, first. And if he plays the smart aleck… here, we settle things fair and square, with fists. But don't break him too badly: he's one of my best customers.
textes.Quelqu'un gratte une guitare, assis sur: Someone strums a guitar, sitting on a purple pouf. A young woman hums along with him.
Someone is practicing a piece of music. Well… it sounds like a piece of music.
textes.Quelqu'un vole les croissants de Margaux: Someone steals Margaux's croissants every night. Officer Lefort wants witness statements.
textes.Question importante : tu préfères les co: Important question: do you prefer round shells or pointy ones?
textes.Qui est là ? … Ha ! Je le savais. C'est: Who's there? … Ha! I knew it. It's always you.
textes.Qui est là ? … Un visiteur ! Désolé, je: Who's there? … A visitor! Sorry, I can't open up: I'm made of stone, it takes a while to get up. Come back in a hundred years!
textes.Qui monte à mon échelle sans prévenir ?: Who's climbing my ladder without warning? … A customer, maybe. Octave Taillefer, blacksmith. Here we sell, we buy, we don't chit-chat. Well, not much.
textes.Qui sait ? Quelqu'un a peut-être déjà ré: Who knows? Maybe someone already has.
textes.Qui va là ? Un client ou un voleur ?: Who goes there? A customer or a thief?
textes.Quinze pièces. L'encre de seiche, ça ne: Fifteen coins. Cuttlefish ink doesn't fish itself. Come back when you've got enough.
textes.Quoi ? Ah, les meubles ? C'est le reste: What? Oh, the furniture? It's the rest of the world that's upside down. I'm perfectly fine like this.
textes.Quoi ? Bon… oui. Elle s'appelle « Gertru: What? Fine… yes. She's called “Gertrude”. Like crate number twelve. Don't look at me like that.
RAINVILLE
It rains here. All the time.
We've got used to it.
textes.RHUBARBE ! (L'oiseau saute sur son épaul: RHUBARB! (The bird jumps onto her shoulder and nibbles her ear: “Shiver me timbers!”) … Well. You saw nothing. A captain doesn't cry. Here, some coins, and one of his feathers: he lost that one biting me the day I found him. You're a friend of the Requin Borgne now.
textes.RRRIIIIIII ! Le larsen siffle dans toute: EEEEEE! The feedback whistles through the whole yurt! The two musicians burst out laughing: “That's the sound of Rainville!”
Tell me about your life again.
textes.Raconter la fresque de la Bergerie à Mèr: Tell Mother Moon, the elder of Ramure, about the Sheepfold fresco
textes.Raconter tout au Vieux Silas (près des f: Tell Old Silas everything (near the fires on the shore in the morning, at the Crâne Fendu in the evening)
textes.Raconter à Matthias ce que j'ai vu (capi: Tell Matthias what I saw (Carène harbour master's office, on the poop deck)
textes.Raconter à Nadine le voyage de ses carte: Tell Nadine about her postcards' journey
textes.Rainville — des yourtes sombres, des gar: Rainville — dark yurts, garages, amps… and a little cloud that never leaves
textes.Rallumer le cristal de l'Aile de la Lune: Rekindle the crystal of the Moon Wing (to the east)
textes.Rallumer le cristal de l'Aile des Marées: Rekindle the crystal of the Tide Wing (to the west)
textes.Rallumer le cristal de l'Aile des Rouage: Rekindle the crystal of the Cog Wing (to the north)
textes.Rallumer le cristal de l'Aile des Sables: Rekindle the crystal of the Sand Wing (to the south)
textes.Ramasser les trois éclats de lune : près: Pick up the three moon shards: near the altar of the Circle of Moonstones (west of the Academy), in the Twisted Wood (to the south-west) and on the western shore
textes.Ramasser trois bûches de bois tordu dans: Pick up three logs of twisted wood in the Twisted Wood (south-west of the island)
textes.Ramasser trois cristaux de soufre au bor: Pick up three sulphur crystals at the edge of the hot springs (at the foot of the Great Blaze)
textes.Ramasser trois flocons de givre éternel: Pick up three everlasting frost flakes on the northern cliffs of the island
textes.Ramasser trois fragments de météorite to: Gather three meteorite fragments that fell during the last shooting-star shower (one on the Agora of Stars, one in the Hanging Gardens, one at the Spaceport)
textes.Ramasser trois paniers de légumes dans l: Gather three baskets of vegetables in the Shared Gardens (east of the town, near the container village of the Boxes)
textes.Ramasser trois plumes du vent : sur la c: Pick up three wind feathers: on the western hill, at the edge of the northern cliffs, and on the eastern cliff
Pick up items on the island with E.
textes.Ramener Miou à Nebet, à Per-Hâpy: Bring Miou back to Nebet, in Per-Hâpy
textes.Ramener Rhubarbe à la capitaine Anne-Ros: Bring Rhubarbe back to Captain Anne-Rose Corbeau (at the helm of the Requin Borgne by day; at the Crâne Fendu at noon)
textes.Ramener Sardine à Tornade (au Bassin à s: Bring Sardine back to Tornade (at the Dry Dock, the skatepark, in the north-east of the town)
textes.Ramure : la théière qui remue la queue: Ramure: the teapot that wags its tail
textes.Ramure, le village des oreilles — les ar: Ramure, the village of the ears — the giant trees, the Swap Market, the Moon Circle
textes.Range ça, ou je te le fais avaler !: Put that away, or I'll make you eat it!
textes.Rapporte-les à la reine Néréa !: Bring them back to Queen Néréa!
textes.Rapporter 4 bûches à Tobias (une hache e: Bring 4 logs to Tobias (an axe and a tree will do), on the Léviathan's lower deck
textes.Rapporter au Révérend Père Farfalle (au: Bring Reverend Father Farfalle (at the Colander Temple) Mamma Lasagna's pasta, a jar of volcano sauce and the Golden Grater
textes.Rapporter deux cuisses de grenouille (co: Bring back two frog legs (an order for the inn)
textes.Rapporter deux dents de crocodile à Khét: Bring two crocodile teeth to Khéty (the crocodiles lie at the mouth of the Iterou, east of Per-Hâpy)
textes.Rapporter deux navets dorés (Père Gauber: Bring back two golden turnips (Father Gaubert wants them stuffed)
textes.Rapporter huit pots de gelée (Madame Olg: Bring back eight jars of jelly (Madame Olga is preparing a bath)
textes.Rapporter l'alliance à Léa: Bring the wedding ring back to Léa
textes.Rapporter l'antenne à Sergent Fréquence: Bring the antenna back to Sergeant Fréquence (at the Radio Boucan studio, in the wheelhouse of the stranded cargo ship in the north-west)
textes.Rapporter l'engrenage à Firmin Cogne, à: Bring the gear back to Firmin Cogne, at his stand at the Fair
textes.Rapporter l'holo-photo à Glorb (il se pr: Bring the holo-photo back to Glorb (he wanders all over Astralys: Museum, Agora, Nebula Café, lookouts, Bazaar…)
textes.Rapporter l'éclat de lentille à Anselme,: Bring the lens shard back to Anselme, at the lighthouse
textes.Rapporter l'Œil d'Horus de la Pyramide d: Bring back the Eye of Horus from the Pyramid of Ra
textes.Rapporter la Plume de Quetzalcóatl des C: Bring back Quetzalcóatl's Feather from the Five Suns
textes.Rapporter la bannière à Sire Tancrède (à: Bring the banner back to Sir Tancrède (at the Guild, in the castle courtyard in the morning, or on the ramparts in the afternoon)
textes.Rapporter la carte au Capitaine Croc-de-: Bring the map back to Captain Croc-de-Sel (on the deck of the Murène Noire by day, at La Murène Ivre in the evening)
textes.Rapporter la clochette d'argent à Bedain: Bring the silver bell back to Bedaine, at the Swap Market (at the foot of the Mother Oak)
textes.Rapporter la graine à la reine Oriane, d: Bring the seed back to Queen Oriane, in the fairy clearing
textes.Rapporter la partition à Django: Bring the sheet music back to Django
textes.Rapporter la puce à Kenji, à son atelier: Bring the chip back to Kenji, at his workshop in the Alleys
textes.Rapporter le Cœur de gelée royale à Maît: Bring the Royal jelly heart back to Master Hugues (in his office, at the back of the Guild, or at a tavern table in the evening)
textes.Rapporter le Masque de Jade de Xibalba: Bring back the Jade Mask from Xibalba
textes.Rapporter le chapeau au Baron Barthélemy: Bring the hat back to Baron Barthélemy (at the castle, at the top of the Hill: throne room in the morning, garden or rampart in the afternoon)
textes.Rapporter le panier vide à Margaux: Bring the empty basket back to Margaux
textes.Rapporter le parapluie à Mamie Tournesol: Bring the umbrella back to Granny Sunflower, in the Flower Camp
textes.Rapporter les champignons à Mère-Lune (d: Bring the mushrooms back to Mother Moon (in front of her house, halfway up the Mother Oak, or at the Moon Circle at night)
textes.Rapporter les noms à Odette, à la capita: Bring the names back to Odette at the harbour master's office
textes.Rapporter les plans du Lisse-Center à Ma: Bring the Lisse-Center plans back to Mamie Barricade (at the Cannery, in the assembly room on the roof)
textes.Rapporter les quatre livres à Théophrast: Bring the four books back to Théophraste Filandre
textes.Rapporter les trois graines à Photon et: Bring the three seeds back to Photon and plant them with him (in the Hanging Gardens, west of the Agora)
textes.Rapporter les trois pages à Madame Olga: Bring the three pages back to Madame Olga (at her magic shop, on the Great Square)
textes.Rapporter trois crocs de gobelin (pour l: Bring back three goblin fangs (for Master Hugues's necklace)
textes.Rapporter trois dents de crocodile à Bru: Bring three crocodile teeth to Brutus, at the forge (you get them from the crocodiles of the Drowned Marsh, west of the island)
textes.Rapporter trois pots de gelée de slime (: Bring back three jars of slime jelly (for the apothecary)
textes.Rapporter à Orbe un coquillage (sur les: Bring Orbe a seashell (from the beaches of Port-Azur or Village Island), a parrot feather (Balafre Island), a scarab (Island of the Three Suns), a Bilge Rats patch (Boucan Island) and a golden turnip (Montjoie Island, in the Southern Fields) — Orbe is at the Museum of Worlds, west of the Agora
textes.Rattraper trois graines lumineuses qui f: Catch three glowing seeds floating high up in the Zero-Gravity Garden (at the end of the bridge of light, past the Hanging Gardens: you jump three times higher there)
textes.Raté ! Le virus ricane… On revoit la séq: Missed! The virus sniggers… Let's see the sequence again.
textes.Raté… le poisson a filé avec l'appât. Il: Missed… the fish got away with the bait. Another one will come.
textes.Raymond et Marcel ont perdu leur cochonn: Raymond and Marcel have lost their jack, somewhere near the fountain.
textes.Rayé de bleu, vif et nerveux. Rend un cœ: Striped with blue, quick and lively. Restores one heart.
textes.Re-bonjour ! Tu as oublié quelque chose: Hello again! Did you forget something?
textes.Re-salut ! Je t'ai rouvert le système. L: Hi again! I reopened the system for you. The virus hasn't moved: it's sulking in its corner. Let's pick up where you left off!
textes.Recevoir la graine de l'esprit de l'arbr: Receive the seed from the tree spirit
textes.Redémarrage impossible : ferme l'applica: Cannot restart: close the app and launch the EXE again after Quest Link.
textes.Regarde ! Elles poussent ! Tu as une jol: Look! They're growing! You have a lovely voice… for a human.
textes.Regarde comme l'eau est claire !: Look how clear the water is!
Look up there. It moved a noodle. It did, I swear.
textes.Regarde partout, même en l'air et sous l: Look everywhere, even up high and under stones. Islands love hiding things.
textes.Regarde toutes ces belles fenêtres !: Look at all these lovely windows!
textes.Regarde toutes ces étoiles. On ne s'en l: Look at all those stars. You never tire of them.
textes.Regarde, il arrive ! Ah non, c'est une m: Look, it's coming! Oh no, it's just a seagull.
textes.Regarde, je fais un bateau avec ma purée: Look, I'm making a boat out of my mashed potatoes!
textes.Regarde-les se bousculer ! Le gros orang: Look at them jostle! The big orange one is Admiral: he always eats first. Thank you! Here, a pearl from my garden.
textes.Regarde-le… l'Albatros ! Il flotte, il r: Look at it… the Albatros! It floats, it purrs, it's magnificent. I think I'm going to cry. No. Yes. A little. Call it wherever you like: it will come and land next to you.
textes.Regarder dans la longue-vue du Belvédère: Look through the telescope at the Lookout of Colours (E, at the edge of the platform, at the very top of the Great Oak)
textes.Regarder la Palette de pierre et ses neu: Look at the Stone Palette and its nine empty paint pots
textes.Regardez ! Trois mille bulles par minute: Look! Three thousand bubbles a minute! And that one… that one is heart-shaped. I don't know how I do it. Tell the jury people smile thirty-four per cent more near my machine.
textes.Regardez ce livre, sur l'étagère. Ne ten: Look at that book, on the shelf. Don't reach out your arm: reach out your wish. Want it. Gently. … It's coming! It's coming! Catch it! Perfect. Aim, and call: the book will fly to you. Now, go and fetch me the four runaways.
textes.Regardez ce que j'ai trouvé dans le cerc: Look what I found in the fairy circle, behind the dune…
textes.Regardez-les briller dans vos mains… Mai: Watch them shine in your hands… Now, close your eyes. Think of the morning, of the first glow on the sea. Open your hand. … There! A little light, all yours. It will follow you. Go and try it in the Crypt of Runes: the three runes at the back show themselves only to it.
textes.Rejoindre l'île des elfes en bateau: Sail to the island of the elves
textes.Remonter les trois étoiles de mer du fon: Bring up the three starfish from the bottom of the bay, in front of the beach
textes.Remplir un pot de sauce à la Louche Sacr: Fill a jar with sauce at the Sacred Ladle (at the edge of the Cooking Pot), then ask Captain Rigatoni for the Golden Grater (his Houseboat, east of the Parmesan Beach)
textes.Rencontrer Lyra, l'elfe, au cœur de l'îl: Meet Lyra the elf in the heart of Village Island
textes.Rendre l'appareil photo à Gérard: Give the camera back to Gérard
textes.Rendre la Flamme Éternelle au Cœur-Brasi: Return the Eternal Flame to the Ember Heart (in the middle of the nave of the Forge Cathedral)
textes.Rendre la guitare et l'ampli à Rouille (: Give the guitar and the amp back to Rouille (at the Cannery in the morning, on the square in the afternoon, at the Howling Hall in the evening)
textes.Rendre le cerf-volant à Théo: Give the kite back to Théo
textes.Rendre le cochonnet à Raymond: Give the boules jack back to Raymond
textes.Rendre sa lumière au Cœur de la Flèche: Restore the light of the Spire's Heart
textes.Rendre visite au Capitaine Rigatoni, dan: Visit Captain Rigatoni in his Houseboat
textes.Rendre à l'Île Crayonnée toutes ses coul: Give Sketched Island back all its colours
textes.Retiens ton souffle ! Sans masque, tu ne: Hold your breath! Without a mask, you can only last a few seconds underwater. Come up for air (Space).
textes.Retourner voir Coyotl, le potier (à son: Go back to Coyotl, the potter (at his workshop, or at the market at noon)
textes.Retourner voir Grand-Mère Aquarelle: Go back to see Grand-Mère Aquarelle
textes.Retourner voir Grand-Mère Aquarelle (dev: Go back to see Grand-Mère Aquarelle (in front of the Palette in the daytime, on the Council terrace at noon and in the evening)
textes.Retourner voir Nova (à la Serre des Espè: Go back to see Nova (at the Greenhouse of Species, in the north-east, past the Academy)
textes.Retourner voir Petit-Pierre (sur le quai: Go back to see Petit-Pierre (on the quay, by the crates, in the morning; at the fishing jetty in the afternoon; on the square in the evening)
textes.Retourner voir Pixel pour la fin de la p: Go back to see Pixel for the end of the game
textes.Retourner voir Père Gaubert (aux Champs: Go back to see Père Gaubert (in the Southern Fields, in front of his farm; in the yard at noon)
textes.Retourner voir Rosalie (à la poissonneri: Go back to see Rosalie (at the fishmonger's, on the harbour, in the morning; on a café terrace or the promenade in the afternoon)
textes.Retourner voir Rouille (à la Conserverie: Go back to see Rouille (at the Cannery in the morning, on the square or the quays in the afternoon, at the Howling Hall in the evening)
textes.Retourner voir l'archimage, dans la cour: Go back to the archmage, in the courtyard of the Great Crystal
textes.Retourner voir la Doyenne Astrée (à la S: Go back to see Elder Astrée (at the Council Hall, at the foot of the Spire; on her bench in the Agora during the auroras)
textes.Retourner voir le Révérend Père Farfalle: Go back to see Reverend Father Farfalle
textes.Retourner voir le maire, devant la mairi: Go back to the mayor, in front of the town hall
textes.Retrouver Ba Sidi, le conteur de Tazira: Find Ba Sidi, the storyteller of Tazira (on Lantern Square), who has the logbook of the Léviathan
textes.Retrouver Comète (au Spatioport, ou l'ap: Find Comète (at the Spaceport, or in the afternoon at the Zero-Gravity Garden)
textes.Retrouver Germaine-la-Terrible, la guita: Find Germaine the Terrible, Clou's guitar (at the robots' lair, in front of the gate of the Grey Factory, in the south-east, behind the Spore Wood)
textes.Retrouver Mamie Barricade (à la Conserve: Find Mamie Barricade (at the Cannery, in the assembly room on the roof, or in front of the entrance in the afternoon)
textes.Retrouver Pixel et Quark, cachés quelque: Find Pixel and Quark, hiding somewhere in Astralys (in a street corner, behind a giant plant, on a floating bench… Quark hums when he hides)
textes.Retrouver Plume-de-Nuage (une petite méd: Find Plume-de-Nuage (a little pink sky jellyfish, over by the Zero-Gravity Garden, to the west) and gently lead her back to the Greenhouse of Species: she follows you if you stay close to her
textes.Retrouver Rhubarbe au vieux camp abandon: Find Rhubarbe at the old abandoned camp (to the north-west, along the camp path), and call him at the foot of his perch with the seeds (E)
textes.Retrouver Sardine, le chien au bandana r: Find Sardine, the dog with the red bandana (at the Scrapyard, in the south-east of the island, among the car wrecks: listen carefully, he barks at the robots)
textes.Retrouver Truffe dans les bosquets au bo: Find Truffe in the thickets at the edge of the Southern Fields and ring his little bell: he'll come
textes.Retrouver Zénith (à l'Observatoire, au t: Find Zénith (at the Observatory, at the telescope, at night)
textes.Retrouver l'ampli à lampes (à la Casse,: Find the tube amp (at the Scrapyard, in the south-east, among the scrap heaps, near the Scrap dragon)
textes.Retrouver la carte volée par le chat rou: Find the map stolen by the ginger cat: he climbs onto the roofs of Tazira using crates, near the houses on the quay, east of the square
textes.Retrouver la clochette de Truffe (tombée: Find Truffe's little bell (it fell in the grass near Clovis's windmill, in the Southern Fields)
textes.Retrouver la pelote de laine rouge tombé: Find the ball of red wool that fell out of Pauline's basket (in the Grand Hotel garden)
textes.Retrouver la puce holographique envolée: Find the hologram chip that flew off during the explosion in Professor Quasar's laboratory (at the Academy of Sciences, east of the Agora)
textes.Retrouver le cerf-volant de Théo sur les: Find Théo's kite on the hills, west of the town
textes.Retrouver le chapeau à plume du Baron (l: Find the Baron's plumed hat (the wind blew it south: look on top of Clovis's windmill, in the Southern Fields)
textes.Retrouver le cochonnet, près de la fonta: Find the boules jack, near the fountain on the square
textes.Retrouver les baguettes de batterie (au: Find the drumsticks (at the Dry Dock, the skatepark, in the north-east of the town, next to the harbour)
textes.Retrouver les huit autres pots de couleu: Find the eight other paint pots and pour them into the Palette: the families know where six of them fell (Basile at the pond, Rosalie in the wood, Capucine in the meadows, Lili on the beach, Gaspard at the Lookout, Achille at the waterfall); as for the turquoise and the pink, Grandpa Augustin has a little idea
textes.Retrouver les trois fromages affinés cac: Find the three aged cheeses Biscotte has hidden around Port-Coutelas (between the crates on the quay, under the fishing jetty, near the well): follow your nose
textes.Retrouver les trois pages de la partitio: Find the three pages of sheet music (the beach, the square, the quay to the east)
textes.Retrouver les trois éclats du Cœur de la: Find the three shards of the Spire's Heart (one near the Observatory, to the north; one in the Greenhouse of Species, to the north-east; one high up in the Zero-Gravity Garden, to the west): they beat softly and sing a single note
textes.Retrouver trois pages de grimoire envolé: Find three spellbook pages that blew away around Montjoie (they glow a little: on the Great Square, in the Upper Town, in the Lower Town…)
textes.Revenir voir Agrafe (à l'imprimerie de l: Go back to see Agrafe (at the Spinning Mill print shop, or in the evening at the Expression Wall)
textes.Revenir voir Brindille (à la poste du po: Go back to Brindille (at the port post office)
textes.Revenir voir Honorine (à la boulangerie,: Go back to see Honorine (at the bakery, in the Middle Town)
textes.Revenir voir Ionie au Spatioport: Go back to see Ionie at the Spaceport
textes.Reviens avec ton petit ballon, Pied-Lour: Come back with your little balloon, Heavy-Foot! I only transform things that already fly.
textes.Reviens voir les gens souvent : à force: Come back and see people often: the more you chat, the more they'll tell you things they tell no one else.
textes.Rhubarbe ? Ha ! Il ne descend pour perso: Rhubarbe? Ha! He won't come down for anyone. Except for this. (He hands you a little pouch.) Sunflower seeds roasted with salt. Show them to him, and don't look him in the eye: he hates that. And if he calls you a jellyfish head, it means he likes you.
textes.Rhubarbe te regarde de haut, ébouriffé :: Rhubarbe looks down at you, ruffled: “Jellyfish head!” He won't come down for nothing… Perroquet-Joe surely has something to lure him.
textes.Rhubarbe, le perroquet rouge de la capit: Rhubarbe, the red parrot of Captain Anne-Rose Corbeau, has flown off towards the old abandoned camp in the north-west of the island. Perroquet-Joe will know how to lure him back.
textes.Rhum ambré, eau chaude, miel et citron,: Hot water, honey and lemon, served steaming in a pewter mug. Corentin swears it cures everything. Restores one and a half hearts.
textes.Rien ! Juste un ver de terre, qui te reg: Nothing! Just an earthworm, looking at you in surprise.
textes.Rien du tout. Le pirate grogne dans son: Nothing at all. The pirate grumbles in his sleep.
textes.Rien en vue pour l'instant. Explorez, re: Nothing in sight for now. Explore, meet people!
Nothing here. The treasure must be nearby.
textes.Rien que des cailloux. Ronds, plats, gri: Nothing but pebbles. Round, flat, grey, a little less grey… That one looks like my aunt. That one too, actually.
textes.Rien sous la tête… mais tu as l'impressi: Nothing under the head… but you get the feeling it snickered when you leaned over.
textes.Rien. Absolument rien. C'est très reposa: Nothing. Absolutely nothing. It's very restful.
textes.Rien. Cette tête-là regarde l'horizon, d: Nothing. This head looks at the horizon, straight ahead; not at the clouds.
textes.Rien. Ils sont de pierre, ils parlent av: Nothing. They're made of stone, they talk with their… rocks. Er. Their relations. Anyway.
textes.Rien. Juste l'écho de ta propre main sur: Nothing. Just the echo of your own hand on the stone. In the beginning, there was…
textes.Rien… à part une vieille chaussette de p: Nothing… except an old pirate sock. Yuck.
textes.Roadie d'honneur du Festival du Larsen: Honorary roadie of the Larsen Festival
textes.Ronflements. Sur le canapé, quelqu'un do: Snoring. On the sofa, someone sleeps under three plaid blankets. A black cat sleeps on top of him. Nobody moves.
textes.Ronron. Le chat se roule sur le dos. C'e: Purr. The cat rolls onto its back. It's a trap, everybody knows that.
textes.Rosalie Gomme, la jardinière, croit que: Rosalie Gomme, the gardener, thinks the pot of green (no. 2) rolled all the way to the Hollow Stump, the oldest stump on the island, deep in the Hatching Wood. She doesn't dare go there: a big owl lives there, and it gives her funny looks.
textes.Rosalie est à la lisière du Bois des Hac: Rosalie is at the edge of the Hatching Wood, Grandpa Augustin near the Palette.
textes.Rosalie, Brioche vient avec moi !: Rosalie, Brioche is coming with me!
textes.Rosalie, c'est à qui, ce chat roux sur l: Rosalie, whose is that ginger cat on the roof?
textes.Rosalie, voilà le pot de vert ! Le hibou: Rosalie, here's the pot of green! The owl didn't say a thing.
textes.Rosalie, vous cherchez quelque chose dan: Rosalie, are you looking for something in the wood?
textes.Rou ? Rou. Rouuu. (C'est très profond, e: Coo? Coo. Cooo. (It's very deep, in pigeon.)
textes.Rouge, jaune, bleu et vert, avec une lon: Red, yellow, blue and green, with a long knotted tail. It belongs to little Théo.
textes.Rouille ? Alors c'est la maison qui offr: Rouille? Then it's on the house. (She sets a lemonade in front of you with a rat-shaped straw.) Sirène's lemonade, lemon, mint and bubbles. Nothing that goes to your head: just enough to dance until midnight. There's a concert in the evening. Come. And bring your ears, Larsen takes care of the rest.
textes.Rouille m'envoie te dire bonjour !: Rouille sent me to say hello!
textes.Rouille t'envoie ? Alors tu fais partie: Rouille sent you? Then you're part of the family! Here, have a taste. (He holds out his giant ladle, full of soup.) No, not the whole ladle. Just a sip. … There. Now you know the taste of Boucan. Come back whenever you like: here, you pay what you can. Even zero. Especially if you're hungry.
textes.Rouille, la chanteuse des Rats de Cale,: Rouille, the singer of the Bilge Rats, wants you to get to know Port-Boucan. To start with: say hello to Lentille at the Pay-What-You-Can Canteen, to Rustine at the bike workshop and to Sirène at the Howling Hall bar.
textes.Rouille, pourquoi tout le monde fait cet: Rouille, why the long faces everywhere?
textes.Rouille, tu peux me présenter un peu la: Rouille, could you show me around town a bit?
textes.Royaume des fées : chez une fée: Fairy kingdom: at a fairy's home
textes.Rrriiiii ! Le larsen siffle encore. Les: Eeeeeee! The feedback squeals again. The Rainville crows fly off, offended.
Rrrrrr… pffff… (He's asleep. Deeply. There's moss on his shoulder.)
textes.Rrrr… non, pas les cailloux… rrrr…: Rrrr… no, not the pebbles… rrrr…
textes.Rustine n'a plus de pièces de vélo : les: Rustine has run out of bike parts: Lisse's robots searched the Scrapyard to build themselves arms. There are three batches of parts left, hidden in the Scrapyard, to the south-east.
textes.RÈGLEMENT DU DONJON\nDES MILLE MARCHES\n:
RULES OF THE DUNGEON
OF A THOUSAND STEPS

1. Do not feed the slimes (they grow).
2. Do not pet the frogs (they swallow).
3. A chest that smiles is not a chest.
4. The blue crystals bring you back up here. The falls do not.

— Odon, keeper and step counter
textes.Réclamer la dette à Gontran Lestrange, d: Claim the debt from Gontran Lestrange, known as Jambe-de-Bois (on the Veuve Écarlate by day; at the Shark's Tooth in the evening)
textes.Récolter deux rayons de miel aux ruches: Gather two honeycombs from the fire bees' hives, in the Ash Wood (south-east of the city)
textes.Réconcilier Mamie Tournesol et Mère Aver: Make peace between Granny Sunflower and Mother Downpour
textes.Réconcilier le Grand Spaghetti Volant av: Reconcile the Great Flying Spaghetti with its followers
textes.Récupérer l'antenne de Radio Boucan (tou: Get back the Radio Boucan antenna (at the very top of the painted water tower, east of the town)
textes.Récupérer l'appareil photo de Gérard au: Get Gérard's camera back from the lookout (at the top of the hill path)
textes.Répondre aux trois questions du Sphinx (: Answer the Sphinx's three questions (on the plateau of Ra, across the river, south of Per-Hâpy)
textes.Répète-le plus fort, qu'on l'entende jus: Say it louder, so they can hear it all the way to Octave's kapok tree.
textes.Résoudre l'énigme des serpents: Solve the riddle of the snakes
textes.Réveiller les esprits de la forêt et ouv: Wake the forest spirits and open the root gate
textes.Réveiller les trois runes de la Crypte a: Wake the three runes of the Rune Crypt with the light spell (key 5 then V; in VR, left trigger): the crypt is above the garden, on the path to the Twisted Wood
textes.Révérend ! Il danse ! Il m'a touché l'ép: Reverend! He's dancing! He touched my shoulder!
textes.Révérend, pourquoi le Grand Spaghetti a-: Reverend, why does the Great Spaghetti look so sad?
textes.Révérend, voici les pâtes, la sauce et l: Reverend, here are the pasta, the sauce and the Golden Grater.
S to go down, W to go back up.
textes.S'inscrire à la Guilde des Aventuriers: Sign up at the Adventurers' Guild
textes.SARDINE ! (Le chien saute sur Tornade, l: SARDINE! (The dog leaps at Tornade, licks his whole face, then comes back to sit at your feet. Tornade looks at him, then at you, and sniffs.) ... He doesn't want to leave you, does he. I can see that. He chose you. (He rubs his eyes with his fist.) All right. You can keep him with you. But take good care of him, okay! He likes chew bones, he bites robots, and sometimes he brings back coins. Nobody knows where he finds them. Here, his chew bones. And bring him back to the skatepark once in a while. Promise?
textes.SORTIE DU PERSONNEL — TOURNIQUET\nformul:
STAFF EXIT — TURNSTILE
stamped forms required
textes.SPLOOOSH ! Le Mont Bolognaise crache sa: SPLOOOSH! Mount Bolognese spits out its sauce! Big red drops fly very high… and fall all over its slopes.
textes.SPLOTCH ! Une grosse goutte de sauce t'e: SPLOTCH! A big drop of sauce landed right next to you… You're splattered from head to toe. (It smells delicious.)
textes.Sa cabane du bord de plage s'est effondr: His beach hut collapsed during one of Mistral's big tracks. I heard about it from Clou, who came home covered in sand. I sent him a bag of twenty nails, by Clou. He got eleven. Clou takes his commission.
textes.Sa carapace arrête tout ! Un vent assez: Its shell stops everything! A strong enough wind might knock it over…
textes.Sa cuirasse d'or est trop dure. Ses yeux: Its golden armor is too hard. Its eyes, though, fear fire…
textes.Sa lame s'est plantée dans les dalles !: His blade is stuck in the flagstones! Strike now!
textes.Sa peau est très épaisse… Quand il RUGIT: Its skin is very thick… When it ROARS, it's going to charge: dodge, and let it smash into the rock of the hollow!
Wise decision. He never gives anything back.
textes.Sage décision. La dernière fois, j'ai pe: Wise decision. Last time, I lost my eyebrows. They grew back, but upside down.
textes.Sage. Très sage. Plus sage que nous deux: Wise. Very wise. Wiser than the two of us put together, which isn't hard.
textes.Saluer Edmond, à la réception du Grand H: Greet Edmond at the Grand Hotel reception
textes.Saluer Lentille à la Cantine à prix libr: Say hello to Lentille at the Pay-What-You-Can Canteen (on the ground floor of the Cannery, the big brick factory covered in murals, west of the Howling Hall)
textes.Saluer Odette à la capitainerie, sur le: Greet Odette at the harbour master's office, on the quay
textes.Saluer Rustine à l'atelier vélo (à la Fi: Say hello to Rustine at the bike workshop (in the Spinning Mill, the long brick shed with saw-tooth roofs, south of the Pallet Square)
textes.Saluer Sirène au bar de la Halle Hurlant: Say hello to Sirène at the Howling Hall bar (the old forge hall with the great glass roof, north-east of the Pallet Square)
textes.Saluer Toni au Perroquet Bleu: Greet Toni at Le Perroquet Bleu
textes.Salut ! Toi aussi tu veux des bras comme: Hi! Do you want arms like these too? Come on, ten push-ups with me!
textes.Salut ! Tu flottes, toi aussi ? Non ? Ah: Hi! Are you floating too? No? Ah, Heavyfoots… Well, shall I turn gravity back on, or would you rather everything floated?
textes.Salut ! Tu tombes à pic : notre chanteur: Hi! You're just in time: our singer lost his voice. Literally. He's looked for it everywhere. Want to replace him?
textes.Salut, l'ami ! Assieds-toi. Je cherche l: Hey, friend! Sit down. I'm looking for the rest of my song. It's about a sunflower that falls in love with the moon… but never sees her, because it sleeps at night. Want to sing the chorus with me?
textes.Salut. Fais attention où tu marches : le: Hi. Watch where you step: the roof leaks. In three places. I have three buckets, there, by the door, but I can't be bothered to get up… Would you put them under the drips?
textes.Sardine a déterré quelque chose… Une piè: Sardine dug something up… A coin! He drops it at your feet.
textes.Sardine aboie de toutes ses forces : un: Sardine barks with all his might: a robot! He charges to bite its iron ankles.
textes.Sardine déboule en dérapant et te lèche: Sardine skids in and licks your hand. Mission: follow you.
textes.Sardine fait trois fois le tour de toi e: Sardine circles you three times, wagging his whole behind. It's decided: he's yours, and you're his.
textes.Sardine pose une pièce un peu baveuse à: Sardine puts a slightly slobbery coin at your feet and waits for praise.
textes.Sardine rentre à la maison en trottinant: Sardine trots home. He looks back twice to make sure you haven't changed your mind.
textes.Sardine revient en trottinant, une pièce: Sardine trots back, a coin in his mouth, very pleased with himself.
textes.Sardine s'allonge contre ta jambe et pou: Sardine lies down against your leg and lets out a big, happy dog sigh.
textes.Sardine saute dans la barque et se poste: Sardine jumps into the boat and takes up position at the bow, nose in the wind, like a true sea dog.
textes.Sardine, le chien au bandana rouge: Sardine, the dog with the red bandana
textes.Sardine, le chien de Tornade, un bâtard: Sardine, Tornade's dog, a happy mutt with a red bandana, followed one of Lisse's robots and hasn't come back. Chaussette thinks he went towards the Scrapyard, to the south-east.
textes.Sauter (ou E) : danser le pogo avec la f: Jump (or E): mosh with the crowd!
textes.Se faire inscrire au registre par Éclipt: Get Écliptique to enter you in the register (at the Council Hall, at the foot of the Crystal Spire, in the centre of the island; at noon at the Nebula Café)
textes.Se promener dans le Bois des Hachures: Take a walk in the Hatching Wood
textes.Sept pièces, mon ami. Les ressorts, ça s: Seven coins, my friend. Springs wear out. So do coins, but more slowly.
textes.Ses crocs sont plantés dans la pierre :: His fangs are stuck in the stone: his head is on the ground, STRIKE!
textes.Ses pinces sont coincées dans la roche !: His claws are stuck in the rock! Strike now!
textes.Ses quarante pièces ?! Elle les aura qua: Her forty coins?! She'll get them when the sea runs dry! … What? You insist? Listen to me well, landlubber: either you pay my debt yourself, or you take it from me fair and square, with fists. No one has ever put Gontran Lestrange on the mat. No one.
textes.Sextant, Ionie a besoin d'une carte stel: Sextant, Ionie needs a star chart.
textes.Sextant, avez-vous vu une méduse de ciel: Sextant, have you seen a sky jellyfish?
textes.Si je cligne des yeux lentement, ça veut: If I blink slowly, it means I love you. Don't get used to it.
textes.Si je me souviens de toi ? Je me souvien: Do I remember you? I remember all my customers. Especially the ones who don't pay.
textes.Si je me souviens de toi ? Mais bien sûr: Do I remember you? But of course! My memory is a seashell: everything echoes inside it.
textes.Si le flotteur frétille juste un peu, ne: If the float just wiggles a little, don't move. That's a fish having a taste. Wait until it dives for real.
textes.Si quelqu'un a l'air triste, va lui parl: If someone looks sad, go and talk to them. It always helps. Them and you.
textes.Si ton sac est plein, va vendre ce que t: If your bag is full, go and sell what you don't need at a merchant's.
If you have fish, we can talk.
textes.Si tu coupes un arbre, plantes-en un aut: If you cut down a tree, plant another one. That's all we ask, we elves.
textes.Si tu entends couiner dans ton oreille,: If you hear squeaking in your ear, that's me saying hello.
textes.Si tu grimpes les pitons, repose-toi sur: If you climb the rock spires, rest on the ledges. Even goats take breaks, and they don't have arms.
If you want to make me happy, think of %s. But you didn't hear it from me.
textes.Si tu {le} croises, dis-lui bonjour de m: If you run into {le}, say hello from me.
textes.Si vous {le} croisez, dites-lui bonjour: If you run into {le}, say hello from me.
Sign here. And here. And there. Thank you.
textes.Signez ici. Non : lisez d'abord. TOUJOUR: Sign here. No: read first. ALWAYS read first. (You read.) “The undersigned promises to put books back in their place, not to dog-ear the pages, and to return good humor on the way out.” … You read to the very end. You're the first. Trial of the contract: passed.
textes.Signorina Ravioli m'a appris à chanter p: Signorina Ravioli taught me to sing to the tomatoes. They prefer nursery rhymes.
textes.Sire Orage lève son épée vers le ciel :: Sire Orage raises his sword to the sky: THE STORM BREAKS LOOSE! He'll charge in a gust: when he steps back glowing, move out of his path.
textes.Sire Orage pose un genou à terre… et se: Lord Storm drops to one knee… and dissolves into the wind. The storm calms, the sun returns to the Tower. Far away, on Fire Mountain, the golems fall still. A golden chest appears among the runes.
textes.Sire Orage, le Chevalier des Tempêtes: Lord Storm, the Knight of Storms
textes.Sire Tancrède de Tournevent raconte des: Sir Tancrède de Tournevent tells tales of magnificent feats. All imaginary. He'd finally like to live a real one, with a witness: defeat the goblin chief of the Goblin Wood and bring back his banner.
textes.Sire Tancrède, racontez-moi votre plus g: Sir Tancrède, tell me about your greatest exploit.
textes.Sire Tancrède, votre cape traîne encore: Sire Tancrède, your cloak is dragging in the mud again…
textes.Six bâtons, et droits en plus. Tiens, do: Six sticks, and straight ones too. Here, twelve coins. And your next shovel will cost you less: you're almost family.
Six hundred metres: the Glider has reached its ceiling. Above that is the realm of the stars.
textes.Six pièces le hamac, couverture comprise: Six coins for the hammock, blanket included. My aunt doesn't give credit, and neither do I. Well… she doesn't let me.
textes.Six pièces, mon chou. Même les sorciers: Six coins, dearie. Even wizards pay for their bed. Especially wizards: they set the sheets on fire.
textes.Six sardines de l'aube grillées sur la b: Six dawn sardines grilled over the embers, with cumin and lemon, on the Tazira quay. Restores two hearts.
textes.Soigner ? Oh, mon petit, c'est la plus b: Healing? Oh, my dear, it's the most beautiful of all magic. But first you must learn to know what heals. Go and pick me three mushrooms in the Twisted Wood: the brown ones with white stalks, not the others. The others make you sing off-key.
textes.Soigner la chouette blessée du Bois Tors: Heal the injured owl in the Twisted Wood with the healing spell (key 0 then V, right next to her; in VR, left trigger)
textes.Son blindage arrête tout ! Attends qu'el: Its armor stops everything! Wait until it plants its bucket in the ground: its hoses will be exposed.
textes.Son dos est dur comme la pierre ! Frappe: Its back is hard as stone! Hit the head… or wait until it catches its breath after its tail swing.
textes.Sors de l'eau d'abord !: Get out of the water first!
textes.Sortir de Tazira par la porte du nord, s: Leave Tazira by the north gate, follow the three caravan markers to the north-east (they light up at night), open the tomb of the Walking Dune (the star, the dune, the sun) and take the Seal of Sands
textes.Soucieuse ? Je grelotte, voilà ce que je: Worried? I'm shivering, that's what I am. Me! An archduchess of the underworld! The Ember Heart is dying out, little flame: it's no more than a blue glimmer, and the city is cooling. The cold rises from the Nine Circles, beneath the Forge Cathedral. The Frost Titan has awakened at the bottom of Cocytus, and he has taken the Eternal Flame. Brother Cinder keeps the key to the door. Go down, circle after circle… and bring us back our fire.
textes.Sous l'œil de Khépri, dans un coffret :: Beneath the eye of Khepri, in a small casket: a piece of Osiris!
textes.Sous la Lueur de lune, des lettres d'arg: Under the Moonglow, silver letters appear above the door: four moons, in order. Full, waning, new, waxing.
textes.Sous la Lueur de lune, un des beaux pont: Under the Moonglow, one of the beautiful slate bridges… fades away: it was only an illusion! And other bridges, made of light, appear where there was nothing.
textes.Sous la tête, de la terre, une fourmi, e: Under the head, some earth, an ant, and the ant looks at you as if to say: “This is my home, you know.”
Beneath the Great Temple of Aztlán.
textes.Sous le Temple de Kukulkan s'ouvre le ch: Beneath the Temple of Kukulkan lies the road to Xibalba, the kingdom of the Lords of Death. Ix Kanul, the high priestess, would like someone to go down there like the Twins of the Popol Vuh, and bring back the Jade Mask of the kings of Yaxché.
textes.Sous le banc ! Marcel, il était sous le: Under the bench! Marcel, it was under the bench! … Thanks, kid. Here, a few coins. And whenever you like, we'll teach you how to play.
textes.Sous le beaupré, la Dame de Proue : une: Beneath the bowsprit, the Figurehead Lady: a woman of carved wood, leaning over the waves, her hands clasped over a closed shell. The blue paint of her dress is flaking. She has been watching the sea for two hundred years.
textes.Sous le capot d'une vieille voiture : de: Under the hood of an old car: some coins and two shiny springs. Ferraille had hidden them for a rainy day.
textes.Sous le coussin, tu trouves quelques piè: Under the cushion, you find a few coins, a broken drumstick and a note: “If you're reading this, don't wake me.” You leave the drumstick and the note, but he won't say a word about the coins.
textes.Sous le lit : trois moutons de poussière: Under the bed: three dust bunnies and a marble. Nobody.
textes.Splortch ! Te revoilà dehors, gluant de: Splortch! There you are, outside again, gooey from head to toe. The frog has the hiccups.
textes.Splotch ! Tu t'enfonces dans la boue du: Splotch! You sink into the mud of the Styx… and climb out, sticky, onto the bank. The bubbling slabs won't hold you!
textes.Stick droit : choisir Gâchette : répon: Right stick: choose   Trigger: answer   B: leave
textes.Stick droit : choisir Gâchette : utili: Right stick: select   Trigger: use   Grip: drop   Y: close
textes.Stick gauche : virer, monter, descendre: Left stick: turn, climb, descend; right trigger: faster, left: brake; A: land.
Left stick: turn, climb, descend; triggers: speed; A: land.
textes.Stick gauche pour virer et piquer, A pou: Left stick to turn and dive, A to land.
textes.Suis le rayon du regard : là où il touch: Follow the beam with your eyes: where it hits the wall, that's where it got lost!
textes.Sur l'autel de Serket, dans un coffret :: On the altar of Serket, in a small casket: a piece of Osiris, green as wheat growing back.
textes.Sur l'autel du Soleil des Jaguars : une: On the altar of the Sun of the Jaguars: a tablet engraved with a jaguar's head and four dots. The first sun, the one the jaguars devoured.
textes.Sur l'autel, sous la pluie de feu : la t: On the altar, beneath the rain of fire: the tablet of the Sun of the Rain of Fire, still warm.
textes.Sur la Mouette, Barnabé mesurait tout :: On the Seagull, Barnabé measured everything: the mast, the cook's soup, my beard. Eleven inches. He wrote it on his map, off a little islet: “Octave's beard, eleven inches”. The only accurate thing on that map. Just saying.
textes.Sur la Mouette, pendant trois jours de c: On the Seagull, during three days of dead calm, Octave carved me a walking stick from a bamboo cane. He engraved a little seagull on the handle, and my initials. Backwards: “C. B.”. I never pointed it out to him. It's my favourite walking stick.
textes.Sur la corniche, au sec : la tablette du: On the ledge, out of the wet: the tablet of the Sun of Water, engraved with waves. The sun of the great flood.
textes.Sur la porte, un écriteau : « NE PAS DÉR: On the door, a sign: “DO NOT DISTURB. (Since 1226.)”
textes.Sur la stèle, un soleil gravé et ces mot: On the stele, an engraved sun and these words: “I rise in the east, I burn in the south, I set in the west, and I sleep in the north. Relight my course, and the door will open.”
On the bowl, a label: “Fernand. Do not feed (he lies).”
textes.Sur ma carte des Anciens, à l'est, entre: On my Ancients' map, to the east, between the village and here, there's a patch of mist and a golden eye. I thought it was spilled coffee.
textes.Sur ma carte, j'ai barré le mot « NON »: On my map, I crossed out the word “NO” written three times and put your name there instead. Very small. There wasn't much room.
textes.Sur une ardoise : « Défense de goûter. S: On a slate: “No tasting. Except you, traveler. Just one. — The cheesemaker upstairs”
textes.Survolté ! J'ai bu le jus de quatre noix: Supercharged! I drank the juice of four coconuts. I can see sounds. They're green.
textes.Sylwen ! Ton pain de miel a traversé la: Sylwen! Your honey loaf crossed the mist, you know.
textes.Sylwen nourrit tout le Bois-Doré et se v: Sylwen feeds the whole of Bois-Doré and takes offence if you don't have seconds. I always have seconds. It's a matter of diplomacy.
textes.Sérieusement ? {dernier_cadeau} ? Tu te: Seriously? {dernier_cadeau}? Are you making fun of me, {surnom}?
textes.Sœur Pétronille, la prêtresse du Temple: Sister Pétronille, the priestess of the Temple of Dawn, was praying by the Frog Lake when the biggest giant frog in the lake swallowed her sun rosary. Without it, she doesn't dare go adventuring any more.
textes.Sœur Pétronille, vous voulez que je vous: Sister Pétronille, would you like me to read you something?
textes.T'as de la sauce sur le nez !: You've got sauce on your nose!
textes.T'as renversé mon verre, là. Tu vas me l: You knocked over my glass, there. You're going to pay for it.
textes.TE PRÉSENTER ? Avec plaisir ! Bon, je ne: INTRODUCE YOU? With pleasure! Well, I can't introduce you to everyone, there are too many of us and Tapage would talk for three days. So start with the three pillars of Boucan: Lentille, who feeds everyone at the Canteen, on the ground floor of the Cannery; Rustine, who keeps everything with wheels rolling, at the bike workshop in the Spinning Mill; and Sirène, who quenches everyone's thirst, at the bar of the Howling Hall. Tell them Rouille sent you. They'll give you a… noisy welcome.
textes.TING ! … Dans le berceau : « HIHIHI ! EN: DING! … In the cradle: “HEEHEEHEE! AGAIN! AGAIN! DING!”
textes.TOUCHÉ ! Hi hi hi ! On a gagné ! On reco: TAGGED! Hee hee hee! We won! We can go again whenever you like.
textes.TOUS LES TROIS ?! (Tom saute sur la tabl: ALL THREE?! (Tom jumps on the table and plays until his strings nearly snap.) ♪ And then came a stranger, with fists as hard as bronze, he put all three on the mat: long live the King, the king of fists! ♪ … Here, the King's belt: it belonged to the last champion, forty years ago. No one has worn it since.
textes.TROISIÈME FOIS DANS L'ANNEAU ! Les Seign: THIRD TIME IN THE RING! The Lords of Xibalba are defeated at the ball game, just as the Twins once beat them. “Go then… to the House of Bats.” The door at the back opens.
textes.TROP vite ! Ils vont se décrocher la mâc: TOO fast! They'll dislocate their jaws!
textes.TU AS GAGNÉ ! Devant Bondi ! Bondi a les: YOU WON! Ahead of Bondi! Bondi's ears are all flat, look at him! I'll paint your name at the very top of the board, in lantern letters. Here, the Great Race cup: it's made of Mother Oak wood, and it hasn't left Bondi's side in three years. It'll have a lot of fun with you.
textes.TU AS PÊCHÉ LE POISSON-LUNE DORÉ ?! Gast: YOU CAUGHT THE GOLDEN SUNFISH?! Gaston, fall off your perch, now's the time! You're a legend, {surnom}!
textes.Ta Chanson du Roi de la Bagarre… il lui: Your Song of the Brawl King… is it missing a verse?
textes.Ta hache sent la sève fraîche. Combien d: Your axe smells of fresh sap. How many trees was it again? {nb_arbres}? Leave me one for the shade.
textes.Ta pelle heurte de la pierre… Une trappe: Your shovel strikes stone… A trapdoor engraved with a serpent, with a bronze ring!
textes.Ta épaule, c'est le meilleur poste de vi: Your shoulder is the best lookout post in the archipelago!
textes.Tac. Tac. Tac. Un nain creuse dans le mu: Tap. Tap. Tap. A dwarf is digging through the wall of his own living room.
textes.Taillées par Coralin dans du corail et d: Carved by Coralin from coral and shark teeth, ribbed with mother-of-pearl. As long as they're in your bag, you swim one and a half times faster.
textes.Tant mieux. Ici, on aime les gens qui s': All the better. Around here, we like people who get along.
textes.Tant pis pour toi ! Enfin… tant mieux po: Too bad for you! Well… lucky for you, maybe. Hehe. The offer still stands!
textes.Tant pis. Mais tu rates quelque chose !: Too bad. But you're missing out! Well… the neighbors say not, but you are.
Oh well. It can be glued back together… maybe.
textes.Tant que l'Usine Grise de Lisse & Fils f: As long as the Lisse & Sons Grey Factory keeps building robots, the raids will go on. Mamie Barricade knows that the plans for the Lisse-Center are kept at the very bottom of the factory, underground, guarded by Mr Lisse's favourite machine: the Great Digger. You need to go down the five floors, defeat the machine and bring back the plans.
textes.Tazira, le pont de la Murène Noire: Tazira, the deck of the Murène Noire
textes.Tazira, le port des sables — la criée, l: Tazira, the port of sands — the fish auction, the souk, and the Murène Noire at the quay
textes.Tchoum, il ne grésille pas, c'est la mer: Tchoum, it's not crackling, that's the sea.
Stitch you up? There's nothing to stitch. Come back after your next brawl. It shouldn't be long.
textes.Te revoilà ! Tu as aimé notre cuisine, h: You're back! You liked our cooking, huh? Come back whenever you like!
Back in the fairy kingdom again.
textes.Te revoilà, {surnom}. Les feuilles t'ont: Here you are again, {surnom}. The leaves announced you before your footsteps did.
textes.Te voilà, l'ami des poissons ! {nb_poiss: There you are, friend of the fishes! {nb_poissons} catches, according to Gaston. He counts everything, that bird.
textes.Temple-Passoire\nEntrez, la porte est ou:
Colander Temple
Come in, the door is open (everything is open: it's a colander).
Quiet, please, we're draining.
textes.Tenez, Gédéon. Ces baguettes vous attend: Here, Gédéon. These sticks were waiting for you.
textes.Tes coups le traversent ! Il faudrait un: Your blows go right through it! You'd need a light to reveal what's hiding… (the Moonglow)
textes.Tes coups rebondissent sur le bronze ! S: Your blows bounce off the bronze! If only its gears would jam…
textes.Tes pieds deviennent légers, légers… Ici: Your feet grow light, so light… Here, gravity is taking a nap. Jump!
textes.Thalion t'a encore demandé où tu allais: Did Thalion ask you where you were going again?
textes.Théophraste Filandre m'apprend la téléki: Théophraste Filandre is teaching me telekinesis. Four of his books flew away during the great storm and are stuck where no one can climb: I have to bring them back down.
textes.Tic. Tac. Tic. Tac. Des horloges partout: Tick. Tock. Tick. Tock. Clocks everywhere… and not one shows the same time.
textes.Tiens : une pour maintenant, une pour la: Here: one for now, one for the road. And remember: herbal tea is meant to be sipped slowly, while looking at something beautiful.
textes.Tiens bon, on tangue un peu !: Hold on tight, we're rocking a bit!
textes.Tiens, Barbe-de-Fer. Toujours à refondre: Well, well, Barbe-de-Fer. Still melting down other people's work?
textes.Tiens, des pièces, et deux jarres de la: Here, some coins, and two jars of Mérit's date juice. And if one day you want to fish, my boat is yours.
textes.Tiens, des pièces, et du copal pour le t: Here, some coins, and copal for the temple: they say the gods love the smell of flowers and copal together.
textes.Tiens, des pièces. Des vraies, des ronde: Here, some coins. Real ones, round ones. And a patch, just in case. You never know when you'll get a flat. A tyre, I mean.
Here, keep this one as a souvenir.
textes.Tiens, goûte. … Alors ? Je le savais. Le: Here, taste. … Well? I knew it. The saffron comes from Aïcha's, the preserved lemon from my mother's, and the sea bream… from yours. Take one for the road, and these few coins. And come back on Friday.
textes.Tiens, mon chou : deux potions de mana,: Here, dearie: two mana potions, for your trouble. They're surely magic. These ones, I'm almost sure.
textes.Tiens, quelques pièces, et deux bols de: Here, a few coins, and two bowls of soup to take away. They're in jars, with a lid. Copeau made the lids. Out of pallets, of course.
textes.Tiens, te revoilà, {surnom} ! Ça fait {a: Well, look who's back, {surnom}! It's been {absence}. Gaston thought the crabs had eaten you.
Here, hold the pot. … (You hold the pot. He gets paint everywhere. Mostly on you.) … Perfect! Here, for the helping hand.
textes.Tiens, tiens… Venez donc m'expliquer, vo: Well, well… Come and explain yourself, you.
textes.Tiens, tiens… Viens donc m'expliquer, to: Well, well… Come and explain yourself, you.
textes.Tiens, un gâteau de miel de Bobor, que j: Here, a Bobor honey cake that I was saving for myself. I'm giving it to you: you did the hardest part, I only did the planting.
Here, a corn cake from Ix Chab.
textes.Tiens, une petite carte de ton portrait,: Here, a little card of your portrait, as a souvenir!
textes.Tiens, une petite fusée de remerciement…: Here, a little thank-you rocket… no, some coins, rather. Rockets are for the party.
textes.Tiens, {dernier_cadeau}. Hmm. Merci, je: Well, {dernier_cadeau}. Hmm. Thanks, I suppose. I'm sure I'll find a use for it.
textes.Tiens, {surnom} ! Monte, j'ai du neuf. E: Well, {surnom}! Come on up, I've got new stock. Well, the same stock.
Here. Hang it above your bed. And if you ever have a nightmare, come tell me: I'll strengthen the net.
textes.Tiens. Des pièces, et trois flacons de m: Here. Some coins, and three flasks of my tonic: honey, fever grass, syrup and a secret. One sip, and you get back up from any brawl. Well, almost any.
textes.Titou, ton pas de danse, là, c'est quoi: Titou, that dance step of yours, what is it?
textes.Tobias, le calfat, doit reboucher une vo: Tobias, the caulker, has to patch a leak in the hull of the Léviathan. He needs good timber.
textes.Toc toc ! … Ah non, c'est toi qui frappe: Knock knock! … Oh no, you're the one knocking. Shall we start over?
textes.Toc toc toc ? Hé, c'est MOI qui fais les: Knock knock knock? Hey, I'M the one who tells the jokes around here!
textes.Toc toc… (Une voix ensommeillée, derrièr: Knock knock… (A sleepy voice, behind the door.) “Who's there? … Ah, it's you. We're asleep, it's night! Come back tomorrow, we'll look for the colours together.”
textes.Toc toc… La Maison du Conseil est fermée: Knock knock… The Council House is closed. A poster: “Extraordinary meeting: WHERE HAVE OUR COLOURS GONE? Everyone is asked to search everywhere.”
textes.Toc toc… Personne : de jour, tout le mon: Knock knock… Nobody: by day, everyone is out looking for the colour pots.
textes.Toc toc… Personne. Sur la porte, un peti: Knock knock… Nobody. On the door, a little note: “Gone to find the blue of the sky. Back soon! — the Brush family”
textes.Toc toc… Personne. Un mot un peu taché :: Knock knock… Nobody. A slightly smudged note: “Gone to find the red of the poppies. Please water our flowers, thanks! — the Blotter family”
textes.Toc toc… Personne. Un petit mot : « Part: Knock knock… Nobody. A little note: “Gone to find the green of the leaves. Don't erase anything while we're away! — the Rubber family”
textes.Toc, toc, toc. Une petite voix, derrière: Knock, knock, knock. A little voice, behind the door: "
textes.Toc, toc. Le seul qui répond, c'est la p: Knock, knock. The only one answering is the rain on the roof: tic, tic, tic…
textes.Toc, toc. Rien… Un écriteau peint : « En: Knock, knock. Nothing… A painted sign: “Meditating. Come back in an hour, or in a lifetime.”
textes.Toc, toc… Personne. Sur la porte, un pet: Knock, knock… Nobody. On the door, a little note: “Gone to pick poppies. Come back whenever you like, the door of the heart is always open (this one, not so much).”
textes.Toc, toc… Rien. Puis, de très loin dans: Knock, knock… Nothing. Then, from deep inside the yurt, a sleepy voice: “… It's not time for rehearsal yet…”
textes.Toi ! Ne crois pas que je ne sais pas ce: You! Don't think I don't know what you did.
textes.Toi ! Tu tombes bien ! Dis-lui, toi :: You! Just in time! Tell him, would you:
textes.Toi ? Dans les Neuf Cercles ? (Le vieux: You? Into the Nine Circles? (The old guardian looks at you for a long time, then unhooks a big black key from his belt.) The Key of the Ember. The door is at the back of the nave. Listen well: a coin for Charon, honey cakes for Cerberus, good answers for Minos. And take a coat, little one. Cocytus is no joke.
textes.Toi ?! Sur MA scène ? … D'accord. Vas-y,: You?! On MY stage? … Fine. Go ahead, the audience is hot. Well, warm. Well, it's made of stone.
textes.Toi qui as vu du pays, dis-moi francheme: You've seen the world, so tell me honestly: can a map be wrong?
textes.Toi qui dis qu'une bonne carte ne se tro: You, who say a good map is never wrong… you're my only ally on this island. Along with Gaston, on the days he agrees.
textes.Toi qui dis qu'une dette, ça se paie tou: You say a debt always gets paid: you still owe me one visit a week. I'm writing it down.
textes.Toi qui disais qu'une dette, ça se pardo: You said a debt can be forgiven… I'm thinking about it. Slowly. Don't rush me: iron doesn't like that either.
textes.Toi qui voulais visiter toutes les îles,: You wanted to visit every island, and it looks like you've come a long way. Will you tell me about the ones I don't know?
textes.Toi, t'as une tête qui ne me revient pas: I don't like the look of you.
textes.Toi, tu as assez bu pour aujourd'hui. Un: You, you've had enough to drink for today. A glass of water, and off to bed!
textes.Toi, ça fait longtemps que je voulais te: You, I've been wanting to tell you this for ages!
textes.Tom le Violoneux chantera la gloire de c: Tom the Fiddler will sing the glory of whoever knocks down the port's three champions with their fists: Gros-Louis of the Requin Borgne, the Mute of the Veuve Écarlate and Belle-Humeur of the Morue Enragée.
textes.Tom va en faire une chanson !: Tom's going to make a song out of this!
textes.Tombée d'un cocotier abattu. Son lait re: Fallen from a felled coconut palm. Its milk restores one heart.
textes.Ton ami. Hmpf. Chacun ses fréquentations: Your friend. Hmph. Each to their own company. As long as you pay…
textes.Ton carnet de voyage a rencontré un prob:
Your travel journal ran into a problem.
A “cheap” program turned everything upside down.
textes.Ton carnet est très, très lent. Clique i: Your journal is very, very slow. Click here to speed it up (promise).
textes.Ton carnet garde tout ce qu'on te demand: Your journal keeps track of everything you're asked. Read it again when you don't know where to go.
textes.Ton chat a besoin d'une mise à jour. Tu: Your cat needs an update. You don't have a cat? It needs one anyway.
textes.Ton chat… je peux le chercher ?: Your cat… can I look for it?
textes.Ton cœur bat fort et ton souffle est ple: Your heart beats strong and your breath is full. Ra has nothing to give you today… except his light, and that one is free.
Your kapok tree is laughing, you know.
textes.Ton moustique… tu me le prêterais ?: Your mosquito… would you lend it to me?
textes.Ton perroquet… je peux le chercher ?: Your parrot… can I look for it?
textes.Ton record, c'est {record} ? Moi, une fo: Your record is {record}? I once caught a whale. Well, it was a rock. But it looked like a whale.
textes.Ton sac déborde. Fais de la place, et re: Your bag is overflowing. Make some room, then come back.
textes.Ton sac est plein ! Fais de la place ava: Your bag is full! Make some room before opening the chest: its contents will wait for you.
Your bag is full! Make some room before opening the chest.
textes.Ton sac est plein ! Fais de la place pou: Your bag is full! Make room for the Pearl of Light.
Your bag is full! Make room for the wand.
Your bag is full! Make room for the flower.
textes.Ton sac est plein ! Fais un peu de place: Your bag is full! Make a little room for the fragment.
Your bag is full! Make a little room for the seal.
Your bag is full! Make a little room, then come back.
Your bag is full! Make a little room.
textes.Ton sac est plein ! Trocante rit : « Alo: Your bag is full! Trocante laughs: “Then give something first!”
textes.Ton sac est plein : Lentille te fait boi: Your bag is full: Lentille has you drink the soup right there, from the ladle. It does you good.
textes.Ton sac est plein : fais-y un peu de pla: Your bag is full: make a little room for the colour pot.
textes.Ton sac est plein : le sifflet des compa: Your bag is full: the Companions' Whistle is waiting for you. Make some room!
textes.Ton sac est plein de virus ! (Ça, c'est: Your bag is full of viruses! (That one's true. It's me.)
textes.Ton sac est plein à craquer : fais-lui u: Your bag is bursting: make a little room for the cloth.
Your island is pretty. Noisy, but pretty. The trees here are young: they don't talk much yet.
textes.Toni n'a plus de noix de coco pour son c: Toni has run out of coconuts for his famous punch.
Always BOOM. At least it's consistent. Science marches on!
textes.Tourne les cristaux ! Chacun renvoie la: Turn the crystals! Each one sends the light in the direction it points.
textes.Tous les chats accourent ! La dame est r: All the cats come running! The lady is delighted: “You've been adopted. By them. It's an honor!”
textes.Tous les quatre ! Le traité des nuages,: All four! The treatise on clouds, the herbal of shadows, the grammar of ravens and… “Berthe's Recipes, Volume Two.” I'd forgotten that one. Thank you. Truly. Here, some coins. And you may borrow any book you like, whenever you like. Without dog-earing it.
textes.Tous les soirs, j'agite mon chapeau vers: Every evening, I wave my hat towards the mist. Nobody ever answers. Except once: a lantern blinked three times, high up in the trees. Gaston says it was a firefly. Me, I'm sure it was Faelar. Old folks understand each other.
textes.Tous les soirs, je monte sur ma plus hau: Every evening, I climb onto my highest branch and look across to the other side of the island. I check that the smoke from his hut is rising. If it is, I climb back down. I don't know why I do it. Neither does Clou.
textes.Tous les soirs, mademoiselle ! Un jour,: Every evening, miss! One day, someone will answer.
textes.Tous les trois ! Et chauds encore, je pa: All three! And still warm, I bet. You're a darling, my little one. Here, some coins, and a nice warm honey bread. That one, you're allowed to eat on the way.
textes.Tous trouvés ! Tu es le champion du cach: All found! You're the hide-and-seek champion!
Everything is for sale! … Well, almost.
textes.Tout flotte ! La table, les chaises, les: Everything floats! The table, the chairs, the books… even the houseplant, which looks delighted.
textes.Tout le monde parle de ce que tu as fait: Everyone's talking about what you did for {qn}.
textes.Tout le monde parle de ce que vous avez: Everyone's talking about what you did for {qn}.
textes.Tout le monde sait que tu as offert {obj: Everyone knows you gave {objet} to {qn}. Around here, news travels faster than the wind.
textes.Tout le monde sait que vous avez offert: Everyone knows you gave {objet} to {qn}. Around here, news travels faster than the wind.
textes.Tout là-haut, au sommet du Mont Fusain,: Way up, at the summit of Mount Charcoal, beside the cairn: a little glint. Purple. A pot!
Everything looks lovely to me today.
textes.Tout tourne… Tu ferais mieux de t'arrête: Everything's spinning… you'd better stop there!
textes.Tout ça ? D'accord. {prix} pièces le lot: All that? Alright. {prix} coins for the lot. You're getting a good deal, and I'm getting a better one.
textes.Toute la caverne chante, d'une seule voi: The whole cavern sings, with one low, soft voice. The veins of the rock light up all the way to the ceiling… At the back of the room, the great slab sinks into the floor. “The Heart of the Song is yours, friend of the Moai.”
textes.Toute la forge se tait. Borin et Nori le: The whole forge falls silent. Borin and Nori the Runecarver engrave the armour for an entire night. By morning, the runes beat softly, like a heart. “The finest I've ever made.”
textes.Toute ma vie, j'ai cherché la cité englo: All my life, I've searched for the sunken city. The texts speak of a great crystal that gave air and light. If one day you find that city, if you see that crystal shining… come back and tell me about it. I beg you.
textes.Toutes ? Il en faudrait peut-être quatre: Every one? There may be four hundred… But I like your answer. You have human feet and the heart of a migrating bird.
textes.Toutes ? Même… la reine ? Oh ! J'ai les: All of them? Even… the queen? Oh! I have tears in my eyes. You carried a little of my heart to the end of the world. Take a little of mine: it's big, I have too much.
textes.Toutes les couleurs de l'île: All the colours of the island
textes.Toutes les journées sont belles, au Bois: Every day is lovely, in Bois-Doré.
textes.Toutes les yourtes sont vides… Où sont d: All the yurts are empty… Where have the people of Larsen Island gone? It looks like they're preparing something.
textes.Toutes… Toutes les couleurs. (Elle regar: All… All the colours. (She looks at the clearing, the giants, the houses, the sky in the pond, for a long time, saying nothing.) The Council met this morning. Well, Gaspard, Augustin and I, on the terrace. We voted. From now on, you will be the Colourist of Sketched Island. Keep the Brush: it's yours now. And if one day it rains too hard, you'll know what to do. Here, also: a honey cake from Rosalie, and a little from the Council's fund. It was only used for buying paint.
textes.Tranquille, Barnabé. Plancher, murs, toi: Chill, Barnabé. Floor, walls, roof. And a bottle of water.
textes.Tranquille. Tu veux de l'eau ? J'ai touj: Chill. Want some water? I've always got water.
textes.Traverser le Lac Miroir sur un chemin de: Cross Mirror Lake on a path of ice (frost spell, key 7 then V, facing the islet; in VR, left trigger) and touch the Frost Crystal (E)
textes.Trente mètres de haut : il se cache derr: Thirty meters tall: what's he going to hide behind?
textes.Trente secondes ! Personne ne t'a touché: Thirty seconds! Nobody touched you! … You've got eyes in the back of your head, haven't you?
textes.Triste ? Je suis… aveugle, presque. (Il: Sad? I'm... practically blind. (He points to the big telescope.) The last meteor shower. A little meteorite fragment, the size of a hazelnut, fell right into the tube. Three cracked lenses. I see the stars in three pieces. The Big Dipper looks like three little angry bears. I'd need three meteorite fragments to melt down new lenses. They fell everywhere that night: on the Agora, in the Hanging Gardens, at the Spaceport... Would you look for them? They're black, heavy, and they still glow a little.
textes.Trocante pose ton objet sur la table, bi: Trocante puts your item on the table, nice and visible: “Thank you! Somebody is going to be so happy.”
textes.Trois ! Ils sont encore tièdes… (Il les: Three! They're still warm... (He melts them in a little light furnace, blows on them, polishes them with his cape.) Three new lenses. (He presses his eye to the telescope.) Oh... Oh! The Big Dipper is a single bear again! She looks relieved. Come back tonight, during the auroras. I want to show you something.
textes.Trois amis à table, pliés de rire. Perso: Three friends at the table, doubled over with laughter. Nobody has noticed you.
textes.Trois compagnons, c'est déjà une petite: Three companions is already quite a crowd! You'll have to send one to rest at the Guild first.
textes.Trois contrats à la fois, pas plus : c'e: Three contracts at a time, no more: that's the rule (and Églantine knows it by heart).
textes.Trois cristaux, deux fragments, quatre e: Three crystals, two fragments, four gears, two rolls of sailcloth! (She disappears into the hangar. Sounds of wrenches, glowing welding, a “clack”, an “oops”, another “clack”.) It's coming along! The hull is done, the engine is purring. Now I need the navigation: the Professor's hologram chip, and a star chart from Sextant.
textes.Trois dés d'os qui roulent un peu… mieux: Three bone dice that roll a little… better than the others, sold on the sly by Isaac Cinq-Doigts. You can play dice with them. But if the pirate across from you notices (one time in three), it's a brawl.
textes.Trois flammes rouges qui ne brûlent pas: Three red flames that don't burn! A dry voice in the dark: “Our torches are… whole?” The Lords are furious, but the door opens.
textes.Trois flammes. Le sol vibre très légèrem: Three flames. The floor trembles ever so slightly.
Three times. I wasn't going anywhere.
textes.Trois fois. La reine m'a dit que l'arbre: Three times. The queen told me the tree was sick. I hope someone will help it…
textes.Trois galettes de maïs encore chaudes, c: Three corn cakes still warm, cooked on Ix Chab's clay griddle, folded around a few beans and some chilli. Restores two hearts.
textes.Trois graffitis ! Pigment va être fière: Three graffitis! Pigment is going to be proud of you.
textes.Trois graffitis sur les murs du Boucan: Three graffiti on the walls of Boucan
textes.Trois grands tournesols du jardin de Mam: Three tall sunflowers from Granny Sunflower's garden, tied with a yellow ribbon. They turn their heads towards you, as if towards the sun.
textes.Trois grognements, trois paires d'yeux d: Three growls, three pairs of glowing eyes… CERBÈRE, the three-headed dog, rises from his straw! (They say he loves honey cakes. One per head.)
Three hours with the comb, every morning.
textes.Trois jours d'anneaux, un par un. Ursule: Three days of rings, one by one. Ursule hands you the chain mail: heavy, supple, cold. “Put it on. Stand straight. Good.”
textes.Trois lampes, trois « clac » : la porte: Three lamps, three “clacks”: the south door sinks into the floor with a rumble. The stairs lead down to the Underground Lake.
textes.Trois noix de coco, et mon punch revit !: Three coconuts, and my punch lives again! The jungle boat hasn't come by. You can find some at Colette's, or under the coconut palms in the jungle.
textes.Trois paniers ! Des poireaux, des courge: Three baskets! Leeks, squashes, potatoes, and... (He pulls out a bitten carrot.) A carrot. Just one. I told you I'd be counting! Ha ha! (He pours everything into the pot.) Tonight, everybody's soup! Because it's made by everybody, and for everybody. And a little bit by you.
textes.Trois personnes sont assises en silence: Three people sit in silence on colored mats. A soft voice murmurs: “Breathe…”
textes.Trois petits Moaïs, alignés, très concen: Three little Moai, lined up, concentrating hard, make a grimace. Well… they try.
Three coins for the temple offering. The gods are not stingy, but the temple has lamps to fill.
textes.Trois pièces, mon cœur. La brume de la b: Three coins, my dear. The mist in the ball doesn't clear for nothing.
textes.Trois pour toi, deux pour moi, un pour G: Three for you, two for me, one for Gaston. That's family!
Three glasses of tea! You feel refreshed.
textes.Trois verres, c'est la tradition ! Le qu: Three glasses, that's the tradition! The fourth is for the greedy ones… Come back tomorrow, I'll make a new pot.
textes.Trois étoiles de mer orange, au fond de: Three orange starfish, at the bottom of the bay, in front of the beach. Bring all three back up and I'll recognise you as a true diver. No mask needed, just breath. Go on, champ!
textes.Trois, un, deux… Un déclic, puis un long: Three, one, two… A click, then a long clatter: the round door starts turning on itself, like a gear… and rolls aside!
textes.Trois… quatre… cinq moutons… six… un mou: Three… four… five sheep… six… a sheep riding a bike…
textes.Trompé de porte… C'est vrai qu'elles se: Wrong door… It's true they all look alike on this street. Go on, off you go. And close it properly behind you!
textes.Trop bas pour t'envoler : l'Alouette ne: Too low to take off: the Alouette only launches from a high point. You need twelve metres of empty space beneath you: a cliff edge, a tower, the launch pad of the Wing Workshop… or jump first, and unfold it mid-fall!
textes.Trop loin du rivage : approchez un ponto: Too far from shore: get close to a jetty or a beach.
textes.Trop long… La Grande Course est finie sa: Too slow… The Great Race is over without you. Come back to the Games Clearing for a rematch.
textes.Trop tard ! Les anneaux s'éteignent un i: Too late! The rings go dark for a moment, then light up again. We start over from the first.
textes.Troquer la fiole de brume avec Ursule, l: Swap the vial of mist with Ursule, the blacksmith (the bears' forge, south-east of the village)
textes.Troquer la plume de lune avec Pivoine, l: Swap the moon feather with Pivoine, the herbalist, at the Herb Stall (halfway up the Mother Oak)
textes.Troquer le caillou-qui-chante avec Pomme: Swap the singing-stone with Pomme-de-Pin, the bridge carpenter (on the western tree in the morning, near the big pond in the afternoon)
textes.Troquer le gland d'or avec Plumette, à l: Swap the golden acorn with Plumette, at the Post Office, right at the top of the Mother Oak
textes.Trouver Brioche, la chatte rousse et bla: Find Brioche, the ginger-and-white cat, on the harbour rooftops (near the fishmonger's and the harbour master's office), show her the ball of wool and let her come to you: she's the one who chooses
textes.Trouver Monsieur Paille, l'épouvantail,: Find Mr Paille, the scarecrow, in the middle of the White Meadows (east of the village), and take the pot of red at his feet
textes.Trouver deux morceaux de la carte : dans: Find two pieces of the map: in the keep of the Cursed Fort (on the eastern point) and in the graveyard mausoleum (on the western hill) — watch out for skeletons, especially at night
textes.Trouver l'Atlantide et rallumer son Gran: Find Atlantis and rekindle its Great Crystal
textes.Trouver l'entrée du temple sous le villa: Find the entrance to the temple under the village (a hidden trapdoor)
textes.Trouver la Bergerie du Vent, au pied du: Find the Wind Sheepfold, at the foot of Stoneheart south-east of Cliquetis, burn its brambles with the Flame (key 2 then X; in VR, B), and take the Bronze Seal
