textes.Trouver la Souche Creuse, au fond du Boi: Find the Hollow Stump, deep in the Hatching Wood (to the west, at the end of the woodland path), and take the pot of green from it
textes.Trouver le calme au Jardin Zen: Find peace in the Zen Garden
textes.Trouver le grand château de sable de l'A: Find the big Averse sandcastle, at the far end of the White Strand (to the west), and take the pot of yellow at the foot of its tower
textes.Trouver trois lots de pièces de vélo cac: Find three batches of bike parts hidden in the Scrapyard (in the south-east of the island, under the scrap heaps)
textes.Trouver une première Perle de Lumière: Find a first Pearl of Light
textes.Trouvé ! Zut ! T'es trop fort. Tiens, po: Found! Darn! You're too good. Here, for the winner!
textes.Truffe ? Ce petit diable ? (Elle soupire: Truffe? That little devil? (She sighs, but she's smiling.) This morning I saw him go past Clovis's mill at a full gallop, snout in the grass. His little bell must have come off over there: I heard it jingle, then nothing. Find it. Truffe knows its jingle: when he hears it, he comes running. It's the snack-time bell. I used to shake it to call him when he was tiny. He's still tiny, mind you. Except for his appetite.
textes.Truffe a le groin d'or : une truffe tout: Truffle has a golden snout: a fresh truffle just for you!
textes.Truffe accourt en couinant de joie, la q: Truffle rushes over squealing with joy, tail in a corkscrew.
textes.Truffe frétille de la queue au groin, fa: Truffle wiggles from tail to snout, does a little hop for joy and presses his nose against your hand. Oink!
textes.Truffe monte dans la barque (elle tangue: Truffle climbs into the boat (it rocks a little) and sits at the front, snout in the wind.
textes.Truffe renifle, renifle… et creuse comme: Truffle sniffs and sniffs… and digs like mad! He brings you a black truffle that smells of the forest.
textes.Truffe rentre à la maison en grognant do: Truffle goes home grunting softly. There must be apples there.
textes.Truffe, le plus petit des cochons de la: Truffe, the smallest of the pigs on Old Man Gaubert's farm, pink and black, runs away every day to root around in the woods at the edge of the Southern Fields. He digs up truffles… and the turnips. Old Man Gaubert, with his knees, can't catch him any more, and his little bell has fallen off. He's looking for someone who likes walking to take him along.
textes.Très bien ! J'ai trouvé ce matin un cail: Very well! This morning I found a pebble that looks exactly like my Aunt Ursule. Except for the hat.
textes.Tu agites la plume. « MILLE SABORDS ! »: You wave the feather. “BLISTERING BARNACLES!” cries a voice in the distance. Or was it you who said it?
textes.Tu agites ton mouchoir rouge vers le cie: You wave your red handkerchief at the sky… A purr of propellers answers, far away. The Albatros is coming!
textes.Tu agrippes la chaîne et te hisses, mail: You grab the chain and haul yourself up, link after link…
textes.Tu allumes la torche… elle flambe, se co: You light the torch… it blazes, burns down, and falls to ashes. A laugh in the dark: “Give us back our torch WHOLE, tomorrow morning!” (It would have to shine without burning. The Twins had used red feathers.)
textes.Tu as PERDU ma canne ?! Sapristi… Bon. J: You LOST my rod?! Blimey… Right. I've got another one, cut from the same bamboo. Don't tell anyone: the other one was the real one.
textes.Tu as abattu le Crabe-Roi ?! … Tu me rev: You took down the King Crab?! … Will you sell me its shell? No? Shame. I'd have made shields out of it.
textes.Tu as aidé {qn} ! {Il} me l'a raconté. J: You helped {qn}! {Il} told me all about it. I won't forget it, {surnom}.
textes.Tu as du fromage ? Même un petit bout ?: Got any cheese? Even a little bit? Even a whiff of cheese?
textes.Tu as déjà creusé ici. Essaie un peu plu: You've already dug here. Try a bit further away.
textes.Tu as déjà fait ta part ! Et tu as encor: You've already done your share! And you still have paint in your hair.
textes.Tu as déjà pris trois tomates. Il faut e: You've already taken three tomatoes. You have to leave some for the sauce (and for the others).
textes.Tu as déjà pris un objet aujourd'hui. De: You've already taken an item today. Tomorrow, the table will have changed!
textes.Tu as déjà ta thermos, petit gourmand !: You already have your thermos, little glutton! Come back tomorrow, I'll make more.
textes.Tu as déterré le coffre de la Mouette !: You dug up the Seagull's chest! I always said so: the map was right. That rock was in the wrong place, that's all.
textes.Tu as déterré le coffre de la Mouette. J: You dug up the Seagull's chest. I… I've got nothing to say. Actually I do: sixty percent. No? Fine.
textes.Tu as eu l'occasion de lui parler, depui: Have you had a chance to talk to them since?
textes.Tu as fait la connaissance de {qn}, il p: You've met {qn}, I hear. What do you think?
textes.Tu as frappé {qn} ? Ça ne se fait pas. T: You hit {qn}? That's just not done. Everyone's talking about it.
textes.Tu as frappé {qn} ?! On m'a tout raconté: You hit {qn}?! I've heard everything. You've got some nerve coming to talk to me.
textes.Tu as frappé {qn}, à ce qu'on dit. Je ne: You hit {qn}, so they say. I'm not saying it was deserved. I'm not saying it wasn't.
textes.Tu as gagné un poney en chocolat. Il fon: You won a chocolate pony. It melts fast: hurry!
textes.Tu as goûté le thé de Mamie Kiku ? Il ré: Have you tried Mamie Kiku's tea? It warms you down to your toes.
textes.Tu as gâté {qn}, à ce qu'on raconte. Ceu: Word is you spoiled {qn}. Anyone who's kind to my folks is welcome at my place.
textes.Tu as jugé, le grand. Un nain n'oublie j: You've passed judgement, tall one. A dwarf never forgets a judgement. Nor the person who gave it. … Come back anyway, go on.
textes.Tu as l'air épuisé, {surnom}. Assieds-to: You look exhausted, {surnom}. Sit down under the leaves. Here, nothing can reach you.
textes.Tu as l'impression que les petits Moaïs: You feel like the little Moai at the back have moved. But no. … Did they?
You have your head on upside down.
textes.Tu as le nez fin ! Pas de soupe ! Les pa: You've got a good nose! No soup! The vegetable baskets from the Shared Gardens haven't arrived. Radis prepared them this morning, but he had to leave them in the plots: he was interrogating his carrots. My pot is empty, and an empty pot echoes. Go to the Shared Gardens, east of town, near the Boxes, and bring me three baskets. Don't eat them on the way! Well... one carrot. Just one. I'll be counting.
textes.Tu as les deux yeux de corail ! Il ne re: You have both coral eyes! All that's left is to give them back to the Great Moai, in the middle of the Elders' Plateau.
textes.Tu as mis le pied sur l'île des nains ?!: You set foot on the dwarves' island?! Me, in sixty years at sea, never. Bring me back a pebble from their volcano so I can show it to Octave.
textes.Tu as offert {objet} à {qn} ? Tout le mo: You gave {objet} to {qn}? Everyone knows {il} can't stand that. I'm still laughing.
textes.Tu as plongé jusqu'à la ville engloutie: You dived all the way down to the sunken city?! My grandfather was right! I have to redraw all my maps. All of them!
textes.Tu as pris la fuite… Ils s'en souviendro: You ran away… They'll remember that.
textes.Tu as quitté la Grande Course… Les coure: You left the Great Race… The runners head back to the Games Clearing.
You're right not to judge too quickly.
textes.Tu as remarqué. (Elle pose sa main sur l: You noticed. (She places her hand on yours; it's light as a leaf.) The bridges are flickering, the fountain can't choose between two planets, and the Spire beats more weakly. The Heart is fading, my little star. It's very old: it came from Ondelune with us. Last night, three shards broke off and fell onto the island. Without them, it beats like a tired heart. And if the Heart stops… (She smiles.) We won't fly away. We'll fall. Gently, I hope. I don't like big falls at my age. Go see Volt, at the foot of the Spire. He pretends everything is fine. He knows everything. Help him.
textes.Tu as remonté une vieille botte ? Montre: You reeled in an old boot? Show me! … It's mine! I've been looking for it since the shipwreck. Bring it to me, please.
textes.Tu as rencontré Aëlwen ? Elle m'a soigné: Have you met Aëlwen? She healed me when I was little. Her potions are bitter, but they work.
textes.Tu as réussi ! Mais attention… la Reine: You did it! But careful… the Bramble Queen is waiting for us at the end of this corridor. I'll stay close to you.
textes.Tu as tout ce qu'il faut. On le fait ?: You have everything you need. Shall we do it?
textes.Tu as traversé le Lac Noir ! Derrière to: You crossed the Black Lake! Behind you, the false slabs sink for good: the path of the Ancients stays marked out.
textes.Tu as traversé le gouffre ! Sous tes pie: You crossed the chasm! Under your feet, a flagstone sinks a notch: the grate at the back creaks open.
textes.Tu as trouvé Pixel et Quark ! Va dire à: You found Pixel and Quark! Go and tell Pixel the game is over.
textes.Tu as un cœur d'elfe, {surnom}. Je garde: You have an elf's heart, {surnom}. I'll keep {dernier_cadeau} close to me.
textes.Tu as un péché mignon ?: Do you have a guilty pleasure?
textes.Tu as une histoire à me raconter ?: Do you have a story to tell me?
textes.Tu as une mine affreuse, {surnom}. Tu t': You look dreadful, {surnom}. Did you pick a fight with a rock spire? Eat something, for goodness' sake.
textes.Tu as une tête de déterré, {surnom}. Ass: You look like something dug up from a grave, {surnom}. Sit down. And eat something before you fall off my ladder.
textes.Tu as vaincu le Serpent des Abysses ?! L: You defeated the Serpent of the Abyss?! The elders of my people will talk about it for a hundred years. Well… a hundred years isn't that long.
textes.Tu as vaincu le Serpent des Abysses… Bar: You defeated the Abyssal Serpent… Barnabé will make a forty-verse song out of it. Me, I'll just say: well done, {surnom}.
textes.Tu as vu ? Au milieu des aurores, à trav: You saw? In the middle of the auroras, through my new lenses... (He lets you look.) There. A tiny little star, at the edge of the sky. Ondelune's sun. You can only see it on aurora nights, when the sky is washed clean. I wanted someone from down below to see it too. Now there are two of us. Here: an astral crystal, and a star elixir. The crystal is for your machines. The elixir is for the evenings when you feel far from home.
textes.Tu as vu ? Tu as VU ? J'ai regardé le co: Did you see? Did you SEE? I watched the whole concert. Sitting in the grass. Without carrying a single crate. (He laughs, a real laugh.) Twenty years of touring, and it's on a little island that I got my first concert back. Thank you. Here: a share of the roadies' fund, two Spleen chocolates, and a title. Not an official one. We voted for it, by show of hands, last night. Unanimous, minus Grésil, who was asleep.
textes.Tu as vu Nimiel ? Elle est encore montée: Did you see Nimiel? She climbed onto the footbridge with no hands again.
textes.Tu as vu la lumière, ce matin ? L'Arbre-: Did you see the light this morning? The Mother Tree was all golden.
textes.Tu as vu la tête de pierre à moitié ente: Have you seen the stone head half-buried west of the gorge? Clou won't go near it. He says it echoes, right next to it. Take a shovel… and a sword.
textes.Tu as vu le Grand Moaï, au milieu ? Il a: Have you seen the Great Moai, in the middle? He has a staircase in his belly!
textes.Tu as vu ma queue ? Elle fait des tire-b: Did you see my tail? It makes corkscrews when I'm happy.
textes.Tu aurais encore un champignon des fées: Would you happen to have another fairy mushroom?
textes.Tu aurais une graine dorée ?: Would you have a golden seed?
textes.Tu bascules la louche géante dans la Mar: You tip the giant ladle into the Cooking Pot, blow for a long time, and taste… Mmm! A perfect tomato sauce: garlic, basil, a hint of sugar. You fill a little jar.
textes.Tu boucles la ceinture et tu bombes le t: You buckle the belt and puff out your chest. Somewhere, Tom the Fiddler launches into the last verse of his song.
textes.Tu boucles les sangles de la selle naine: You buckle the straps of the dwarven saddle. Ventaile rises, proud, and offers you a golden feather. She is yours, and you are hers.
You move: the line goes back up.
textes.Tu branches la vieille guitare et tu t'a: You plug in the old guitar and step up to the amp… EEEEEEEEEEEEE! A terrible squeal: it's the Larsen effect! (That's where the island's name comes from.)
textes.Tu connais du monde, ici ?: Do you know many people here?
textes.Tu crois qu'elle est grande, la mer ?: Do you think the sea is big?
textes.Tu crois qu'ils sont vrais, les champign: Do you think Lulu's mushrooms are real?
textes.Tu croques le champignon de Lulu… Il a u: You nibble Lulu's mushroom… It tastes of honey and rain. Everything starts to turn gently, the colours begin to sing, and the world dissolves into a golden light…
textes.Tu cueilles une tomate cœur-de-bœuf, lou: You pick an oxheart tomato, heavy and warm from the sun. It smells of green leaves and summer.
textes.Tu descends l'escalier de la Cathédrale-: You go down the stairs of the Forge Cathedral. The air grows cooler with every step… At the bottom, a door, and an inscription in letters of fire.
textes.Tu descends l'escalier de la vieille tou: You go down the stairs of the old tower. The steps sink into the dark, the air smells of moss and… jelly? Below, a hall, a set of rules, and a blue crystal.
You climb down the ladder… for a long time.
textes.Tu descends sous le Grand Temple. Sur le: You go down beneath the Great Temple. On the walls, Tlaloc and Huitzilopochtli watch you pass; somewhere below, a drum beats like a heart.
textes.Tu descends, longtemps, dans le ventre d: You descend, for a long time, into the belly of the Temple of Kukulkan. The air turns damp and cold. On the walls, the Feathered Serpent descends with you… and two young people, a blowgun in hand: the Twins.
textes.Tu disais que le temps efface tout. J'ai: You said time wipes everything out. I checked this morning: still nothing wiped. I'll keep you posted.
textes.Tu disais que tu dormirais trois cents a: You said you'd sleep for three hundred years… You look wide awake today. Faelar would be disappointed.
textes.Tu débouches la fiole. Ça sent la vanill: You uncork the vial. It smells of vanilla and woodsmoke. You don't have horns… but you rub your temples a little, just to see.
textes.Tu décroches une botte de spaghettis bie: You take down a bundle of nicely dry spaghetti: hard as sticks, and smelling of wheat. (Recommendation no. 3: don't break them in two.)
textes.Tu dégages les gravats à la pelle, pierr: You clear the rubble with the shovel, stone after stone…
textes.Tu déplies l'Alouette, tu prends ton éla: You unfold the Alouette, take a run-up… three steps… and the void carries you. You're gliding!
textes.Tu déplies le Bail collectif. Trente et: You unfold the shared lease. Thirty-one signatures, a crested rat, a paw print (Sardine) and, right at the bottom, a tiny grey signature that trembles a little.
textes.Tu déroules le papyrus. Thot montre le c: You unroll the papyrus. Thoth points at the cartouche: the ibis, the eye of Horus, the sun. From top to bottom.
textes.Tu déroules ton diplôme. Le sceau de cir: You unroll your diploma. The wax seal is still smoking a little. You are a bachelor of flames, it says so.
textes.Tu effleures ta Clé d'étoile… Une lueur: You brush your Star Key… A glimmer streaks across the sky: the Star Glider is coming!
textes.Tu en as déjà un ! Un seul suffit : les: You already have one! One is enough: bad dreams are afraid of dreamcatchers.
textes.Tu en as déjà un : il te reste à trouver: You already have one: you still need to find the other.
textes.Tu en as déjà une. Une seule suffit : ce: You already have one. One is enough: what I forge doesn't break.
textes.Tu enfiles le poing de fer et tu frappes: You slip on the iron fist and punch your palm. Clang! That's going to hurt. Somebody.
textes.Tu enfiles un grand manteau de laine rou: You slip on a big, warm red wool coat. It smells a little of sulfur. (You never know: the inscription on the door insists.)
textes.Tu entends le violon ? Ça veut dire que: Can you hear the violin? That means dessert is coming.
You step into the mushroom circle. The glimmers spiral up around you…
textes.Tu es allé chez Octave ?! Il t'a dit que: You went to Octave's?! Did he tell you the shipwreck was my fault? It's not true. The map was right. It was the rock that was in the wrong place.
textes.Tu es allé chez les elfes ! Raconte ! Es: You went to the elves! Tell me everything! Do they have shells? No? What a strange people.
textes.Tu es déjà au royaume des fées. Garde ce: You're already in the fairy kingdom. Keep this mushroom for another time.
textes.Tu es déjà mon écuyer, mon brave ! Le pr: You're already my squire, brave one! A squire's first duty: come back to see me. You did. Well done.
textes.Tu es le 1 000 000e visiteur de ton prop: You are the 1,000,000th visitor of your very own journal!
textes.Tu es mon humain préféré. Enfin, après T: You're my favourite human. Well, after Tornade. And after the sausage seller.
You've come to see me %d times.
textes.Tu fais quoi dans la vie, déjà ?: What is it you do again?
textes.Tu fais rouler les dés dans ta main. Six: You roll the dice in your hand. Six, six, six. Again. Six, six, five. Not bad. Nobody saw a thing.
textes.Tu fais siffler la plume dorée… Un cri d: You blow the golden feather like a whistle… An eagle's cry answers, far away. Ventaile is coming!
textes.Tu fais tinter la clochette : ding, ding: You ring the little bell: ding, ding! The bushes shake, and Truffe trots out, ears flopping, tail curled like a corkscrew. He presses his snout against your hand. Oink! He follows you now.
textes.Tu fais tourner l'attrape-rêves. Les per: You twirl the dreamcatcher. The beads tinkle softly. You yawn.
textes.Tu fais tourner la plume entre tes doigt: You twirl the feather between your fingers. Somewhere in the Twisted Wood, an owl hoots.
textes.Tu fais un nœud de marin, comme Galet. P: You tie a sailor's knot, like Galet. Then you undo it. Then you tie it again. It's strangely soothing.
textes.Tu ferais ça ? Bien. L'herbe à fièvre po: You'd do that? Good. Fever grass grows at the water's edge, in the Drowned Marsh: silvery tufts that glow a little when the sun is low. I need three. And watch the water, not the tufts: crocodiles come out of the water.
textes.Tu ferais ça ? Les cempasúchil poussent: You'd do that? The cempasúchil grow on the chinampas in the south, beside the canals: orange tufts, like little suns. I need five bunches. Don't step on the beans!
textes.Tu ferais ça ? Mon tajine du vendredi, c: You'd do that? My Friday tagine is a whole affair: I need two sea bream, nice ones, fresh ones. Not Saïd's: he shouts at them all morning, their flesh gets stressed. Catch them yourself, or find them, but bring me two. And you'll taste the best tagine on the whole island.
textes.Tu ferais ça ? … Rhubarbe. Rouge comme u: You'd do that? … Rhubarbe. Red as a sunset, ill-mannered as a cabin boy. He flew off three days ago toward the northern jungle. Joe heard him swearing near the old abandoned camp. Spiders have made their nest there, be careful. First go and see Joe, in the square: he talks to birds better than to men.
textes.Tu feuillettes « Le Boucanier ». Page 3: You leaf through “Le Boucanier”. Page 3: “A ROBOT FROM LISSE APOLOGISES FOR FORTY MINUTES.” Page 4: a crossword where all the answers are “BOUCAN”.
textes.Tu fouilles tes poches… pas assez de piè: You rummage through your pockets… not enough coins. Lentille laughs: “Then it's zero! Zero is a price too!”
textes.Tu frottes le patch des Rats de Cale. Qu: You rub the Bilge Rats patch. Somewhere in the Boucan, a guitar goes “BRRRANG”. It's surely no coincidence.
You rub the scarab between your fingers. It's warm, like a summer morning.
textes.Tu frottes ton badge. Il fait « bip-bip: You rub your badge. It goes “beep-beep” and displays, in tiny letters: “Hello!”
textes.Tu gravis l'escalier de racines…: You climb the staircase of roots…
textes.Tu gravis les marches de la Tour des Tem: You climb the steps of the Tower of Storms… the wind howls louder and louder.
textes.Tu grimpes sur le dos de Géryon. « Accro: You climb onto Geryon's back. “Hold on tight,” he says in his kindly voice. He spreads his wings, dives into the chasm in wide circles… and sets you down, all the way at the bottom, at the edge of Malebolge.
textes.Tu jettes l'or et le jade dans le feu… L: You throw the gold and jade into the fire… The flames hiss and shrink back, like Tecciztécatl, the rich one, who drew back four times before the blaze. Nothing happens. (On the fresco, it's the other god who jumps.)
You throw the bones into the middle of the room. The jaguars pounce on them growling… and lie down to gnaw. They're not interested in you at all anymore.
textes.Tu jettes les roseaux et les épines de N: You throw in the reeds and thorns of Nanahuatzin, the poor one, the brave one, who leapt without hesitating… The fire roars, rising to the vault! And from the blaze, slowly, a sun rises.
textes.Tu l'as fait exprès ?: Did you do that on purpose?
textes.Tu l'as vu aussi, gamin ? Le slime remon: You saw it too, kid? The slime is rising. In the wells, in the fountain, and this morning in Rissole's soup. She's furious. It comes from below, from the Dungeon of a Thousand Steps, at the foot of the Fangs. Five floors. Right at the bottom is the Jelly King, with his little crown. As long as he's there, the jelly will keep rising. You're rank D now: you're ready. Go down, defeat him, and bring me his Royal jelly heart. And when he splits into little pieces… whatever you do, don't panic. I know what I'm talking about.
textes.Tu l'as… tu es remonté de Xibalba. (Ix K: You have it… you came back up from Xibalba. (Ix Kanul kneels.) The Twins tricked the Lords and became the Sun and the Moon. You, you became a story. Keep the mask: its place is on the Altar of the Three Suns, in the highlands. Here, some festival cacao.
textes.Tu lances les trois gâteaux de miel. Tro: You throw the three honey cakes. Three heads, three “gulps”. Cerbère licks his chops… yawns with all three mouths… and collapses, snoring. A three-voice snore. The south gate opens.
textes.Tu lâches tout juste au-dessus de ta bar: You let go just above your rowboat… and land right in it! The Alouette folds back into your bag.
textes.Tu lèves les quatre sceaux vers la grand: You raise the four seals toward the great gate…
textes.Tu lèves les trois sceaux vers la Dame d: You raise the three seals toward the Figurehead Lady. They light up: gold, bronze, silver… The wood creaks. Slowly, between her hands, the shell opens.
textes.Tu lèves les yeux. Une table te regarde,: You look up. A table stares back at you, legs in the air. All the furniture is stuck to the ceiling!
You've bought %d item from me, for %d coins.
textes.Tu m'as acheté %d objets, pour %d pièces: You've bought %d items from me, for %d coins.
textes.Tu m'as dit qu'une carte, ça peut se tro: You told me a map can be wrong. I thought about it all night. So did Gaston. He was snoring, but he was thinking about it.
You told me you'd plant a forest. I kept a seed for you. Start with one tree: the forest will come later.
textes.Tu m'as dit que tu trouvais %s très symp: You told me you found %s very nice.
textes.Tu m'as dit que tu trouvais %s un peu bi: You told me you found %s a bit weird.
You've given me %d gift, the last one: %s.
textes.Tu m'as fait %d cadeaux, le dernier : %s: You've given me %d gifts, the last one: %s.
textes.Tu m'as fait une de ces peurs ! J'ai cru: You gave me such a fright! I thought it was Monday.
textes.Tu marchandes bien, pour un {surnom}. Al: You haggle well, for a {surnom}. Go on then: a small discount. Don't tell anyone.
textes.Tu me dois deux pièces, Tonneau !: You owe me two coins, Tonneau!
textes.Tu me ferais une jarre de pluie ?: Would you make me a rain jar?
textes.Tu me racontes la suite ?: Will you tell me what happened next?
textes.Tu mesures encore les gens, Coquillard ?: Still measuring people, Coquillard? Go and measure your words.
textes.Tu montes l'escalier en colimaçon du bef: You climb the spiral staircase of the belfry…
textes.Tu montes sur l'estrade. Ton cœur s'envo: You step onto the platform. Your heart flies out of your chest — you can see it! — and lands on the left pan. The jackal leans toward you.
textes.Tu montes vers la lumière… le vent souff: You climb toward the light… the wind is blowing up above.
textes.Tu montes, marche après marche, dans le: You climb, step after step, into the heart of the tree…
You don't have any seal power yet.
textes.Tu n'as encore rien attrapé ? Patience,: Haven't caught anything yet? Patience, {surnom}. It took me three years to catch my first fish. Mind you, my rod was made of seaweed.
textes.Tu n'as jamais voulu me dire d'où tu vie: You never would tell me where you come from. That, I remember.
textes.Tu n'as pas encore de machine volante. À: You don't have a flying machine yet. In Cliquetis, Philibert Vis, “the inventor without an invention”, dreams of building one…
textes.Tu n'as pas encore de pouvoir. Les quatr: You don't have a power yet. The four seals of the great eastern island each hide one…
textes.Tu n'as pas eu le temps de dire « bonjou: You didn't have time to say “hello.” The door shut by itself. Well, not by itself.
textes.Tu n'as que {coquillages} bâtons. Il m'e: You've only got {coquillages} sticks. I need {manque}. The island's woods are full of them.
textes.Tu n'en as que {coquillages}. Il m'en fa: You've only got {coquillages}. I need {manque} in all. Look on the beach by your village, they sparkle in the sun.
textes.Tu nages ! Espace : remonter, Ctrl : plo: You're swimming! Space: surface, Ctrl: dive, Shift: swim fast. Facing a pier or a rock, press Space to haul yourself up.
textes.Tu nages ! Stick gauche : nager vers où: You're swimming! Left stick: swim where you're looking (look down to dive). A: surface, B: descend, left trigger: swim fast.
textes.Tu ne connais encore aucun sort. Les maî: You don't know any spell yet. The masters of Arcanelle, the wizards' island, teach six of them.
textes.Tu ne connais pas encore la magie de tél: You don't know teleportation magic yet. The fairies, maybe, someday…
textes.Tu ne le diras à personne, que c'était m: You won't tell anyone it was me, right? I'm working on an even scarier ghost. With chains. And a saucepan.
textes.Tu ne me ferais pas un prix ?: Couldn't you give me a better price?
textes.Tu nous as trouvés ! Tous les DEUX ! Mêm: You found us! BOTH of us! Even Quark! Why are you so good? Do you have hidden antennae? Show me! … No? Fine. You're the first Heavyfoot hide-and-seek champion. Quark is sulking. He says you cheated. HE's the one who cheats! Here, our moon cookies from recess. We kept three. Well, four. Quark ate one while hiding. That's how you found him: the crumbs.
You tell us that one every time, Nono.
textes.Tu ouvres la calebasse. Xan file droit…: You open the gourd. Xan flies straight… down the BLACK path! He vanishes there, then comes back zigzagging, all pleased, and goes into his gourd.
textes.Tu ouvres la lanterne. Un à un, les espr: You open the lantern. One by one, the firefly spirits fly out and settle in the niches… The bark trembles, and the door of the Mother Tree opens!
textes.Tu ouvres le grimoire. L'encre violette: You open the spellbook. The violet ink quivers, and the spells you know glow for a moment on the page.
textes.Tu ouvres les cinq bourses et souffles l: You open the five pouches and blow the fairy dust over the brambles. It sparkles… and the black brambles wither, curl up, and fall to dust. The way to the Bramble Throne is open.
textes.Tu passes le portail de l'Usine Grise. D: You step through the Grey Factory gate. Inside, it's clean, grey and silent, like a giant waiting room. A reception robot smiles at you with its screen. Somewhere beneath your feet, machines purr.
You may pet me. Once. Not twice.
You may pass. I allow it.
textes.Tu plonges la fiole de cristal dans le b: You dip the crystal vial into the basin. The spring water sparkles inside, as if full of stars.
textes.Tu plonges le bras dans l'eau froide du: You plunge your arm into the cold water of the lake… and pull out a big round stone, white as coral, with a black pupil: an EYE! It looks at you. It seems delighted to be out of the water. (“The water that looks at the sky”: it was the crater lake!)
textes.Tu portes une hache. S'il te plaît… pas: You're carrying an axe. Please… not here. Not near the Tree.
textes.Tu poses l'amulette sur la pierre. Les y: You place the amulet on the stone. The serpents' eyes light up one by one…
textes.Tu poses l'obole dans la main osseuse de: You place the obol in Charon's bony hand. He bites it, looks at it, pockets it. “Get in. And don't lean over: the Acheron is cold, and it doesn't give back hats.”
textes.Tu poses la main sur la lentille. Bzzzt: You place your hand on the lens. Bzzzt! The carp change color and swoop in a big loop above the square. Somewhere, someone applauds.
textes.Tu poses le Plat de la Grande Réconcilia: You place the Dish of the Great Reconciliation on the altar, next to the eternal plate. A smell of tomato, basil and parmesan rises to the top of the colander… Up there, something stirs.
textes.Tu poses le cuissot de cerf sur l'autel: You lay the venison haunch on the altar: “Blades, here is the flesh of the beasts. All the beasts of the forest shall be yours.” A creak… and the four blades slide into the walls and lie down.
textes.Tu poses le tricorne sur ta tête. Il est: You set the tricorn on your head. It's a bit big. You feel ready to face the whole ocean.
textes.Tu poses les deux cristaux dans le Sceau: You place the two crystals in the Seal of Winds: one glows red, the other turns blue… A breath of wind sweeps through the courtyard, and the great doors of the keep slowly open.
textes.Tu poses les quatre morceaux dans le sar: You place the four pieces in the sarcophagus… A green light, like growing wheat, rises from the basin: Osiris is whole again! A very gentle voice: “Thank you. Now go before Anubis: your heart will be weighed.”
textes.Tu poses les trois fragments dans les em: You place the three fragments in the imprints… They sink in by themselves.
textes.Tu poses un morceau de fromage affiné su: You put a piece of aged cheese on the planks, against the hull. A snout. Whiskers. Biscotte comes out of its hole, nibbles, looks at you… then climbs up your leg, your arm, and settles on your shoulder. You did it!
textes.Tu pousses de toutes tes forces… Le poid: You push with all your might… The weight doesn't budge: something is blocking it from the other side.
textes.Tu pousses les battants d'obsidienne. La: You push open the obsidian doors. The green barrier dies out with a crackle…
textes.Tu prends la Perle de la Fosse sur son a: You take the Pearl of the Trench from its altar. It's as cold as the depths… the age of the abyss.
textes.Tu prends le Sceau des Sables. Il est ch: You take the Seal of Sands. It's warm like a stone in the sun… and suddenly it burns without hurting: a flame awakens in the hollow of your hand! (Press 2 to choose the Flame, X to throw it; in VR: B.) The sand in the corners starts to move…
textes.Tu prends un ruban et tu fais le tour de: You take a ribbon and skip around the tree. The ribbons braid around the pole, yellow, red, green, blue… it's very pretty, and a little dizzying.
textes.Tu prends une obole dans la coupe de bro: You take an obol from the bronze bowl. A little label: “For Charon. One per traveler. He counts.”
textes.Tu préfères les coquillages… aucun, héla: You prefer shells that are… none, alas.
textes.Tu regardes au fond de la fleur. Une tou: You look into the heart of the flower. A tiny galaxy turns and turns… You feel a little dizzy. It smells of vanilla.
textes.Tu regardes ta carte d'aventurier. Ton p: You look at your adventurer's card. Your portrait looks back at you. The nose, honestly, is not right.
textes.Tu relis ton titre de propriété. Tu as u: You reread your property deed. You have a house! With a wisteria! And a bed!
textes.Tu remontes de la fosse, couvert de sabl: You climb back out of the pit, covered in sand, at the chapel entrance. Those slabs had nothing on them… The scarabs, though, know where to step.
You climb back out of the pit, covered in sand.
textes.Tu remontes les couvertures jusqu'aux me: You pull the blankets up to their chins. One of the children murmurs “Thank you, Granny Sunflower…” without waking. The mother slips you a few coins: “For your gentleness.”
textes.Tu remontes les marches… L'air sent l'he: You climb back up the steps… The air smells of grass and wind. Odon looks up from his ledger: “Already?”
textes.Tu remplis un petit pot de sauce du volc: You fill a little jar with volcano sauce. It's just as good as before.
textes.Tu repenses à la légende de Mamie Basalt: You remember Granny Basalte's legend: give the Great Moai back his two eyes. One in “the water that looks at the sky”, the other “under the heads that look at the clouds”.
textes.Tu replies l'Alouette dans ton sac. Clic: You fold the Alouette back into your bag. Click, clack.
textes.Tu ressors de l'Arbre-Mère, ébloui par l: You step out of the Mother Tree, dazzled by the golden light of Bois-Doré.
textes.Tu reviens après ce que tu m'as fait ? J: You come back after what you did to me? I haven't forgotten. Neither has Gaston.
textes.Tu reviens après m'avoir frappé ? Les pr: Back after hitting me? Prices have gone up. For you.
textes.Tu reviens après une longue absence… {ab: You're back after a long absence… {absence}, I believe. For an elf, that's the blink of an eye.
textes.Tu reviens jouer ?: Are you coming back to play?
textes.Tu reçois le Sifflet des compagnons ! Ut: You receive the Companions' Whistle! Use it to choose who comes with you.
textes.Tu récupères ce que tu n'avais pas pu po: You pick up what you couldn't carry:
textes.Tu sais ce qui est plus vieux que les Mo: Do you know what's older than the Moai? … Pebbles. Hee hee! They never brag about it.
textes.Tu sais pourquoi les Moaïs ne jouent jam: Do you know why Moai never play hide-and-seek? … Because they're found right away! Hee hee hee!
textes.Tu sais pêcher ?: Do you know how to fish?
textes.Tu sais qui vole les croissants ?: Do you know who's stealing the croissants?
textes.Tu sais te servir de tes mains, au moins: Can you at least use your hands?
textes.Tu sais, tous les Moaïs regardent l'inté: You know, all the Moai look toward the inside of the island. It's tradition. So I… I've never seen the sea. Never. Not once. They say it's big, and blue, and that it sings.
textes.Tu sautes avec la foule ! Boïng ! Boïng: You jump with the crowd! Boing! Boing!
textes.Tu secoues la bombe : clic-clic-clic ! L: You shake the can: click-click-click! The wall is waiting. What will you paint?
textes.Tu secoues le sachet. Quelque part, un p: You shake the pouch. Somewhere, a parrot turns its head.
textes.Tu sens comme le kick a monté ? Mistral: Do you feel how the kick has come up? Mistral is on form tonight.
textes.Tu sens la sciure, {surnom}. Tu abats de: You smell of sawdust, {surnom}. Are you chopping down trees? Spare my banana trees, they're my confidants.
textes.Tu sens le fer rouillé et le charbon. Tu: You smell of rusty iron and coal. You've come from Octave's, admit it.
textes.Tu sens le saucisson. Je dis ça, je dis: You smell of sausage. Just saying. Not saying anything.
textes.Tu siffles doucement… Tout le monde est: You whistle softly… Everyone has gone home. You walk a while on your own.
textes.Tu sors la pelote de laine et tu la fais: You take out the ball of wool and roll it gently over the cobblestones. Up above, two ears prick up. Brioche hesitates… stretches… and jumps, light as a rag, down beside the ball. She nudges it with a paw, then comes to rub against your legs. She's the one who chose: it's you.
textes.Tu souffles dans la conque d'Ehécatl, de: You blow into Ehécatl's conch with all your might. An immense wind rises in the hall, bending the flames… and the fifth sun starts to move! It turns, it crosses the stone sky. To the south, the last door opens.
textes.Tu souffles dans le sifflet : fuiii-iii: You blow the whistle: tweeeet! Who's coming with me?
You blow the whistle: tweeeet! … Nobody comes. You don't have a companion yet.
textes.Tu soulèves la pierre plate, au pied de: You lift the flat stone, at the foot of the only head with its nose in the air, watching the clouds go by… Underneath, in a nest of moss: a coral eye, white, round, with its black pupil. It looks like it's blinking. (No: that's just emotion.)
textes.Tu soulèves le couvercle… Le coffre ouvr: You lift the lid… The chest opens an eye. Then a mouth. Full of teeth. Oops.
You were smiling in your sleep. I saw you.
textes.Tu t'approches du Cœur de la Flèche. Les: You approach the Spire's Heart. The three shards slip out of your bag, float up to the great crystal… and melt into it in a flash of blue. The Heart begins to beat again, strong, steady, joyful. Far below, the bridges of light stop flickering. Go back and see Elder Astrée!
textes.Tu t'assois sur le tapis jaune. Inspire…: You sit down on the yellow mat. Breathe in… breathe out… The wind makes the canvas sing, someone laughs softly, a fly passes. After a while, you feel light as a feather.
textes.Tu t'es posé : la course s'arrête. Comèt: You've landed: the race is over. Comète turns around laughing: “Rematch? I'll be waiting at the golden ring!”
You've moved away: the line reels in.
textes.Tu t'installes avec eux. C'est délicieux: You sit down with them. It's delicious (and everyone watches you eat). Your hearts are full! For the road:
textes.Tu t'élèves de cinq ou six mètres, tu pl: You rise five or six metres, hover a moment, and float gently back down.
textes.Tu t'évanouis… et te réveilles au pied d: You faint… and wake up at the foot of the ladder.
textes.Tu te dis aventurier. Je te crois. À moi: You call yourself an adventurer. I believe you. Halfway.
textes.Tu te glisses dans la couchette. Les vag: You slip into the bunk. The waves rock you… Good night, sailor.
textes.Tu te laisses glisser le long de la chaî: You let yourself slide down the chain, all the way to the bottom of the well…
textes.Tu te perds ? Mais c'est merveilleux ! L: You get lost? But that's wonderful! The great explorers get lost all the time. I got lost for twenty-two years, and look at everything I found.
textes.Tu te réveilles près du feu du Clan. Mam: You wake up by the Clan's fire. Mamie Silex dabs your forehead with cold moss: “Grosse-Dent too strong? Eat first. After, go hit again.”
textes.Tu te réveilles sur le quai, la mâchoire: You wake up on the quay, your jaw in a mess. The seagulls are laughing.
textes.Tu tends l'os à Sardine. Il le prend tou: You hold out the bone to Sardine. He takes it very gently, lies down at your feet and gnaws on it, growling with joy. His tail sweeps the floor: flap, flap, flap.
textes.Tu tends les graines. Rhubarbe penche la: You hold out the seeds. Rhubarbe tilts his head… comes down from his perch, pecks from your hand, and climbs onto your shoulder: “SHIVER ME TIMBERS!” Take him back to the captain.
textes.Tu tiens la botte bien droite, comme une: You hold the bundle perfectly straight, like a conductor's baton. (Recommendation no. 3: don't snap it in half.)
textes.Tu tombes… Un robot-trieur te ramasse, t: You fall… A sorting robot picks you up, stamps you “RETURN TO SENDER” and sets you back at the start of the room.
textes.Tu tombes… et tu te retrouves, étourdi,: You fall… and find yourself, dazed, at the edge of the hall.
You fall… and find yourself, dazed, at the start of the room. (One more step for Odon's count.)
You fall… and find yourself, dazed, at the entrance of the hall.
textes.Tu tournes la grande roue : des vannes s: You turn the great wheel: sluice gates open somewhere, the water drains away with a roar… The basin empties, the rafts sink all the way down.
textes.Tu tournes la grande roue : l'eau monte: You turn the great wheel: the water rises to half height, and the rafts with it. The chest on the pillar, to the right, is now level with them…
textes.Tu tournes la grande roue : l'eau monte,: You turn the great wheel: the water rises, and rises, up to the brim! The rafts reach the level of the ledge.
textes.Tu tournes la manivelle du rouet : les f: You turn the crank of the spinning wheel: the hemp threads twist together, tight, tight… and there's a sturdy rope! That's what hemp is for here: ropes, canvas, twine. You can keep it.
textes.Tu trouves que c'est bizarre ? Moi je tr: You think it's strange? I think it's strange that you all put your furniture on the floor. That's where we walk!
textes.Tu vas me rembourser, j'espère !: You're going to pay me back, I hope!
textes.Tu verses l'eau de la jarre dans la coup: You pour the water from the jar into the chacmool's bowl. A rumble of thunder rolls in the distance, over the lake… Tlaloc is pleased.
textes.Tu veux courir ? Vraiment ? Formidable !: You want to race? Really? Wonderful! The rule is simple: you start from the arch, there, you go under the ten lantern arches, in order, all around the village, and you come back here. Bondi, Grisou and Éclair run with you. Come in first, and your name will go right at the top of the record board. Nobody has beaten Bondi in three years. Nobody has really tried, mind you.
textes.Tu veux pêcher ? Tu sais quoi… tu m'as r:
You want to fish? You know what… you completed my collection. Here, take my old rod. It once caught a grouper as big as Gaston. Gaston didn't appreciate that.

Equip it, go up to the water, hold {bouton} to wind up and release to cast. When the float dips: {bouton} again, quick!
textes.Tu veux que je te parle de qui ?: Who do you want me to tell you about?
textes.Tu veux te rendre utile, {surnom} ? Rapp: Want to make yourself useful, {surnom}? Bring me {manque} nice straight sticks. I need shovel handles. I'll pay, of course. Not much.
textes.Tu veux un sac ? Je n'ai pas de sac. Mai: You want a bag? I don't have bags. But it's kind of you to think of it.
textes.Tu veux vraiment savoir ? J'avais une fi: You really want to know? I had a fiancée, Mireille. She ran off with a lighthouse. I don't want to talk about it.
textes.Tu viens de chez Barnabé ? Il me fait ri: Have you just come from Barnabé's? He makes me laugh. He asked me whether elves eat shells.
textes.Tu viens de chez Barnabé, toi. Ça se sen: You've come from Barnabé's place. I can tell: you smell of seashells and old stories.
You come from the village across the water.
textes.Tu vois cette pointe dorée qui dépasse d: See that golden spire poking out of the water, to the south-west, when the sea is calm? It lights up at night. My grandfather said there was a city beneath it. A whole city! Under the water! … He did love his tall tales, my grandfather.
textes.Tu vois les pitons de pierre ? Ce sont l: See the rock spires? They're the fingers of a sleeping giant. Don't tickle him.
textes.Tu voles déjà sur le dos de Ventaile !: You're already flying on Ventaile's back!
textes.Tu y retournes ? Tiens, j'en ai cueilli: Going back there? Here, I picked another one this morning. Say hello to Queen Oriane for me!
textes.Turbo joue. Personne ne parle. C'est la: Turbo is playing. Nobody talks. That's the rule.
textes.Turbo-Aventure 3000 a été supprimé. Grig: Turbo-Adventure 3000 has been deleted. Grigri went to the trash, and the trash was emptied.
textes.Tu… tu l'as trouvé. Le trésor du capitai: You… you found it. The captain's treasure. (Old Silas cries and laughs at once.) A hundred years I've been talking about it, and nobody believed me. Here, take this: his tricorn hat. He left it to me, the day he went to sea never to return. It suits you better than me. Go, heir of Barbe-Sanglante. And tell it well, this story. It's all that's left, in the end: stories.
textes.Tu… tu t'en fiches ? Gaston, bouche-toi: You… you don't care? Gaston, cover your ears.
textes.Télécharge plus de mémoire pour ton carn: Download more memory for your journal. Free*!  *not free
textes.UN CONCURRENT ! (Elle hurle tellement qu: A CONTENDER! (She yells so loudly that three pigeons fall off the roof.) Four rounds! Imps, hellhounds, bronze automatons… and in the final, GORGOTH THE HORNED! Strike the gong at the edge of the sand to start each round. If you leave the sand, you forfeit. If you fall, we pick you up. SIGNED UP!
textes.UNE MINI-PELLETEUSE ! Quand son godet se: A MINI DIGGER! When its bucket rises, a red circle marks where it will come down: get out of the circle! And watch out for its sweeps.
textes.Un CHAT ! Je fais semblant de ne pas l'a: A CAT! I'm pretending I didn't see it.
textes.Un air pour la journée. Tu veux une chan: A tune for the day. Want a song?
textes.Un ampli, une batterie, deux musiciens q: An amp, a drum kit, two musicians head-banging… and earplugs on the table, for guests.
textes.Un ankylosaure (Queue-Massue) ! Son dos: An ankylosaur (Club-Tail)! Its back is hard as stone. When its tail rises, back off: it's going to spin. After its blow, it catches its breath: hit it on the head!
textes.Un anneau d'or fin avec un petit diamant: A fine gold ring with a small diamond, engraved on the inside: "H & L, forever".
textes.Un anneau de verre taillé de la grande l: A ring of cut glass from the lighthouse's great lens. It focuses light like a giant magnifying glass.
textes.Un appareil photo holographique, un peu: A holographic camera, a little sticky (Glorb is gelatinous). It takes photos in three dimensions, and sometimes in four.
textes.Un atelier en désordre. Des engrenages,: A messy workshop. Gears, wires, a machine smoking a little… and someone muttering calculations.
textes.Un autel de pierre, vide, taché de vieux: A stone altar, empty, stained with old blood. Carved on it: “The blades are hungry. The Twins promised them the flesh of all beasts… and the blades lay down.”
textes.Un automate de bronze ! Il lève sa halle: A bronze automaton! It raises its halberd before striking: parry or roll. The Cog (key 3) freezes it for a good while.
textes.Un aventurier ! Comme moi à ton âge. Sau: An adventurer! Like me at your age. Except I got stuck here. Don't do the same.
textes.Un badge en plastique gris, avec une pho: A grey plastic badge, with a photo of someone who isn't smiling and the words "ACCESS: EVERYTHING. SMILING: FORBIDDEN." It opens the doors on the lower floor of the Grey Factory.
textes.Un badge rond qui brille, avec ton nom é: A round, shiny badge, with your name written in Lumen letters (which look like little dancing stars): "VERY WELCOME VISITOR — HEAVY-FEET, BUT KIND".
textes.Un battement d'ailes énorme fait vacille: An enormous beating of wings makes the flames flicker. A shape drops from the vault: a man's body, a bat's head, huge wings… CAMAZOTZ!
textes.Un batteur pour les Rats de Cale: A drummer for the Bilge Rats
textes.Un beau pavillon tout neuf ! J'ai hissé: A lovely brand-new flag! I've hoisted the Laughing Seagull; choose the design you like.
textes.Un biscuit en forme de croissant de lune: A crescent-moon biscuit, sprinkled with silver sugar. Crunchy on one side, soft on the other (the Lumens can't make up their minds). Restores one heart.
textes.Un bocal de « soupe de tout le monde »,: A jar of steaming "everyone's soup", with a pallet-wood lid made by Copeau. You never know exactly what's in it, but it's always good. Restores two hearts.
textes.Un bol de cacao mousseux, chez Ix Chab: A bowl of frothy cocoa, at Ix Chab's
textes.Un bol de nouilles, s'il vous plaît ! Av: A bowl of noodles, please! With a smiley!
textes.Un bol fumant de ragoût aux champignons: A steaming bowl of ember mushroom stew. It burns your tongue and restores four hearts.
textes.Un bon livre. J'en suis au meilleur pass: A good book. I'm at the best part, so be quick.
A good tool is all in the handle.
textes.Un bouclier d'épines entoure la Reine !: A shield of thorns surrounds the Queen! Your blows do nothing now… Awaken the three roses of light (E)!
textes.Un bâtard au bandana rouge sort de sous: A mutt in a red bandana crawls out from under a car wreck, one ear up, one ear down. It sniffs you, sneezes, and starts wagging its tail so hard its whole behind wiggles. SARDINE! It follows you now: take it back to Tornade!
textes.Un cadeau des humains… Je le montrerai a: A gift from the humans… I'll show it to my people. They'll be curious.
textes.Un cadeau qu'on aime, ça ouvre les cœurs: A gift people love opens hearts. A gift they don't love… closes them a little.
textes.Un café du Brasier, au bord des bains: A Brasier coffee, by the baths
textes.Un café noir comme la lave refroidie, to: A coffee as black as cooled lava, roasted on the Ember Heart itself, served piping hot at Au Diable Repu. Restores one heart, and wide-open eyes.
textes.Un café à vapeur au comptoir: A steam coffee at the counter
textes.Un caillou ? … Une pièce. Et c'est bien: A pebble? … One coin. And that's well paid: I only do it because it's pretty. It's pretty, right?
textes.Un caillou lisse. Servira à fabriquer de: A smooth pebble. Good for making tools.
textes.Un caillou noir et lourd, encore un peu: A heavy black stone, still a little warm, that fell from the sky onto Astralys on a night of shooting stars. It has an iron sheen and smells like stormy rain.
textes.Un caillou-qui-chante ! Écoute-le siffle: A singing pebble! Listen to it whistle! I'll hang it under the west bridge this very evening. Here, my finest golden acorn, found at the top of the Mother Oak. Plumette, the postmistress, adores them.
textes.Un canard de laiton à remontoir. Il nage: A wind-up brass duck. It swims, it quacks, it doesn't lay eggs.
textes.Un candidat libre ! Hm. Trois épreuves,: A private candidate! Hm. Three trials, like everyone else. The flames: Miss Sulfura wants to see if you know where fire is born. The contract: our librarian, Ombreline, will have you sign… after reading, I hope. The sparks: in front of me, you'll crunch an infernal chili pepper without crying. Or almost without crying.
textes.Un canon à confettis : à bord, touche K: A confetti cannon: on board, press K (B on the controller, A in VR). To celebrate every arrival, every treasure, every Tuesday.
textes.Un carnet couvert de poussière. Sur la d: A dust-covered notebook. On the last page:
textes.Un cartographe ne se perd jamais, Taille: A cartographer never gets lost, Taillefer. He explores.
textes.Un cercle de bois tressé d'un filet de c: A wooden hoop woven with a hemp net, with beads and feathers. The net catches bad dreams; the good ones slide down the feathers.
textes.Un champignard ! Une petite créature cha: A mushling! A mischievous little mushroom creature. Its spore cloud doesn't hurt… but it makes you sneeze. One little tap and it scurries off; two, and poof!
textes.Un champignon au chapeau violet, constel: A mushroom with a purple cap, dotted with spots that shine like stars. Lulu says it takes you to the fairy kingdom, above the clouds. "Bite" it to make the journey; up there, the mushroom ring will bring you back to the beach.
textes.Un champignon de braise ?! Ho ho ! Ça, c: An ember mushroom?! Ho ho! Now THAT is a dwarf soup! It stings the eyes AND the beard! Here, taste, and take some for the road.
textes.Un champignon féerique au chapeau orange: A fairy mushroom with an orange cap, on a spiral stalk that bounces all by itself. "Munch": you jump three times higher and float gently back down (for a while). A storybook mushroom: in a real forest, you must NEVER eat a mushroom you don't know.
textes.Un champignon féerique aux lamelles de t: A fairy mushroom with gills of every colour. "Munch": the world ripples with colours, you run faster, and you leave a rainbow trail. A storybook mushroom: in a real forest, you must NEVER eat a mushroom you don't know.
textes.Un champignon féerique pâle et argenté q: A pale, silvery fairy mushroom that glows like a little piece of the moon. "Munch": you can see the invisible (glowing hiding places appear all over the island). A storybook mushroom: in a real forest, you must NEVER eat a mushroom you don't know.
textes.Un champignon féerique violet aux lamell: A purple fairy mushroom with gills shaped like a little mouth, which goes "blah blah blah" when you hold it up to your ear. "Munch": you understand animals. A storybook mushroom: in a real forest, you must NEVER eat a mushroom you don't know.
textes.Un champignon rouge et tiède qui pousse: A red, warm mushroom that grows in the ash, near the steam vents. Dagna puts it in her stew. Restores one heart.
textes.Un chapelet de perles de bois clair, ave: A string of pale wooden beads, with a little gold sun at the end. Sister Pétronille's, swallowed by the Queen Frog of the lake. It smells a little of mud (and a lot of frog).
textes.Un chat roux a volé la carte au trésor d: A ginger cat has stolen the treasure map of Captain Croc-de-Sel, the pirate moored at Tazira. And cats climb
A ginger cat has stolen the treasure map of Captain Croc-de-Sel, the pirate moored at Tazira. And cats climb…
textes.Un chat roux te fixe. Puis un noir. Puis: A ginger cat stares at you. Then a black one. Then a white one. You're outnumbered.
textes.Un chaudron qui bouillonne, une odeur de: A bubbling cauldron, a smell of sulfur… and a frog in a wizard hat, sitting on a chair.
textes.Un chevalier ne se fatigue jamais. Il… s: A knight never tires. He… rests strategically.
textes.Un chien ! Je le savais. Enfin, je m'en: A dog! I knew it. Well, I suspected it. Well… Case closed! Margaux will leave him one croissant a day, and everyone will be happy. Excellent work, detective.
textes.Un chien. Je l'ignore avec une grande di: A dog. I ignore it with great dignity.
textes.Un chiffon rouge troué, cloué sur un bât: A red rag full of holes, nailed to a stick, with a big tooth painted on it (crookedly). The banner of the goblin chief of the Goblin Wood. Sir Tancrède wants to bring it back as proof of his first real feat.
textes.Un château ! Mais le vrai, le grand, il: A castle! But the real one, the big one, is over there, at the very end of the beach, to the west. It's the Downpour castle: the sand piled up all by itself, with towers and everything. And the yellow pot, number four, rolled inside! I saw it! But the sea came in, and now I can't find the door. Would you look for it? You have longer arms than me.
textes.Un cidre brut des pommiers de la côte ou: A dry sparkling apple drink from the west coast orchards, fizzing like the sea on a windy day. Restores one heart.
textes.Un cidre de Montjoie à la Grenouille Rep: A Montjoie apple fizz at La Grenouille Repue
textes.Un coffre laissé par les Seigneurs « pou: A chest left by the Lords “for their guests”: a haunch of venison, and a few coins.
textes.Un colosse de roche se dresse sous le cr: A colossus of rock rises beneath the crystal: THE HEART GUARDIAN! Four runes glow on it, in the colours of the four seals.
textes.Un colosse des eaux profondes, au bout d: A giant of the deep waters, at the end of the jetties. Restores three hearts.
textes.Un concert ! Avec des rats ! (Il plisse: A concert! With rats! (He squints.) Musician rats, not kitchen rats? Well. I'll hang it above the counter, next to my napkin frog. They go well together. And I'll come! With my number nine frog in a crust: the one you can eat while jumping. It fits very nicely in the hand. It was designed for adventurers on the run.
textes.Un concert ? Des punks ? (Il regarde l'a: A concert? Punks? (He looks at the poster, the rat, the mohawk.) Mamma mia, what a rat! He's got my cousin Gino's mohawk! I'll put it in my window, next to the bouillabaisse. And you know what? I'll come! With a cooking pot! A fish soup for the whole pit! Punks eat, right? Everybody eats. Even while jumping.
textes.Un concert de punks ? (Il fait grincer s: A punk concert? (He makes his fiddle screech, delighted.) People who play loud and fast and jump all over the place? Why, they're pirates without a ship! I'll hang it above my stage. And I'll come! With my fiddle! I've always dreamed of playing a jig with an electric guitar. Tell your singer that Tom the Fiddler will be in the pit. Front row. Wearing a tricorn. She'll recognise me.
textes.Un coquillage ? Je le prends. Pas pour m: A shell? I'll take it. Not for me, mind you: so Barnabé doesn't get it. Heh heh heh.
textes.Un coquillage ?! Tu me prends pour Barna: A shell?! Do I look like Barnabé to you? Take it ba… no, leave it. Clou will throw it away.
textes.Un crabe de roche ! Quand il lève les pi: A rock crab! When it raises its pincers, back off or parry (F)… then strike it.
textes.Un crabe grand comme ma cabane, à l'est: A crab as big as my hut, east of the pillared hall? Its shell is steel. Wait until it sticks its claws into the rock… then hit it.
textes.Un crissement de pierre au-dessus de toi: A grinding of stone above you… The gargoyles on the ramparts open their eyes!
textes.Un cristal bleu, froid comme le soir, ga: A blue crystal, cold as the evening, guarded by the suits of armour in the armoury. It fits into the Seal of the Winds.
textes.Un cristal bleu-violet qui pousse sous l: A blue-violet crystal that grows beneath the floating island of Astralys and hums very softly, as if it were singing to itself. The Lumens make engines, lamps and music boxes out of it.
textes.Un cristal d'un jaune vif, en aiguilles,: A bright yellow crystal in needles, picked up at the edge of the hot springs. It smells of eggs and matches. Zigomar, the fireworks maker, makes his finest rockets with it.
textes.Un cristal des sources ! Bien. Le soufre: A spring crystal! Good. Sulfur, air, a spark: that's fire. (She snaps her fingers: the crystal bursts into a little blue flame.) Trial of the flames: passed!
textes.Un cristal doré, tiède comme le soleil d: A golden crystal, warm as the morning sun, won by ringing the Citadel's bell tower. It fits into the Seal of the Winds.
textes.Un cristal violet, cueilli au sommet des: A purple crystal, gathered at the top of the Fangs, where lightning strikes most often. A little yellow spark runs inside it; it crackles when you squeeze it. Violette needs it for her great spell.
textes.Un croc blanc, long comme un doigt, enco: A white fang, as long as a finger, still warm. Kraxx, the armourer, says it makes very good arrowheads (and very good toothpicks).
textes.Un crocodile ! Quand il ouvre grand la g: A crocodile! When it opens its jaws wide and flattens itself, it's about to leap at you: step aside (or roll, Ctrl), then strike while it recovers.
textes.Un croissant doré du Pain Doré, encore t: A golden croissant from the Pain Doré, still warm, that leaves crumbs everywhere. Restores one and a half hearts.
textes.Un cuissot de cerf enveloppé dans une fe: A haunch of venison wrapped in a banana leaf, from Balam's hunt. Not for you: for an offering. The Twins of the Popol Vuh knew who to give it to.
textes.Un des livres de la bibliothèque d'Arcan: One of the books from the library of Arcanelle, blown away during the great storm. Its pages still flap a little, like wings. Théophraste is waiting for them.
textes.Un disque d'argent pâle où dort un crois: A pale silver disc where a crescent moon sleeps; a light mist always drifts from it. The seal of Ramure. It awakened the Moonglow in you.
textes.Un disque d'or rouge, chaud comme une pi: A disc of red gold, warm as a stone in the sun, engraved with a sun rising over a dune. The seal of the desert. It awakened the Flame in you.
textes.Un disque de bronze aux bords dentés, qu: A bronze disc with toothed edges, which spins by itself when laid flat. The seal of the highlands. It awakened the Cog in you.
textes.Un disque de nacre bleu-vert, frais comm: A blue-green mother-of-pearl disc, cool as a wave, engraved with a compass rose. The seal of Carène. It awakened the Gust in you.
textes.Un donjon ! J'en ai vaincu cent. Enfin,: A dungeon! I've conquered a hundred. Well, three. Well, I've seen one.
textes.Un drame ! Il me faut du poisson frais d: A disaster! I need fresh fish of the day for my Sunday bouillabaisse. Two sea bream, two mackerel. Caught by you, I trust you.
textes.Un drone-huissier ! Il tourne au-dessus: A bailiff drone! It circles above you reading out its notices… then dives in for a shock. Dodge its dive: it stays low, out of breath, for a moment. That's your chance to strike!
textes.Un engrenage de laiton aux dents bien ta: A brass gear with neatly cut teeth, from the workshops of Cliquetis. It turns all by itself if you blow on it (no, that's not true, but it's nice to say).
textes.Un engrenage de quatorze dents, en or ma: A fourteen-tooth gear of solid gold, engraved "F. Cogne". The Fair's perpetual motion engine is missing it.
textes.Un escalier de lumière, des marches qui: A staircase of light, steps warming up one by one… and there you are in the nave of the Forge Cathedral, the Eternal Flame in your hands.
textes.Un escalier de lumière… et te voilà au s: A staircase of light… and there you are at the top of the Great Temple, above Lake Aztlán.
textes.Un escalier de service, des marches de t: A service staircase, sheet-metal steps that echo. On the wall: “Step 1 of 64. Please count.”
textes.Un feu follet ! Quand il se met à brille: A will-o'-the-wisp! When it starts glowing very brightly, it's going to dash straight at you: step aside, then strike.
textes.Un fil, une perle, une plume…: A thread, a bead, a feather…
textes.Un flocon tombé sur les falaises du nord: A snowflake that fell on the northern cliffs of Arcanelle. It doesn't melt, even in the palm of your hand. Borée Givrelin makes it the key to the frost spell.
textes.Un fou rire général. Quelqu'un pleure de: A general fit of giggles. Someone is crying with laughter into a napkin.
textes.Un fragment d'amulette avec un œil ? Sur: An amulet fragment with an eye? On my map, there are three eyes drawn. One under the village… one under the jungle… and one under the sea, in between. Good luck.
textes.Un frigo qui chante l'opéra, livré ce so: A fridge that sings opera, delivered tonight by drone!
textes.Un galet percé de petits trous. Quand le: A pebble pierced with little holes. When the wind blows through it, it whistles a clear note. The start of Bedaine's Great Swap.
textes.Un gardien de corail se réveille ! Il lè: A coral guardian awakens! It raises its spear before striking: roll (Ctrl) or parry (F). Three sword blows in a row hurt.
textes.Un geyser ! L'eau jaillit du fond du bas: A geyser! Water bursts from the bottom of the basin and flings you up. Watch the bubbles: they give a warning.
textes.Un gland d'or contre une plume ?: A golden acorn for a feather?
textes.Un gland doré, tout brillant, trouvé à l: A golden acorn, all shiny, found at the top of the Mother Oak. The owls of Ramure love them.
textes.Un golem des hauteurs ! Quand il lève se: A highland golem! When it raises both fists above its head, it's going to smash the ground in front of it: back off or roll (Ctrl)… then strike. Your blows don't stop it.
textes.Un grand coquillage rose et blanc, coupé: A big pink and white shell, cut in a spiral: the conch of the wind god, Ehécatl. When you blow into it, you hear the sea, and the wind rises.
textes.Un grand feutre violet, un galon d'or, e: A big purple felt hat, with gold braid and a white feather as long as an arm. Baron Barthélemy's favourite hat. It flies off at the slightest gust of wind, and the Baron searches the whole island for it.
textes.Un grand plat doré : les tagliatelles de: A big golden dish: Mamma Lasagna's tagliatelle, the sacred sauce from the Cooking Pot, three meatballs, and a snowfall of parmesan grated with the Golden Grater. To be placed on the altar of the Colander Temple, so the Great Spaghetti stops sulking.
textes.Un grand rouleau de plans tout gris : qu: A big roll of all-grey plans: four hundred shops, two thousand parking spaces, a fountain that plays an anthem, and where the Howling Hall stands… a car park. To bring back to Mamie Barricade.
textes.Un grand verre de jus de pomme du verger: A tall glass of apple juice from the farm orchard, cloudy and sweet, pressed that very morning. Restores one heart.
textes.Un grand verre de sirop de menthe à l'ea: A tall glass of mint cordial, green like Pigment's crest, with a paper straw. Tornade's favourite drink (and the Sergeant's, secretly). Restores one heart.
textes.Un grelot de cuivre au bout d'un cordon: A copper bell on a red cord, which the tanukis hang from their belts. The sign of a true master of swapping.
textes.Un grimoire ? … (Théophraste disparaît e: A spellbook? … (Théophraste disappears between two shelves and comes back with a big purple leather book.) There. The pages are blank: you're the one who will write them. Every spell you learn will appear in it all by itself. Don't dog-ear it.
textes.Un grog de soufre au Diable Repu: A sulphur cordial at the Diable Repu
textes.Un grondement : les deux blocs glissent: A rumble: the two blocks slide back by themselves to their starting places.
textes.Un grondement monte des profondeurs. Der: A rumble rises from the depths. Behind the Abyss Gate, NÂGA, THE SERPENT OF THE ABYSS, opens her eyes… You take the amulet back. The barrier wavers: the gate can open.
textes.Un grondement profond monte de la terre…: A deep rumble rises from the earth… At the foot of Yggdrasil, runes light up in the bark, trace a great door… which slowly opens!
textes.Un gros boulon gris, tombé d'un robot dé: A big grey bolt that fell off one of Mr Lisse's removal robots. Rustine, Ferraille and Fusible buy them back to make things far more useful than robots.
textes.Un gros gâteau rond du Four Éternel de B: A big round cake from Bobor's Eternal Oven, glazed with fire honey that runs down the sides. They say Cerberus, the three-headed dog, loves them: one per head. Restores two hearts (if you don't keep it for the dog).
textes.Un gros livre de cuir violet, une étoile: A big book of purple leather, with a gold star on the cover. Its pages were blank: each spell learned from a master of Arcanelle has written itself there, in purple ink.
textes.Un gros nœud de bois sombre, lisse comme: A big knot of dark wood, smooth as a river stone, and cold. It looks like it's waiting for the light. The mirror-flowers, as they turn, send back the light of the spring…
textes.Un gâteau rond à la châtaigne et au miel: A round chestnut and honey cake with a moon drawn on top. In Ramure, they eat it every feast night. Restores three hearts.
textes.Un hamac dans l'arrière-salle, pour la n: A hammock in the back room, for the night
textes.Un haut-de-forme équipé d'un petit venti: A top hat fitted with a little hand-cranked fan. To keep your ideas cool.
textes.Un humain m'a demandé mon âge. J'ai répo: A human asked me my age. I said “three hundred and twelve”. He said “well preserved”. I still don't know if that was nice.
textes.Un jaguar ! Quand il se tapit, il va bon: A jaguar! When it crouches, it's about to pounce: step aside at the last moment, then strike while it recovers.
textes.Un jour de grand vent, ses yeux sont tom: One day of great wind, his eyes fell out. One rolled into the water that looks at the sky. The other hid beneath the heads that look at the clouds. Ever since, his door has been shut. The day someone gives him back his eyes… he will open his belly of stone. There you go.
textes.Un jour, Momo m'a offert un collier : tr: One day, Momo gave me a necklace: thirty shells threaded on a string. In the middle, I recognised Hortense, my tiger cowrie, carried off by a tide six years ago. Drilled! I bought her back for a bunch of bananas. She's fine. She just has a little hole.
textes.Un jus de pomme au bar de la Guilde: An apple juice at the Guild bar
textes.Un lac noir, au fond du puits, avec des: A black lake at the bottom of the well, with carved slabs? The Ancients only had one song, {surnom}: the one on the fresco. Night, sea, day, serpent. Sing it as you walk.
textes.Un lingot d'or, pour payer les dieux: A gold ingot, to pay the gods
textes.Un livre, quelque part, en parle peut-êt: A book, somewhere, may speak of it.
textes.Un long boyau qui monte, des marches tai: A long tunnel climbing up, carved steps… and daylight, in front of the Great Moai.
textes.Un long couloir, une ornière bien droite: A long corridor, a perfectly straight rut down the middle… and, at the end, a lever. On the ceiling, a big round hole. Hmm.
textes.Un long escalier en colimaçon… et te voi: A long spiral staircase… and there you are at the top of the Temple of Kukulkan, dazzled by the sun.
textes.Un majordome mécanique t'accueille en cl: A mechanical butler greets you, blinking all over. He looks very proud of his tray.
textes.Un matin, il m'a monté un mérou plus lou: One morning, he brought me up a grouper heavier than Clou. I paid without haggling. A first. Apparently he still tells the story at parties. Let him enjoy it: it won't happen again.
textes.Un minuscule carré de cristal. Quand on: A tiny square of crystal. When you blow on it, a little hologram pops out and takes a bow.
textes.Un minuscule champignon féerique bleu, t: A tiny blue fairy mushroom, very proud, puffing out its cap. "Munch": you suddenly grow big and hit harder (for a while). A storybook mushroom: in a real forest, you must NEVER eat a mushroom you don't know.
textes.Un monstre ! Je prie, je prie très fort: A monster! I'm praying, I'm praying really hard!
textes.Un morceau d'amulette en jade, gravé d'u: A piece of jade amulet, engraved with an ancient symbol. You need three to open the Serpent Gate, deep inside the Sunken Temple.
textes.Un morceau de fromage qui a beaucoup voy: A piece of cheese that has travelled a lot, with a golden rind and a… brave smell. For a rat, it's a treasure.
textes.Un morceau de lumière tombé du ciel une: A piece of light fallen from the sky on a clear night, pale and warm. Aurélien Lumen needs it to teach the light spell.
textes.Un mot sur la table : « Cher voleur, il: A note on the table: “Dear thief, there's nothing to steal here except the dirty dishes. Help yourself.”
textes.Un mot sur la table : « Le plombier pass: A note on the table: “The plumber will come on Tuesday. Or Wednesday. Or never. Put a basin under the leak.”
textes.Un mot sur la table : « Liste de courses: A note on the table: “Shopping list: bread, eggs, a dragon (small), cheese. Don't forget the cheese.”
textes.Un mot sur la table : « Ne pas toucher a: A note on the table: “Don't touch the cake. Signed: Mum.” Below, in different handwriting: “What cake?”
textes.Un mot sur la table : « Partis à la plag: A note on the table: “Gone to the beach. If it's you, Gérard: the cat has ALREADY eaten. Don't listen to him.”
textes.Un mot sur la table : « RAPPEL : demain,: A note on the table: “REMINDER: tomorrow is Uncle's birthday. Buy a present. NOT socks.”
textes.Un mot sur la table : « Recette de la so: A note on the table: “Granny's soup recipe: water, vegetables, and lots of patience. Especially patience.”
textes.Un mot sur la table : « Si tu lis ce mot: A note on the table: “If you're reading this, you're in my house. While you're at it, water the plants. Thanks!”
textes.Un moteur à cristal… Seuls les Lumens d': A crystal engine… Only the Lumens of Astralys, the island floating in the sky, know how to make those crystals sing. You'd have to go and visit them.
textes.Un moteur à vapeur, j'aimerais bien… mai: A steam engine, I'd love to… but I'd need the plans from the inventors of Cliquetis, the city of gears, on the great eastern island. Go and pay them a visit!
textes.Un moustique dans une petite calebasse f: A mosquito in a little gourd closed with a leaf stopper. Kinich swears its name is Xan, like the Twins' one, and that it stings liars.
textes.Un mérou ! Un vrai, un gros ! Je vais le: A grouper! A real one, a big one! I'll be eating it for a week. Or mapping it.
textes.Un mérou… Je vais le fumer au-dessus de: A grouper… I'll smoke it over the forge. Come back for a taste.
textes.Un naufragé ne se perd jamais : il est d: A castaway never gets lost: he's already lost. It's very restful.
textes.Un navet fuyard ! Il ne mord pas… il cou: A runaway turnip! It doesn't bite… it runs. Catch up by running (Shift) and give it a little tap: it's yours.
textes.Un navet fuyard des Champs du Sud, attra: A runaway turnip from the Southern Fields, caught during an alert: it's golden, it has little arms, and it's sulking. The Guild buys it back; so do Babette and Ulric (for soup).
textes.Un nid de pie était caché dans les branc: A magpie's nest was hidden in the branches!
textes.Un nid de tagliatelles dorées, faites à: A nest of golden tagliatelle, handmade this morning by Mamma Lasagna, "while singing". For the Great Reconciliation dish. Don't squash it, don't break it, don't eat it on the way.
textes.Un nouveau ! Génial ! Viens, je te montr: A new one! Brilliant! Come on, I'll show you: there, the dormitory, Oscar snores; over there, the Duelling Ground, Pyra shouts; down below, the Chaudron Fumant, Berthe bakes pies; and up there, the Observatory, Lumen sleeps by day. Six masters, six spells! Me, I have zero. But soon one!
textes.Un ondin, un esprit de l'eau ! Il se gon: An undine, a water spirit! It swells up before pouncing: step aside. The Gust (key 1) scatters it.
textes.Un os à mâcher qui sent bon le jambon, d: A chew bone that smells deliciously of ham, from Chaussette's shop. For Sardine, the dog with the red bandana: "Give" when he's with you.
textes.Un pain rond et plat, cuit contre la par: A round, flat loaf, baked against the wall of Mérit's oven, with a little sand in it (everyone has sand in their bread in Per-Hâpy). Restores two hearts.
textes.Un panier d'osier des Jardins Partagés :: A wicker basket from the Shared Gardens: leeks, squashes, potatoes, and a carrot with a tiny bite taken out of it. For everyone's soup.
textes.Un parapluie noir, comme tous ceux de Ra: A black umbrella, like all the ones in Rainville… but underneath, when you open it, there are painted sunflowers. Mother Downpour made it fifty years ago, for her best friend.
textes.Un parapluie rouge surmonté d'une hélice: A red umbrella topped with a propeller. When you open the umbrella, the propeller spins. It's no use at all, but it's very pretty.
textes.Un parapluie… avec des tournesols peints: An umbrella… with sunflowers painted underneath. So that, even in the rain, I can see the sun. (She opens it; she laughs; she cries a little.) She promised it to me, the summer of our quarrel. Fifty years… Well. It's time two old ladies stopped being silly.
textes.Un parchemin roulé, un sceau rouge, une: A rolled-up parchment, a red seal, a little cottage drawn in the corner: "The Wisteria Cottage, Montjoie Upper Town, now belongs to its new owner. Wisteria included." Signed: Mr Prosper.
textes.Un parchemin roussi aux coins, scellé de: A parchment singed at the corners, sealed with red wax: "Bachelor of Flames, with the (slightly burnt) congratulations of the jury". Signed: Professor Malachar.
textes.Un pavillon à la poupe : six dessins au: A flag at the stern: six designs to choose from, to change whenever you like.
textes.Un perroquet ! La prochaine fois, je t'e: A parrot! Next time, I'll make you two. One for him.
A parrot ate half of it.
textes.Un petit Moaï surveille un tas de feuill: A little Moai watches over a pile of smoking leaves. “Don't step on it! It's dinner!”
textes.Un petit Moaï te fait signe : « Psst ! T: A little Moai beckons to you: “Psst! Do you know '1, 2, 3, Moai'?”
textes.Un petit champignon des mares de Ramure,: A little mushroom from the ponds of Ramure, with a pale blue cap, that glows softly at night. Mère-Lune puts them in the bridge lanterns.
textes.Un petit croc jaune, perdu par un gobeli: A small yellow fang, lost by a goblin from the Goblin Wood (he has others, and a stolen sock in each pocket). Master Hugues makes necklaces with them.
textes.Un petit diablotin te tapote la joue : «: A little imp pats your cheek: “Up you get! The circles won't go down by themselves.”
textes.Un petit démon plonge sous la table en t: A little demon dives under the table when he sees you. “MOOOMMY! A HUMAN!”
textes.Un petit museau rose sort d'entre les pl: A little pink snout pokes out from between the planks of the jetty, next to the hull of the Requin Borgne… and ducks straight back in. You'd need to put down something that smells very, very good: the aged cheese!
textes.Un petit piment rouge et luisant, du mar: A small, shiny red chilli from Zébuline's market. Demons crunch them like cherries. You're going to cry. Restores one heart (smoke out of the ears included free).
textes.Un petit pot de peinture en fer-blanc, c: A small tin pot of paint, dented by the Great Downpour, with a label: "1". Inside, the blue of Sketched Island (the Rubbed-Out Pond, the sky in the water, the streams). To be poured into cup no. 1 of the Stone Palette, in the middle of the Giants' Clearing.

A small tin pot of paint, dented by the Great Downpour, with a label: "2". Inside, the green of Sketched Island (the leaves, the grass, the moss of the Hatching Wood). To be poured into cup no. 2 of the Stone Palette, in the middle of the Giants' Clearing.

A small tin pot of paint, dented by the Great Downpour, with a label: "3". Inside, the red of Sketched Island (the poppies of the White Meadows). To be poured into cup no. 3 of the Stone Palette, in the middle of the Giants' Clearing.

A small tin pot of paint, dented by the Great Downpour, with a label: "4". Inside, the yellow of Sketched Island (the sand of the White Strand). To be poured into cup no. 4 of the Stone Palette, in the middle of the Giants' Clearing.

A small tin pot of paint, dented by the Great Downpour, with a label: "5". Inside, the brown of Sketched Island (the wood of the village, the earth of the clearing). To be poured into cup no. 5 of the Stone Palette, in the middle of the Giants' Clearing.

A small tin pot of paint, dented by the Great Downpour, with a label: "6". Inside, the purple of Sketched Island (the heather of Mount Charcoal). To be poured into cup no. 6 of the Stone Palette, in the middle of the Giants' Clearing.

A small tin pot of paint, dented by the Great Downpour, with a label: "7". Inside, the orange of Sketched Island (the Ink Waterfall at sunset). To be poured into cup no. 7 of the Stone Palette, in the middle of the Giants' Clearing.

A small tin pot of paint, dented by the Great Downpour, with a label: "8". Inside, the turquoise of Sketched Island (the Dotted Stream, all the way to the sea). To be poured into cup no. 8 of the Stone Palette, in the middle of the Giants' Clearing.

A small tin pot of paint, dented by the Great Downpour, with a label: "9". Inside, the pink of Sketched Island (the flowers of the south-western meadows). To be poured into cup no. 9 of the Stone Palette, in the middle of the Giants' Clearing.
textes.Un petit pot de sauce tomate, puisé à la: A small jar of tomato sauce, scooped with the giant ladle from the Cooking Pot of Mount Bolognese: tomato, garlic, basil, a pinch of sugar. Still warm. Restores two hearts.
textes.Un petit robot-nettoyeur te passe la ser: A little cleaning robot mops your forehead: “Please do not faint in traffic areas. Thank you.”
textes.Un petit sifflet en os sculpté, avec un: A little carved bone whistle, with a dog, a cat, a rat and a pig engraved all around it. "Use": choose which companion comes with you.
