textes.Un petit slime te tapote la joue d'une g: A little slime pats your cheek with some very cool jelly: “Blop?” (That means “get up”.)
textes.Un petit sort de bulle : l'air de la mai: A little bubble spell: the air in the house is a bit damp, just enough for them. You don't feel a thing. Except maybe a little dampness in your hair.
textes.Un petit trésor ! Le coffret contient :: A little treasure! The box contains:
textes.Un peu ? Il parle à un perroquet ET à de: A bit? He talks to a parrot AND to seashells. You, now, you're someone sensible.
textes.Un peu de lumière de l'Aube, et hop !: A little light of the Dawn, and presto!
A little more in tune, please.
textes.Un piano enrhumé, des bulles en forme de: A piano with a cold, heart-shaped bubbles and an offended automaton. Exactly what I thought: they've all won. I'll create three prizes. Thank you, juror! You deserve your title. And take this watch: it runs backwards, but it's accurate… backwards.
textes.Un pirate ronfle dans son hamac. Sur son: A pirate snores in his hammock. On his perch, a red parrot looks at you… and is very, very eager to chat.
textes.Un plateau de cuivre, une théière d'arge: A copper tray, a silver teapot, colored glasses: it's tea time.
textes.Un pogo à la Halle Hurlante: A mosh pit at the Howling Hall
textes.Un poing de fer ? Pour toi ? … Hm. Il me: An iron fist? For you? … Hm. I need three crocodile teeth. Not dog teeth, not shark teeth: crocodile from the Drowned Marsh, to the west. They're as hard as steel. I'll set them in the metal, and your fists will hit like hammers. But the crocodiles, they bite like anvils. Watch out for the water.
textes.Un poisson frais ! Gaston, sors la poêle: A fresh fish! Gaston, get out the frying pan! Well… the flat stone.
textes.Un poisson noble qui se défend bien. Ren: A noble fish that puts up a good fight. Restores one and a half hearts.
textes.Un poisson-perroquet ! Ne le dis pas à G: A parrotfish! Don't tell Gaston, he'd think it's a cousin.
textes.Un pot de gelée verte, tremblotante, qui: A jar of wobbly green jelly that goes "bloop" when you shake it. Aubin, the apothecary, makes ointments with it; Madame Olga, potions; the children, mischief.
textes.Un printemps, Nimiel s'est cachée sous m: One spring, Nimiel hid under my cloak, at the bottom of my boat, to go and see the humans. She sneezed right in the middle of the mist. I had to turn back. She sulked for a whole day, which is her record. The next day, she was already planning her next hiding place.
textes.Un prix ? C'est déjà un prix. Le fer coû: A discount? That IS the discount. Iron costs, charcoal costs, Clou costs. No.
textes.Un problème ? Une catastrophe ! Marcel a: A problem? A catastrophe! Marcel played like a beginner and the jack shot off towards the fountain. No way to find it. No jack, no pétanque. No pétanque, no life.
textes.Un programme pour que mon frigo me dise: A program so my fridge says hello to me… Cheap… Hm.
textes.Un ptéranodon (Grand-Bec) ! Il tourne au: A pteranodon (Big-Beak)! It circles above you, screeches… then dives. Roll aside! It climbs back slowly, very low: that's your moment to strike.
textes.Un punch coco à la paillote: A coconut punch at the beach hut
textes.Un rayon de miel trouvé dans un arbre cr: A honeycomb found in a hollow tree. Restores two hearts.
textes.Un ressort tout brillant, tombé d'un rob: A shiny spring that fell off one of Lisse's robots. It goes "boing" when you let go of it. Ferraille puts them in her sculptures; Cradoc in his shoes.
textes.Un rhum de la Balafre au comptoir: A Balafre dark tonic at the counter
textes.Un robot ! Il fait une révérence, perd u: A robot! He bows, drops a bolt, picks it up, and bows again.
A robot! Shall I bite it? I'M BITING IT.
textes.Un robot déménageur de Lisse & Fils ! Tr: A Lisse & Fils mover robot! Very polite… and very heavy. When it raises its pincers, it's going to shove you: step aside, then strike. It falls apart into bolts and springs.
textes.Un robot soudeur ! Son arc bleu ne porte: A welder robot! Its blue arc doesn't reach far: stay out of range when the sparks fly, then strike while it cools down.
textes.Un rocher. Un vrai. Il a l'air un peu ve: A rock. A real one. It looks a little offended that someone lifted it.
textes.Un ronceux ! Ce paquet de ronces marche: A bramblekin! This bundle of brambles walks toward you and raises its thorny arms before striking: parry (F) or back off, then cut it to pieces.
textes.Un rouage ? Pour l'horloge ? … Bon. Appo: A cog? For the clock? … Fine. Bring me two logs to heat the forge, and three stones for the mould. I'll do the rest.
textes.Un rouage neuf forgé par Hector pour l'h: A new cogwheel forged by Hector for the town hall clock. It shines like a gold coin.
A cog has broken in the mechanism. Hector, the armourer, could forge a new one. But he always says he has no time. Would you mind talking to him?
textes.Un rouleau de toile épaisse, tissée serr: A roll of thick, tightly woven canvas that smells of salt and hemp. For ships' sails… and the wings of flying machines.
textes.Un rubis… Il brille comme ma forge un so: A ruby… It glows like my forge on a winter evening. {prix} coins, and I won't ask where it came from.
textes.Un sablé en forme d'engrenage, au beurre: A gear-shaped shortbread, with butter and cinnamon. The teeth are crunchy. Restores two hearts.
textes.Un sac de toile plein de chaînes, de péd: A canvas bag full of chains, pedals, spokes, brake pads, and a bell shaped like a rat. Ferraille had hidden them for Rustine.
textes.Un sceau de pierre barré de chaînes de b: A stone seal barred with bronze chains. Behind it, an icy breath… You would need the key of the Ancients.
textes.Un second saut en plein vol (Espace, ou: A second jump in mid-air (Space, or A in VR, a second time in the air).
textes.Un secret : le coffre de paie de la Moue: A secret: the Seagull's pay chest was made of ironwood, bound with copper. If your shovel hits metal, call me. We'll split it. Sixty-forty. My way.
textes.Un secret de cartographe : les jarres de: A cartographer's secret: the jars in your village put themselves back together. Nobody knows why. Me neither. But I pretend I do.
textes.Un secret de cartographe : sur ma carte,: A cartographer's secret: on my map, I'd marked the Seagull's pay chest. On the sea side, about twenty paces from Octave's great kapok tree, between three flat stones. He lives right next to it and has never found it. He doesn't read my maps. Take a shovel.
textes.Un serre-tête avec deux oreilles de rena: A headband with two red felt fox ears with black tips. A gift from Mère-Lune: in Ramure, they take you for one of their own.
textes.Un sifflet qui ne fait aucun bruit. L'in: A whistle that makes no sound at all. The inventor insists it's perfect for calling fish.
textes.Un slime ! Une petite gelée qui rebondit: A slime! A little jelly that bounces. When it squashes down flat, it's about to jump on you: step aside, then strike. The blue and pink ones are tougher.
textes.Un soir où son four boudait, je lui ai c: One evening when her oven was sulking, I sang it a bark lullaby. The bread rose. Sylwen swears it was luck. And yet, ever since, she comes to fetch me every time her oven is in a mood.
textes.Un soir, j'ai laissé une couronne de feu: One evening, I left a crown of golden leaves on his big black speakers, to thank him. He wore it until dawn. He tells everyone he has a secret admirer. That's not untrue.
textes.Un sorbet de fruits rouges et de cannell: A sorbet of red berries and fire cinnamon, served in an obsidian cup: hot inside, ice-cold outside (or the other way round, nobody agrees). Restores one and a half hearts.
textes.Un souci à trois têtes… non, à trois chi: A three-headed problem… no, a three-dog problem. Wild hellhounds, on the lava field, east of the volcano. They're not bad, just ill-mannered. They spit fire at passersby. My guard is busy guarding. Will you take care of it? When the jaws glow red, step aside.
textes.Un souffle de mécanique : il remet en ma: A mechanical breath: it restarts old mechanisms from afar and paralyses automatons.
textes.Un souffle glacé : les ennemis se figent: An icy breath: enemies freeze; on a lake, a path of ice.
textes.Un souffle glacé sort de l'antre. Au bou: An icy breath comes out of the lair. At the end of the corridor, an immense flooded cavern… Get ready.
textes.Un squelette de pirate ! Il lève son cou: A pirate skeleton! It raises its cutlass before striking: parry (F) or roll (Ctrl), then strike. Bones break, you know.
textes.Un temple, sous l'île… Si tu croises des: A temple, under the island… If you run into critters down there, don't come crying to me: buy my sword first.
textes.Un thé bleu nuit où flottent des paillet: A midnight-blue tea with flecks of gold floating in it, served at the Nebula Café. It tastes of mint, rain and something else that no one can quite name. Restores one heart.
textes.Un thé à la menthe sur la terrasse: A mint tea on the terrace
textes.Un tiers de parchemin jauni, déchiré en: A third of a yellowed parchment, torn in a zigzag, covered in dotted lines, arrows and stains: a piece of Barbe-Sanglante's map.
textes.Un touriste de l'espace ? Vert ? Gélatin: A space tourist? Green? Jelly-like? (She bursts out laughing.) He can come in for a drink, he won't be the weirdest one in the room! Right, the photo. Hold on. (She spits in her hand, smooths her hair, strikes a pose with her fists on her hips.) Like this. With the Crâne Fendu behind me. So everyone can see it's a respectable tavern. Click! … I look small in there. And all shiny. I like it. Tell your jelly we pay BEFORE we brawl.
textes.Un touriste de l'espace qui a peur de de: A space tourist who's afraid to come down? (She puts down her knitting.) Tell him that here in Boucan, everyone is welcome. Punks, reformed robots, rats, dogs in bandanas… A green jelly was all we were missing. (She raises her fist, standing very straight, with a big smile.) Click! You tell him: “The door is open. It fell down in 1998, but it's open.”
textes.Un tricorne de feutre noir galonné d'or,: A black felt tricorn trimmed with gold braid, a red feather stuck in the side: Barbe-Sanglante's own, which Old Silas kept for a hundred years for the heir to the treasure.
textes.Un tricératops (Corne-Sur-Nez) ! Quand i: A triceratops (Nose-Horn)! When it scratches the ground with its foot, it's going to CHARGE straight ahead: step aside… and if it hits a rock or a tree, it sees stars. Strike then!
textes.Un vent du large qui repousse les ennemi: A sea wind that pushes enemies back, flips shells over, turns sails and windmills.
textes.Un vent furieux tourbillonne autour de l: A furious wind swirls around the Citadel: Ventaile refuses to go near. Land on the Wind Perch, south of the island.
A furious wind swirls around the Citadel: you can't get near it. Land on the Wind Field, south of the island.
textes.Un ver de terre, vexé d'avoir été dérang: An earthworm, offended at being disturbed. It leaves with a sigh (for a worm).
textes.Un verre de rhum de la Murène: A glass of La Murène dark tonic
textes.Un verrou de moins ! Regarde-le, il comm: One lock down! Look at it, it's starting to sweat.
textes.Un vieil ampli à lampes, lourd comme un: An old tube amp, heavy as a donkey, with knobs that go up to eleven. When you switch it on, it purrs. When Clou plays, it roars.
textes.Un vieux coffre cerclé de fer, fermé par: An old iron-bound chest, shut with a chain of bones. It won't give. On the lid, engraved: “To whoever carries my map. B.S.”
textes.Un vieux coquillage, apporté là par un o: An old seashell, brought here by a mischievous bird. This head looks at the sea, not the sky.
textes.Un vieux parchemin offert par Églantine,: An old parchment given by Églantine, the freed Bramble Queen. It shows the passage through the reefs and the ashes, to the west, all the way to the dwarves' volcanic island.
textes.Un vieux parchemin taché de rhum : une c: An old stained parchment: a coastline, dotted lines, a red cross. Captain Salazar Croc-de-Sel cares about it more than his wooden leg.
textes.Un virus ? Dans MES programmes ? Impossi: A virus? In MY programs? Impossible! They're guaranteed. Guaranteed… something. (He looks away.) Go see little Glitch: she knows about… about things. Mornings and evenings, she hangs around near the Arcade Station; in the afternoon, in the arcade hall. Me, I have an appointment. Very far away. Right now.
textes.Un virus ? Dans MON programme ? (Il devi: A virus? In MY program? (He turns all red, then all purple, to match his hat.) Well. All right. Maybe. I bought it from a dealer even cheaper than me, and I hadn't tried it… I'm giving you your coins back, with an apology on top. And I make you a promise: from now on, Monsieur Fil will only sell verified programs! Verified by Glitch. She said yes. Well, she said “we'll see”. It's almost yes.
textes.Un visage de roi fait de centaines de pe: A king's face made of hundreds of little squares of jade, with eyes of mother-of-pearl and obsidian. The mask of the kings of Yaxché, kept deep in Xibalba. Its place is on the Altar of the Three Suns.
textes.Un visiteur ! À inscrire ! Au registre !: A visitor! To be registered! In the register! (He opens an immense book, which falls on his foot.) Ahem ahem. According to article twelve, I write your name in lumen letters... There. According to article thirteen, you must now curtsy. No, not like that. Not like that either. According to article fourteen... Ah, there is no article fourteen. Well. You're registered. Congratulations. That was very protocolary.
textes.Un éboulement bloque la galerie. Au-delà: A rockfall blocks the gallery. Beyond it, you can hear water flowing… You'll have to find another way. (Work in progress!)
textes.Un éclat de cristal qui bat doucement, c: A shard of crystal that beats gently, like a heart. It is warm, and it sings a single, very pure note.
textes.Un éclat de glace bleue qui ne fond jama: A shard of blue ice that never melts, even in your hand, even in Pandémonia. It comes from the Cocytus, the frozen lake of the Ninth Circle.
textes.Un éclat de la grande lentille s'est dét: A shard of the great lens broke off during the storm. It fell into the sea, at the foot of the point, on the seaward side. Six metres down, maybe. I'm too old to dive. Without it, my lighthouse no longer lights the night.
textes.Un éclat rose et tiède, laissé par une a: A pink, warm shard, left behind by a crystal spider. Grommelot the sprite collects them; Mélisse buys them.
textes.Un écusson brodé : un rat à crête verte: An embroidered patch: a yelling green-crested rat, and "BILGE RATS" in red letters. Velours sews them herself, one by one, for the true fans.
textes.Un élixir doré qui pétille comme un ciel: A golden elixir that sparkles like a summer sky. It restores all your magic, and two hearts. Gustave won't say what he puts in it.
textes.Un élémentaire de magma ! Quand il gonfl: A magma elemental! When it swells up and glows red, it's going to leap at you: step aside, then strike while it cools.
textes.Un œil d'or et de lapis-lazuli, l'œil qu: An eye of gold and lapis lazuli, the eye the god Horus lost fighting Set and that Thoth healed: the sign of the light that always comes back. Brought back from the depths of the Pyramid of Ra. Its place is on the Altar of the Three Suns.
textes.Un œil de pierre… Les petits Moaïs du pl: A stone eye… The little Moai on the plateau might know who it belongs to. (The eldest, Granny Basalte, knows all the legends.)
textes.Une Grande Lanterne éteinte, aussi haute: An unlit Great Lantern, as tall as a giant's street lamp. To light it, you'd need a flame from a living ember: Lumina, the lantern-keeper, keeps some in her lantern.
textes.Une Série Z… « Voix numéro zéro ». La to: A Z Series… “Voice number zero”. The city's very first android voice. Cargo kept it all this time. (He cleans it, blows on it, examines it through the lens of his monocle.) It works. I set Zéro up on my workbench, he was waiting. Click. There. Go and see him… I think he has something to tell you.
textes.Une VRAIE vieille botte ?! Avec le trou: A REAL old boot?! With the hole at the end?! Wonderful! I'll put it next to my other treasures. Here, it pays well!
textes.Une affiche : « LES TAUPES HURLANTES — c: A poster: “THE HOWLING MOLES — concert Saturday — admission: one cake”
textes.Une affiche du Grand Boucan, de la part: A poster for the Great Boucan, from Port-Boucan!
textes.Une affiche du Grand Boucan, pour le Crâ: A poster for the Great Boucan, for the Crâne Fendu!
textes.Une affiche du Grand Boucan, pour votre: A poster for the Great Boucan, for your inn!
textes.Une affiche sérigraphiée, encore odorant: A screen-printed poster that still smells of ink: a green-crested rat yells into a microphone, and in dancing letters: "THE GREAT BOUCAN — THE BILGE RATS — FREE, LOUD, AND FULL OF LOVE". To take to the other islands.
textes.Une amulette de faïence bleue en forme d: A blue faience amulet shaped like a scarab, its underside engraved with little signs. The scarab is Khepri, the morning sun reborn. Ptahmose carves them; they say they bring luck.
textes.Une amulette de pierre verte en forme de: An amulet of green stone in the shape of a face, warm under your fingers: a piece of the body of Osiris, which Set had scattered. Four of them are needed for the sarcophagus of Osiris.
textes.Une ancre tatouée sur l'avant-bras : les: An anchor tattooed on your forearm: the pirates of the Balafre pick on you a little less.
textes.Une ancre, sur l'avant-bras. Simple, sol: An anchor, on your forearm. Simple, sturdy, like you. Don't move… (bzzzt, bzzzt…) There. Show it at the counter: around here, folks who wear my mark get picked on a little less.
textes.Une antenne de radio tordue, faite d'un: A bent radio antenna, made from an old rake, a coat hanger and lots of sticky tape. It picks up everything: radio waves, the wind, and sometimes the seagulls' conversations.
textes.Une araignée de cristal ! Elle se dresse: A crystal spider! It rears up before biting: back off or parry (F). Its shards are surely of interest to someone…
textes.Une arme ? Non. Je n'en ai pas besoin, e: A weapon? No. I don't need one, and the Tree doesn't like iron.
textes.Une armure animée ! Elle est vide… et el: An animated suit of armor! It's empty… and it fights. When it raises its sword, parry (F) or roll (Ctrl), then strike.
textes.Une armure complète trône au milieu du s: A full suit of armor stands in the middle of the living room. Its owner gazes at it like a treasure.
textes.Une armure étincelante, polie comme un m: A gleaming suit of armor, polished like a mirror. On the breastplate, someone has engraved: “Property of Sir Fanfaron. Do not touch. Except to make it shine.”
textes.Une autre fois, alors ! Notre porte est: Another time, then! Our door is always open. Well… you saw, you came in.
Another story about %s? Listen to this.
Another story about %s? Listen to this.
textes.Une bague de marin, avec une pierre bleu: A sailor's ring with a blue stone. Octave buys it for 18 coins.
textes.Une baguette croustillante de Margaux. O: A crusty baguette from Margaux. Half of it gets eaten before you reach home. Restores two hearts.
textes.Une baguette de fée en bois de sureau, t: A fairy wand of elderwood, tipped with a crystal star. Pimprenelle lost it in the Cave of the Jumping Mushrooms.
textes.Une bergerie sous la montagne ? Montrez-: A sheepfold beneath the mountain? Show me… Sheep, a cogwheel, a ridge. But I know it! With my big spyglass, I can see the whole north slope of the Stoneheart. Southeast of the city, at the foot of the mountain, there's a cave: the Wind Sheepfold, the shepherds call it. They haven't gone there since black brambles blocked the entrance. Brambles that won't burn, it seems… Well, that won't burn with an ordinary lighter.
textes.Une bibliothèque immense pour une si pet: An immense library for such a small house. One of the books, all red, sticks out a little.
textes.Une bombe de peinture faite maison par P: A homemade spray can by Pigment (made with beetroot, spinach or blueberry: it smells a bit like soup). In front of a paintable wall in Port-Boucan (the Expression Wall, bare walls): E to paint a graffiti.
textes.Une bonne nuit de sommeil… Tous vos cœur: A good night's sleep… All your hearts are back.
textes.Une botte de spaghettis séchés au Séchoi: A bundle of spaghetti dried at the Drying Shed of Al Dente Island, made with durum wheat from its fields. Tied with a green, white and red ribbon.
textes.Une boule de feu : elle brûle les ennemi: A fireball: it burns enemies and brambles, lights braziers and torches.
textes.Une boule de feu qui file droit devant :: A fireball that flies straight ahead: it burns enemies and lights braziers and torches.
A ball of light follows you for a minute. It lights up the dark and wakes sleeping runes.
textes.Une bourrasque te rattrape et te repose: A gust catches you and sets you down on the Wind Perch.
textes.Une bourse de cuir rouge brodée d'une ve: A red leather purse embroidered with a black widow spider, heavy with forty coins: Gontran Lestrange's debt to Mama Grog.
textes.Une bourse de poussière qui scintille de: A pouch of dust that sparkles in every colour, found in the chest of the Fairy Garden. Lumi says you'll need a lot of it to get past the brambles.
textes.Une boussole qui indique le sud. Des deu: A compass that points south. At both ends. So you never get lost heading south.
textes.Une branche de corail rouge du fond de l: A branch of red coral from the bottom of the bay. Ground up, it makes a brilliant pigment.
textes.Une branche solide. Servira à fabriquer: A sturdy branch. Good for making tools.
textes.Une brume épaisse, dorée… Le bateau tour: A thick, golden mist… The boat goes round in circles and comes out where it started. You'd need a guide to get through.
textes.Une canette glacée sortie d'un distribut: An ice-cold can from a Neopolis vending machine. "Sparkling Moon Fruit": nobody knows what moon fruit tastes like, but it's good. It glows a little in the dark. Restores one heart.
textes.Une carte ? De la surface ? Ha ! Je vais: A card? From the surface? Ha! I'll hang it behind my counter. The lads are going to be jealous.
textes.Une carte ? Pour moi ? Personne ne m'a é: A card? For me? Nobody has written to me since… Gaston, look, a card! There's a lighthouse on it. I'll nail it up above my hammock.
textes.Une carte de cuir épais, à ton nom, avec: A card of thick leather, with your name, your portrait (very lifelike, except the nose) and the letter of your rank in a red circle. Églantine stamps it for every contract completed. Clac, the stamp, has left its mark on it.
textes.Une carte des Récifs de Feu ? Les nains: A map of the Fire Reefs? The dwarves! They pay in gold, they do. If you get into Forgefer, mention me: Octave Taillefer, honest trader. Well… trader.
textes.Une carte du ciel dessinée à l'encre de: A sky map drawn in ink of light: the stars move gently across it, in time with the real ones.
textes.Une carte postale de Port-Azur : le phar: A postcard from Port-Azur: the lighthouse, the bay, and on the back, Nadine's round handwriting.
textes.Une carte postale de Port-Azur pour vous: A postcard from Port-Azur for you!
textes.Une carte stellaire ? Pour un glisseur ?: A star chart? For a glider? (He pulls a scroll from his bag and unrolls it: stars drawn in ink of light, moving gently.) I made it for myself, but I never fly. I get dizzy above three steps. Take it. North is at the top. Well… on this chart, north moves a little. Like the stars. Trust the stars, they know the way.
textes.Une cave pleine de pots de confiture. De: A cellar full of jam jars. Hundreds. There's even a jam made of… pickles?
textes.Une cave à fromages ! Des dizaines de me: A cheese cellar! Dozens of wheels… and a smell that would make an onion cry.
textes.Une chambre dans la pénombre. Sous la co: A dimly lit bedroom. Under the quilt, someone snores peacefully.
textes.Une chambre douce et chaude. Près du feu: A soft, warm room. By the fire, an anvil-shaped cradle. A dwarf woman knits, very, very softly.
textes.Une chambre sous les toits pour la nuit: A room under the eaves for the night
textes.Une chambre sur la terrasse pour la nuit: A room on the terrace for the night
textes.Une chambre à ressorts pour la nuit: A room with springs for the night
textes.Une champignonnière secrète ! Des champi: A secret mushroom farm! Mushrooms everywhere… and some of them glow in the dark.
textes.Une chatte rousse et blanche te regarde: A red and white cat watches you from the very top of the beam, her tail curled over her paws. She won't come down for just anybody… You'd need something to interest her: Pauline's ball of wool!
textes.Une chatte tigrée rousse et blanche, trè: A very dignified ginger-and-white tabby cat lives on the rooftops of Port-Azur harbour. Every morning, she pinches a sardine from Rosalie, the fishmonger. Rosalie calls her Brioche. She'd like her to finally have someone of her own. Brioche won't let anyone come near her… except, perhaps, someone with a ball of wool.
textes.Une chaîne de fer noir, scellée dans un: A chain of black iron, sealed into a block of basalt by a humming blue rune: the mark of the golems. Ventaile tugs at it, exhausted. Strike the rune with a weapon to break it!
textes.Une chope d'hydromel au comptoir: A mug of honey drink at the counter
textes.Une chope de bière brune et mousseuse br: A mug of dark, foamy fizz brewed beneath the mountain. Restores one and a half hearts… and warms your ears.
textes.Une chope de la Chope Ardente: A mug from the Chope Ardente
textes.Une chorale ! Le chef d'orchestre agite: A choir! The conductor waves a twig. The singers do their best. Their best is very loud.
textes.Une clochette d'argent ! Écoute… ting !: A little silver bell! Listen… ting! See? A pebble at the start, a bell at the end, and along the way, four happy friends. That's the Great Swap. You're a real tanuki now. Here, my tanuki bell: you hang it on your belt, and all the merchants of Ramure will give you a wink.
textes.Une clé d'argent ciselée de petits hibou: A silver key engraved with little owls, found in the only chest in the Library of Mimics that doesn't bite. It opens the stairway to the top floor.
textes.Une clé de cuivre vert-de-grisé, un peu: A verdigris copper key, a little slimy: it was in the belly of a giant frog in the Underground Lake. It opens the gate on the third floor of the dungeon.
textes.Une copie, faite par Amenemhat le scribe: A copy, made by Amenemhat the scribe, of the papyrus that sleeps in the pyramid: Thoth, the ibis-headed god, points to a royal cartouche. Three signs, one under the other: an ibis, an eye, a sun.
textes.Une corde de plus pour la Corderie. Il e: One more rope for the Ropeworks. They'll need plenty to stretch the festival canvas.
textes.Une corde solide, tordue à la main à la: A sturdy rope, twisted by hand at Galet's Ropeworks, with hemp from the island's fields. It smells of straw and sunshine.
textes.Une couchette avec couverture et oreille: A bunk with a blanket and a pillow: when stopped, far from shore, at night, press E to sleep until morning, rocked by the waves.
textes.Une coupe sculptée dans le bois du Chêne: A cup carved from the wood of the Mother Oak, engraved with a running rabbit. Bondi kept it for three years. Now it's yours.
textes.Une cuisine de nain : des marmites de fe: A dwarven kitchen: iron pots, enormous ladles, and an old cook humming along.
textes.Une cuisse de grenouille géante du lac,: A giant frog leg from the lake, as big as a ham. Ulric grills it with garlic at "La Grenouille Repue". Restores one and a half hearts (and tastes like chicken, apparently).
textes.Une curiosité authentique, my friend ! U: An authentic curiosity, my friend! A feather from the dwarves' giant eagle, a scale from the naga serpent of the deep… or, failing that, a shark's tooth. Bring me one and I'll pay you in gold.
textes.Une dent de tyrannosaure longue comme un: A tyrannosaurus tooth as long as an arm… made of little squares, like everything that comes from Pixelithic Island. Grosse-Dent lost it when he fell asleep. The Clan says it brings luck (as long as you don't give it back).
textes.Une dent jaune et pointue, dure comme l': A pointed yellow tooth, hard as steel, taken from a crocodile of the Drowned Marsh. Brutus sets them in his iron fists; Isaac Cinq-Doigts buys them for six coins.
textes.Une dent longue comme un avant-bras, jau: A tooth as long as a forearm, yellowed by a hundred years of swamp: Vieille-Dent's, the giant crocodile. Isaac Cinq-Doigts offers forty coins for it.
textes.Une dent triangulaire, coupante comme un: A triangular tooth, sharp as a razor, lost by a shark from the Coral garden. Coralin, the craftsman of Atlantis, makes flippers from them.
textes.Une deuxième durite lâche ! OPTIMUS-LISS: A second hose gives way! OPTIMUS-LISSE panics: it strikes faster than ever!
textes.Une deuxième flamme. On dirait que la sa: A second flame. The hall seems to hold its breath.
textes.Une elfe ? Et elle n'aime pas les haches: An elf? And she doesn't like axes, I bet. Of course. People who don't like axes have never been cold.
textes.Une elfe ?! Au milieu de l'île ?! Gaston: An elf?! In the middle of the island?! Gaston, do you hear that? Elves exist! Well, Gaston says he knew it. Gaston always says he knew it.
textes.Une enveloppe cachetée de cire rouge, ac: An envelope sealed with red wax, bought at the post office. Perfect for a declaration of love.
textes.Une enveloppe épaisse, cachetée de cire: A thick envelope, sealed with red wax, with the recipient's name written in round, careful letters. Brindille, the winged postwoman, is counting on you.
textes.Une fausse note ! Les clochettes grincen: A wrong note! The bells creak… and will-o'-the-wisps burst out, snickering!
textes.Une fiole de brume, pour la forge ?: A vial of mist, for the forge?
An elven vial, thin as a bubble. Lyra entrusted it to you to draw the spring water from the pool of the great waterfall (north-east of Village Island).
textes.Une flamme d'or qui danse dans une coupe: A golden flame dancing in a crystal cup, with no wood or oil. It doesn't burn your fingers: it warms your heart. Stolen by the Frost Titan; its place is in the Ember Heart of the Forge Cathedral.
textes.Une flaque de boue ! Non ? Pas maintenan: A mud puddle! No? Not now? Okay…
textes.Une fleur aux pétales de flamme, jaune a: A flower with petals of flame, yellow at the heart, red at the tips, which only grows on the slopes of the Great Blaze. It stays warm in your hand. Mother Brasille needs it for her flowerbeds.
textes.Une fleur aux pétales translucides dans: A flower with translucent petals in which tiny galaxies swirl.
textes.Une fleur blanche aux pétales lumineux,: A white flower with glowing petals, picked from the top of a jungle peak. It never wilts.
textes.Une fleur géante jaillit du bois, tentac: A giant flower bursts out of the wood, tentacles of brambles and jaws as big as a door: MOTHER BRAMBLE! She's the one who turned the plants of Yggdrasil mean.
textes.Une fois toutes les dix minutes, un coup: Once every ten minutes, a blow that should knock you out leaves you at half a heart.
textes.Une fois, chez les nains, on a fait la f: Once, at the dwarves', we partied in a mine. The echo, friends…
textes.Une fontaine qui soigne, sous terre ? On: A healing fountain, underground? We bottle it and make a fortune. … What, it's sacred? Everything's sacred, as long as it sells.
textes.Une forêt… Oh, {surnom}. C'est la plus b: A forest… Oh, {surnom}. That's the most beautiful thing a human has ever said to me. The trees heard you, I promise. They hear everything.
textes.Une fumée âcre, des récifs noirs qui fum: Acrid smoke, black reefs smoking in the waves… No way to find a passage. Without a map, you'd better turn back.
textes.Une galerie froide, des dalles noires co: A cold gallery, flagstones as black as holes in the night… Something is moving in them.
textes.Une galerie sous la mer, jusqu'à la jung: A tunnel under the sea, all the way to the jungle? I'd drawn it as a dotted line on my map. Dotted lines are for things I'm not sure of. I was right!
textes.Une galette de pain moelleuse, dorée au: A soft flatbread, baked golden in the Borgo oven, studded with rosemary and coarse salt, glistening with olive oil. Mamma Lasagna bakes three batches a day. Restores one and a half hearts.
textes.Une gargouille ! Quand elle bat des aile: A gargoyle! When it flaps its wings very fast and rears up, it's going to dive straight at you: step aside, then strike.
textes.Une gelée violette qui tremble toute seu: A purple jelly that wobbles all by itself and sparkles, Gloubi's speciality. It tickles your tongue. Restores two hearts.
textes.Une goutte de rosée de lune. Elle reste: A drop of moon dew. It stays round and cool in the hollow of your hand. (Brindille, in the Fairy Village, is looking for five.)
textes.Une goutte de rosée qui ne s'évapore jam: A dewdrop that never evaporates and shines like a little moon. Brindille the fairy is looking for five.
textes.Une goélette ? Commence par le sloop, ma: A schooner? Start with the sloop, sailor: you don't learn to run before you walk… or to steer two masts before one.
textes.Une graine dorée ?… Attends. ATTENDS. Ga: A golden seed?… Wait. WAIT. Gaston, the treasure box! Here: I picked it up on the beach twenty years ago, it was shining in the sand. I always knew it was special. Take it, for your elf. And tell her Barnabé Coquillard sends his respects. Most humbly.
textes.Une graine dorée, grosse comme un œuf, v: A golden seed as big as an egg, veined with light: the first seed of the World Tree in a hundred years. The spirit of the tree entrusted it to you for the fairies. It is warm, and it seems to breathe.
textes.Une graine dorée, lourde et tiède. Barna: A golden seed, heavy and warm. Barnabé found it on a beach twenty years ago. It comes from the elves' Mother Tree.
textes.Une graine ronde et tiède qui luit comme: A round, warm seed that glows like a night-light. Photon says it grows into a flower that sings when the sun rises.
textes.Une grande assiette de spaghettis de Mam: A big plate of Mamma Lasagna's spaghetti, covered in volcano sauce, with three meatballs and a snowfall of parmesan. Blessed (a little) by the Noodles. Restores three hearts.
textes.Une grande dalle ronde gravée, entre les: A large round engraved slab, between the two shrines. “When the rain and the sun have received their offering, the path of the Five Suns will open.”
textes.Une grande feuille signée par Monsieur A: A large sheet signed by Mr Aldric Lisse (very small) and by all of Port-Boucan (very big, with drawings): "The old port belongs to those who live in it, bring it to life and share it. Forever."
textes.Une grande fresque, peinte il y a très l: A great fresco, painted long ago: a shepherd and his sheep at the foot of a grey mountain, a cave, and in the cave a bronze cogwheel. Above, the ridge of Stoneheart, seen from the north. An astronomer with a big telescope would surely know where that is…
textes.Une grande pierre ronde, gravée d'un cro: A big round stone, engraved with a silver crescent. Nothing on it… “Only the moon knows where it sleeps,” Mother Moon used to say. You will have to come back when the moon rises (night falls around 8 p.m.; you can sleep at the inn to wait for it).
textes.Une grande plume dorée. Utilise-la (ou G: A large golden feather. Use it (or G on PC, X button in VR) to call Ventaile: she arrives and lands near you. Then E (trigger) to climb onto her back.
textes.Une grenouille géante ! Elle bondit, fou: A giant frog! It leaps, lashes out with its tongue… and swallows whole whatever passes by. Keep your distance, parry (F) its jumps, and strike when it lands.
textes.Une grenouille à chapeau pointu, assise: A frog in a pointy hat, sitting very dignified on a chair. It looks at you sternly. “Ribbit.”
textes.Une grosse clé de fer noir, tiède, une f: A big key of black iron, warm, with a golden flame in the ring. Brother Cendrin, the keeper of the Ember Heart, guards it: it opens the gate of the Nine Circles, at the back of the Forge Cathedral.
textes.Une grosse clé de laiton, accrochée à un: A big brass key, tied to a cork (so it floats). It opens the captain's cabin of the Baleine Rouillée, the old freighter that houses Radio Boucan.
textes.Une grosse conque rose. Elle sent la mer: A big pink conch. It smells of the sea. It looks like it can make a lot, A LOT of noise.
textes.Une grosse marmite fume devant le feu. U: A big pot steams in front of the fire. An old dwarf tastes it and frowns: “Something's missing…”
textes.Une grosse tomate de la Tomateraie de l': A big tomato from the Tomato Grove of Al Dente Island, heavy, ribbed, warm from the sun. Restores one heart.
textes.Une grotte cachée derrière la cascade !: A cave hidden behind the waterfall! Crystals glow in the half-light… and there, at the back, an old chest.
textes.Une guitare qui grince, une voix qui mur: A creaky guitar, a whispering voice, and rain recorded in the garage. Everyone in the yurt closes their eyes.
textes.Une image de la ville des humains, au bo: A picture of the humans' town, by the sea… How strange, and sweet. Thank the one who wrote it.
textes.Une image du monde d'en haut… le soleil,: A picture of the world above… the sun, the coloured houses… Tell Nadine that the queen of Atlantis thanks her. And that she exists.
textes.Une immense dalle de pierre ferme le ven: An immense stone slab seals the Great Moai's belly. In the middle, a circle of signs glows faintly, as if breathing. Far, far below, you hear flowing water… and something singing.
textes.Une inscription ! (Elle sort un formulai: A registration! (She takes out a form, two stamps and a magnifying glass.) It's very simple: ten coins in fees, a signature here, here and there, and a little reading of your abilities with the crystal ball. It hardly bites at all. It smells a bit of apples, that's normal. Do you have the ten coins?
textes.Une jarre bleue au visage de Tlaloc, le: A blue jar with the face of Tlaloc, the god of rain: big round eyes, fangs, a moustache. Coyotl, the potter of Aztlán, shaped it and filled it with lake water for the offering.
textes.Une jarre de Tlaloc ? Ce n'est pas un po: A jar of Tlaloc? It's not a soup pot, friend. It isn't given to just anyone: Cuauhtli, the high priest, must send you. Go and see him, at the foot of the Great Temple. If he says yes, I'll make you one.
textes.Une jarre de bière d'orge, chez Mérit: A jar of barley fizz, at Mérit's
textes.Une jolie boîte de bois marquée « RIEN »: A pretty wooden box marked "NOTHING". It contains exactly what it says on it.
textes.Une jolie maison vide. Sur la table, un: A lovely empty house. On the table, a note: “If you find my cellar, I'll let you have a taste.”
textes.Une lame d'obsidienne te frôle… et t'ent: An obsidian blade grazes you… and cuts you! You step back to the entrance of the room.
textes.Une lame dans une bagarre aux poings ?!: A blade in a fistfight?! The pirates are furious: they hit harder.
textes.Une lame t'a fauché ! Attends qu'elle pa: A blade got you! Wait for it to pass, then dash.
textes.Une lame, gamin. Tiens-la en main. Je ne: A blade, lad. Hold it in your hand. I don't engrave runes on thin air.
textes.Une lanterne de proue, avec une vraie fl: A bow lantern with a real flame: at night you can see the sea ahead (and the islands see you coming).
textes.Une large ceinture de cuir clouté, à la: A wide studded leather belt, with a fist-shaped brass buckle. Nobody had worn it for forty years, until you knocked out the three champions of Port-Coutelas.
textes.Une lettre ? Pour Gorgoth ? (Le colosse: A letter? For Gorgoth? (The giant reads it very slowly, and his eyes grow wet.) It's a poem. Someone wrote me a poem. … You won't tell anyone that Gorgoth cried, okay?
textes.Une lettre ? Pour moi ? (Il l'ouvre avec: A letter? For me? (He opens it with a butter knife.) My cousin from Vulcanie is coming for the Night of Lanterns! She eats enough for four. I'll need more hot fruit punch.
textes.Une lettre pour vous, de la part de Brin: A letter for you, from Brindille.
textes.Une limonade bien fraîche. Tu en veux un: A nice cold lemonade. Want one?
textes.Une limonade maison au bar de la Halle H: A homemade lemonade at the Howling Hall bar
textes.Une longue galerie, un canal au milieu,: A long gallery, a canal in the middle, alcoves in the walls… In the distance, the rumble of rolling water. Those alcoves are not just for decoration.
textes.Une longue plume blanche aux reflets ble: A long white feather with blue glints, lost by the wind when it spins too fast. It weighs almost nothing. Zéphyrine Plume needs it to teach levitation.
textes.Une longue plume noire aux reflets bleus: A long black feather with blue glints, lost by an ash raven. Hilda makes arrows out of them… and hats.
textes.Une longue plume noire aux reflets rouge: A long black feather with red glints, lost by a Fury at the gate of Dis. It smells of smoke and anger, but it's very pretty.
textes.Une longue plume rouge vif au bout bleu,: A long bright red feather with a blue tip, given by Captain Anne-Rose Corbeau: the one Rhubarbe lost the day she found him.
textes.Une longue plume rouge vif, d'un ara de: A long bright red feather, from a macaw of the Yaxché jungle. Ix Sak, the feather weaver, sells them. They say that in Xibalba, a red feather shines like a flame that doesn't burn.
textes.Une longue-vue de laiton : à bord, touch: A brass spyglass: on board, press L (LB on the controller) to look into the distance. Islands, whales, seagulls who think they're being discreet…
textes.Une lourde grille de bronze. Pas de serr: A heavy bronze grate. No lock… The two coral guardians seem to be watching over it.
textes.Une luciole plus grosse que les autres s: A firefly bigger than the others rises from the pool… Watch carefully where it lands.
textes.Une lumière d'écume monte du coquillage: A light of sea foam rises from the shell: the Seal of Sea Spray, fresh as a wave! The wind of the open sea rises around you and makes the old sails flap: the Gust (key 1, then X; in VR: B). All that is left is to carry the four seals to the great gate.
textes.Une lumière de lune autour de toi : elle: Moonlight around you: it reveals what is hidden (bridges, slabs, writings) and makes ghosts vulnerable.
textes.Une lumière dorée descend de la voûte. L: A golden light descends from the vault. The sunken Temple is freed… In the centre of the platform, a chest has risen from the depths.
textes.Une lumière verte monte du cœur du bois: A green light rises from the heart of the wood and takes shape: tall, supple as a branch, a crown of antlers on its head… the spirit of the tree. It looks at you. (E: talk to it)
textes.Une maison abandonnée. Les meubles dorme: An abandoned house. The furniture sleeps under white sheets.
textes.Une maison abandonnée… et, au milieu de: An abandoned house… and, in the middle of the room, something white floating. Brrr.
A house under renovation. One wall is done. The other one too, but in a different color.
textes.Une maison naine bien rangée… à part le: A tidy dwarven house… except for the big hole in the wall and the mountain of rubble in front of it.
textes.Une maison ronde, toute en bois clair, a: A round house, all of pale wood, scented with flowers. An elf hums softly to little sprouts in their pots.
textes.Une maison tranquille. Personne. Juste u: A quiet house. Nobody. Just a nice rug in the middle of the room… a bit bulgy, actually.
textes.Une maison vide. Sur la table, une jolie: An empty house. On the table, a pretty brown teapot. Did it just move?
A house turned upside down. Literally.
textes.Une maison à soi : la Chaumière des Glyc: A home of your own: the Wisteria Cottage
textes.Une miche ronde, croustillante, fendue e: A round, crusty loaf, scored with a cross and dusted with flour, from Honorine's bakery. Still warm. Restores one heart.
textes.Une momie ! Lente, mais solide. Quand el: A mummy! Slow, but sturdy. When it stretches out its arms, step aside (or roll, Ctrl), then strike. Bandages do unravel.
textes.Une montre de gousset dont les aiguilles: A pocket watch whose hands turn the other way. It keeps perfect time, but backwards.
textes.Une méduse ? Rose ? Qui chante faux ? (I: A jellyfish? Pink? Singing off-key? (He flips through his notebook.) I drew her this morning without meaning to: I thought she was a cloud. There, look: she was drifting west, toward the Zero-Gravity Garden. Jellyfish love that spot, they fall upward there. If she's not there anymore, look under the waterfalls of light, at the edge of the island. Don't lean over too far. I already have enough trouble drawing people standing up.
textes.Une nuit sans lune, la carte disait « me: One moonless night, the map said “open sea”. I was at the helm. The rock showed up all of a sudden, like a bad debtor. The Seagull cracked open like a walnut. I swam until morning, my hammer on my belt. On the beach stood this great kapok tree. I slept two years on one of its branches before I built the hut.
textes.Une nuée de fées te rattrape au vol, en: A swarm of fairies catches you in mid-air, laughing, and sets you back down in the glade. “Mind the edge!”
textes.Une odeur de pain d'épices et de beurre: A smell of gingerbread and melted butter. Suddenly you're very hungry.
textes.Une page arrachée au grand grimoire de M: A page torn from Madame Olga's great spellbook: a magic circle drawn in purple ink, notes in the margin ("do not read aloud", "nor quietly"). It glows a little in the dark.
textes.Une page de « La Valse d'Azur », la chan: A page of "La Valse d'Azur", Django's song. The notes are a little faded by the sea spray.
textes.Une paire de baguettes de batterie en ér: A pair of maple drumsticks, chewed at the tips, with "BILGE RATS" carved in with a knife. They're waiting for someone who can keep a good beat.
textes.Une pancarte gravée : « GRAND CONCOURS D: An engraved sign: “GREAT GRIMACE CONTEST — 1,147th edition.”
textes.Une part de gâteau rien que pour toi !: A slice of cake just for you!
textes.Une partie ? Non ? Regardez-le jouer con: A game? No? Watch it play against itself, then. … A draw. It's offended. Don't tell the jury it's offended.
textes.Une partie de pétanque. Je gagne. Presqu: A game of pétanque. I'm winning. Almost.
textes.Une pelle d'Octave ! Hmpf. Elle creuse,: One of Octave's shovels! Hmph. It digs, I suppose. Go and dig up the beach here, then: I lost some coins there at low tide.
textes.Une pelle. Le meilleur ami du chercheur: A shovel. A treasure hunter's best friend. Stick it in the beach sand and push: click, and it digs. Each spot can only be dug once, so keep moving.
textes.Une pelote de laine rouge vif, un peu dé: A ball of bright red wool, a little unravelled. No cat in the world can resist it. Not even very dignified cats.
textes.Une perle ! Elle ira au centre de ma col: A pearl! It'll go in the middle of my collection, between the mother-of-pearl and the mother-of-pearl. Thank you, {surnom}.
textes.Une perle bien ronde, sortie d'un trésor: A perfectly round pearl, taken from a buried treasure. Octave buys it for 10 coins.
textes.Une perle grosse comme une prune, qui lu: A pearl as big as a plum, glowing with a blue light. The Great Crystal of Atlantis feeds on them. Queen Néréa is waiting for three.
textes.Une petite araignée a tissé une toile en: A little spider has spun a web between the head's chin and the grass. Nothing else.
textes.Une petite clochette de laiton au bout d: A little brass bell on the end of a green ribbon. When you shake it, somewhere, a little pig pricks up its ears.
textes.Une petite clochette forgée par Ursule e: A little bell forged by Ursule and tempered in the mist. It rings clearer than all the bells on the island.
textes.Une petite clé : approche-toi d'un coffr: A little key: go up to a locked chest and open it, it will do the rest.
textes.Une petite clé de fer à l'anneau en trèf: A small iron key with a clover-shaped ring. It opens one locked chest (only once: it stays in the lock).
textes.Une petite fiole d'huile ambrée, à l'ode: A small vial of amber oil, smelling of burnt wood and vanilla: Tiburce, the polisher, rubs it on his customers' horns until they shine like mirrors.
textes.Une petite fresque au fond de la niche :: A small fresco at the back of the niche: a pond ringed by tall trees, a bronze sluice gate on its edge, and above, a full moon pouring its light down to the bottom of the water. The mist folk, in Ramure… Mother Moon will know.
textes.Une petite lanterne d'argent et de verre: A small lantern of silver and glass, entrusted to you by Faelar. The firefly spirits of Bois-Doré can shelter inside it. Bring them back to the door of the Mother Tree.
textes.Une petite méduse rose flotte là, toute: A little pink jellyfish floats there, all trembling. Plume-de-Nuage! She looks at you… and settles above your shoulder. She follows you: gently take her back to the Greenhouse of Species (east of the city), without running too far ahead!
textes.Une petite ombre blanche, un croissant d: A little white shadow, a croissant in its mouth, racing off towards the crates east of the quay. I'd say a dog. Or a very small baker.
textes.Une petite pièce de bronze, usée, une ba: A small worn bronze coin with a boat engraved on it. The fare to cross the Acheron: Charon, the ferryman, accepts nothing else (and he counts).
A small room full of seashells. Whoever collects them has never seen the beach.
textes.Une petite pièce secrète. Un seul meuble: A small secret room. Only one piece of furniture: a chest. The kind of chest you hide behind a bookcase.
textes.Une petite salle de spectacle : une estr: A little theater: a stage, a red curtain, and an audience of little Moai waiting, giggling.
A little crossing does you good.
textes.Une petite voix étouffée : « Hi hi hi… f: A small muffled voice: “Hee hee hee… cold… all cold!”
textes.Une petite voix, quelque part : « Un, de: A small voice, somewhere: “One, two, three… No! You're the one who's seeking! You'll never find me!”
textes.Une photo ? Charmant, charmant ! Attende: A photo? Charming, charming! Wait, wait… which hat? The Tuesday hat? The cherry hat? (He tries on three.) This one. No, this one. Oh, all three. (He stacks them on his head.) Click! Oh! A little Baron made of light! With three hats! It's my best portrait. Aurore! Aurore, come and see! … Ah, no, never mind. She'll scold me about the hats.
textes.Une photo ? Pour un touriste ? (Il redre: A photo? For a tourist? (He straightens his sash, smooths his moustache, sucks in his tummy.) One moment! The left profile! It's my best. The right one lost the election at the boules club. There. Smile, Port-Azur! (Click! A little hologram of him appears, smiling.) Oh! I'm in three dimensions! Colette is going to be jealous: she's only in two.
textes.Une pierre de feu s'écrase sur toi ! Reg: A fire stone crashes down on you! Watch the ground: where it glows red, fire is about to fall.
textes.Une pierre lourde veinée de rouille, ram: A heavy stone veined with rust, picked up on the slopes of the volcano. Borin the blacksmith makes steel from it.
textes.Une pierre noire, creusée d'une empreint: A black stone, carved with a round imprint… the size of an amulet.
textes.Une pierre plate peinte à l'ocre rouge e: A flat stone painted with red ochre and chalk: it's you, as seen by Ocre, the Clan's painter. You're all square. Ocre put yellow around your head, "because you shine".
textes.Une pierre rouge qui brille comme une br: A red stone that glows like an ember. Octave buys it for 30 coins.
textes.Une pincée de ceci, une pincée de cela…: A pinch of this, a pinch of that… I'm cooking.
A room full of big round rocks. A little Moai by the door is trying very hard not to laugh.
textes.Une pièce sans gravité : les meubles se: A room with no gravity: the furniture sways gently in the air, like boats.
textes.Une pièce secrète, des plans partout sur: A secret room, plans all over the table.
textes.Une pièce secrète, et au fond, un trône…: A secret room, and at the back, a throne… made of stacked cushions, crowned with a gilded paper crown. On a sign: “Here reigns His Majesty the King of Cushions.”
textes.Une pièce secrète… pleine de portraits d: A secret room… full of portraits of the same cat. The cat himself sits enthroned in a velvet armchair. He looks at you as if YOU were the intruder.
textes.Une plante carnivore ! Elle ne bouge pas: A carnivorous plant! It doesn't move, but when it pulls its head back, it's going to bite far ahead: stay out of range, then strike right after its bite.
textes.Une plume brune et douce, laissée sur le: A soft brown feather, left on Mother Sauge's roof by the owl from the Twisted Wood that you healed.
textes.Une plume de chouette argentée, tombée u: A silvery owl feather, fallen on a full-moon night. In Ramure, every night is a full-moon night.
textes.Une plume de lune ! Avec ça, ma brume ne: A moon feather! With this, my mist won't fly away any more. Here, a vial of mist: morning mist, bottled. Ursule says she needs it to temper the silver. I don't ask bears questions.
textes.Une plume de lune pour vos fioles ?: A moon feather for your vials?
textes.Une plume longue comme un bras, d'un ver: A feather as long as an arm, of a green that shifts to blue and gold: a feather of the Feathered Serpent, the god of wind and knowledge. Brought back from beneath the Great Temple of Aztlán. Its place is on the Altar of the Three Suns.
A bright red apple fallen from a tree. Restores one heart.
textes.Une porte d'argent, ciselée de hiboux qu: A silver door, engraved with sleeping owls. The lock awaits a silver key. (The Great Book, on the lectern, might know where it is.)
textes.Une porte de cuivre, et une grosse serru: A copper door, and a big lock shaped like a frog with its mouth open. (Well, well.) You need a copper key… and one of the frogs has a shiny belly.
textes.Une porte de grès, à demi enfouie dans l: A sandstone door, half buried in the dune. Above it, a golden sun. On the slab, three stone rings engraved with signs: the star, the dune, the sun, the moon, the palm tree, the scarab. A golden notch above each.
textes.Une porte de pierre haute comme cinq hom: A stone door as tall as five men, with no handle or lock. On its two leaves, a great engraved circle glows faintly; around it, four round hollows, empty: the four seals. A warm breath comes through the central crack, as if the mountain were breathing.
textes.Une porte de pierre sans poignée, marqué: A stone door with no handle, marked with a serpent. The four braziers in the hall must have something to do with it…
textes.Une porte de pierre, scellée, sous un li: A sealed stone door, beneath a lintel covered in hieroglyphs. Above it, a sun between two cobras. It seems something on this plateau keeps the key… The Sphinx, perhaps?
textes.Une porte ronde comme un engrenage, en b: A round door like a gear, made of bronze, guarded by two metal statues. On the left, on the wall, three wheels engraved with sheep: one, two, three or four. In the shepherd's corner, against the wall, a painted board…
textes.Une porte sculptée dans l'écorce de l'Ar: A door carved into the bark of the Mother Tree, with no handle or lock. Above it, five little empty niches. Faelar, the Elder, surely knows more.
textes.Une râpe à fromage en laiton doré, gravé: A gilded brass cheese grater, engraved with a crossed fork and spoon. Captain Rigatoni buried it on the beach thirty years ago, "so nobody would steal it". It still smells a little of parmesan.
textes.Une résine d'arbre jaune pâle, qui brûle: A pale yellow tree resin that burns with a white, fragrant smoke: the incense of the Aztecs, the offering to the sun Huitzilopochtli. Tochtli sells it at the Aztlán market.
textes.Une salle de répétition secrète ! Une ba: A secret rehearsal room! A drum kit, an amp, posters… and cotton balls on the walls so the neighbors hear nothing.
textes.Une salle de sport. Enfin, un salon tran: A gym. Well, a living room turned into a gym.
textes.Une salle immense, des douves d'eau noir: An immense hall, with a moat of black water all around. At the far end, the Sun Stone… The floor vibrates, very faintly.
textes.Une selle de cuir et de bronze, forgée à: A saddle of leather and bronze, forged in Forgefer for the eagle riders of old. King Thorgal entrusted it to you: Ventaile, the last of the great eagles, nests on the edge of the crater.
textes.Une sieste ? Excellente idée. Je vous ré: A nap? Excellent idea. I'll wake you at seven in the evening.
textes.Une sieste ? Le hamac du fond. Je te rév: A nap? The hammock at the back. I'll wake you for the seven o'clock soup.
textes.Une sieste ? Le lit à ressorts vous atte: A nap? The spring bed is waiting for you. Careful, it's in a playful mood.
textes.Une sieste ? Les murs sont épais, il fai: A nap? The walls are thick, it's cool. I'll wake you for the evening tea.
textes.Une sieste dans un hamac jusqu'au soir: A nap in a hammock until evening
textes.Une sieste sur un lit à ressorts: A nap on a spring bed
textes.Une tablette de pierre gravée d'une tête: A stone tablet carved with a jaguar's head and four dots: 4 Jaguar, the Sun of the Jaguars, the first of the five suns.
textes.Une tablette de pierre gravée de flammes: A stone tablet carved with flames falling from the sky and four dots: 4 Rain, the Sun of Fire-rain.
textes.Une tablette de pierre gravée de vagues: A stone tablet carved with waves and four dots: 4 Water, the Sun of the Water, the sun of the great flood.
textes.Une tablette de pierre gravée du masque: A stone tablet carved with the mask of Ehécatl, the wind beak, and four dots: 4 Wind, the Sun of the Wind.
textes.Une tasse de porcelaine qui remue son th: A porcelain cup that stirs its own tea, thanks to a little motor hidden in the handle.
textes.Une théière fume sur une petite table ro: A teapot steams on a small round table. “Come in! There's some left!”
textes.Une tisane parfumée aux fleurs de nuit,: A tea scented with night flowers, still warm. Restores one and a half hearts.
textes.Une touffe d'herbe argentée, cueillie au: A tuft of silvery grass, picked at the water's edge in the Drowned Marsh. The Doc makes his remedy for marsh fever with it.
textes.Une trappe dans le socle du château d'ea: A hatch in the base of the water tower: two cans of spray paint and a child's drawing, very proud, signed “Tornade”.
textes.Une trappe près de la tête de pierre ? E: A trapdoor near the stone head? And a tunnel running toward the village? If Barnabé finds out, he'll say he knew all along. Don't tell him.
textes.Une trappe sous les pierres levées ?! Et: A trapdoor under the standing stones?! And a temple underneath?! I always knew it. Well, I always sort of suspected it. Gaston, get my boots ready. My boot.
textes.Une truffe noire et parfumée, déterrée p: A black, fragrant truffle, dug up by Truffe the pig (yes, his name means truffle, and he lives up to it). It smells like the forest after the rain. Restores two hearts.
textes.Une vieille borne de grès, rongée par le: An old sandstone marker, eaten away by the sand wind. At the top, an openwork bronze star. An engraved arrow points northeast, toward the dunes.
textes.Une vieille botte… Bon. Ça compte quand: An old boot… Well. Does it still count?
textes.Une vieille cave voûtée. Au fond, un cof: An old vaulted cellar. At the back, an iron-bound chest… Grandfather's treasure?
textes.Une vieille pièce d'or frappée d'une cou: An old gold coin stamped with a crown. Octave gives 12 copper coins for it.
textes.Une vieille puce vocale, grosse comme un: An old voice chip, the size of a stamp, with golden legs and a yellowed label: "Z SERIES — VOICE No. 0". They haven't been made for thirty years. Cargo had kept it, just in case.
textes.Une vieille vanne de bronze, toute verte: An old bronze sluice, all green, half stuck in the mud. A big cogwheel, two pinions fused by time… No hand will ever turn it.
textes.Une vipère des abysses ! Quand elle se l: An abyssal viper! When it coils up and raises its head, it's going to leap straight ahead: step aside, or parry (F).
textes.Une voix d'avare, dans le mur : « Pourqu: A miser's voice, from inside the wall: “Why do you hoard?” Another answers: “Why do you spend?”
textes.Une voix de pierre, grave comme le déser: A voice of stone, deep as the desert: “I guard the door of Ra. Answer my three questions, and it will open. Get one wrong, and come back when you know.”
textes.Une voix, très grave, qui semble venir d: A very deep voice, which seems to come from the whole mountain: “Two hundred years… Two hundred years that the anger of the earth burned in me. The four peoples had put me to sleep; you have soothed me. Take this: a shard of my heart. And tell them… tell them to come back and sing before the gate, once a year, as before.”
textes.Une écaille de Nâga ?! Cent pièces. Non,: A Nâga scale?! A hundred coins. No, don't argue: a hundred coins, and I'll forge you a shield the day you have five.
textes.Une écaille du Serpent des Abysses, vert: A scale from the Serpent of the Abyss, green and hard as jade, as wide as a hand. Proof of your victory. Octave would give a fortune for it.
textes.Une épée d'acier ? C'est Octave qui te l: A steel sword? Octave sold you that. How much? … Too much. Always too much.
textes.Une épée d'entraînement taillée à la for: A training sword carved at the forge. Damage: 3.
textes.Une épée ne coupe pas un arbre : elle s': A sword doesn't cut down a tree: it would go dull. Take an axe.
textes.Une épée taillée dans un éclat du crista: A sword cut from a shard of the Stoneheart crystal, given by the soothed Guardian. It is warm, and beats softly, like a heart. Damage: 9.
textes.Une étiquette sur l'étagère : « Réserve: A label on the shelf: “Granny's stock. 412 jars. I counted them. Take one, go on.”
textes.Une étiquette sur le bocal : « Servez-vo: A label on the jar: “Help yourself (just ONE!)”. You take one. Just one. Promise.
textes.Une étoile de mer orange du fond de la b: An orange starfish from the bottom of Port-Azur bay. It tickles a little.
textes.Une étoile filante ! Elle file au-dessus: A shooting star! It streaks above the Spire… and falls somewhere on the island, softly. A fragment to pick up!
textes.Une île entière ! Avec des palmiers ! Et: A whole island! With palm trees! And mosquitoes!
textes.Ursule chauffe ta lame au rouge, la plon: Ursule heats your blade red-hot and plunges it into a tub of cold mist: a hiss, a blue vapour. “It won't break any more.”
textes.Ursule passe ta lame sur sa grande meule: Ursule runs your blade over her big sandstone wheel, for a long time, without a word. The edge sings.
textes.Ursule taille un plastron et des épauliè: Ursule cuts a breastplate and shoulder guards from thick leather, boiled in wax. “That stops claws. Not rocks.”
textes.VIEILLE-DENT ! Le roi des crocodiles du: VIEILLE-DENT! The king of the marsh crocodiles, as long as a rowboat. His jaws reach far: wait until he lunges at nothing, then strike.
textes.VOILÀ ! Gaston, note ça : une carte ne s: THERE! Gaston, write that down: a map is never wrong. It's the rocks that wander about. You're cartographer material, {surnom}.
textes.Va, va. Je te réveille pour le grog du s: Off you go, off you go. I'll wake you for the evening cordial.
Go on. And don't come back empty-handed.
Go. The wind will bring you back.
textes.Vaincre Vieille-Dent, le crocodile géant: Defeat Vieille-Dent, the giant crocodile, deep in the Drowned Marsh (west of the island, under the dead mangroves)
textes.Vaincre la Naga des profondeurs: Defeat the Naga of the depths
textes.Vaincre le Titan de Givre au fond du Coc: Defeat the Frost Titan at the bottom of the Cocytus
textes.Vaincre le chef des gobelins dans son ca: Defeat the goblin chief in his camp, deep in the Goblin Wood (in the north-east of the island, past the East Gate)
textes.Vaincre le chef gobelin (encore lui ? ou: Defeat the goblin chief (him again? yes, him again)
textes.Vaincre les jaguars des pentes du Mont F: Defeat the jaguars on the slopes of the Smoking Mountain (west of the island, under the pines)
textes.Vanille, fraise et coco : la spéciale Br: Vanilla, strawberry and coconut: Bruno's special. It melts faster than you can eat it. Restores one heart.
textes.Vas-y, mets le casque ! … (Il est beauco: Go on, put on the helmet! … (It's far too big. You can't see a thing. You hear the knight laughing.) HA HA! It suits you… very well! Well, your ears, anyway.
textes.Vas-y, mets-lui en une !: Go on, land one on him!
textes.Venir au Festival du Larsen, le soir (à: Come to the Larsen Festival in the evening (from 8:30 p.m.) and join the crowd in front of the Main Stage
textes.Venir au Grand Boucan, le grand concert: Come to the Great Boucan, the Bilge Rats' big concert, in the evening (from 9 p.m.) at the Howling Hall, and dance in the pit
textes.Ventaile a repris des forces ! Elle dépl: Ventaile has regained her strength! She spreads her immense wings, then lowers her head to you… Fit her with King Thorgal's dwarven saddle.
textes.Ventaile a repris des forces ! Elle étir: Ventaile has regained her strength! She stretches her immense wings… She'd agree to carry you, but without a saddle, you can't hold on to her back at this altitude. King Thorgal, in Forgefer, might know more.
Ventaile is already here, a few steps away.
textes.Ventaile ne peut pas entrer ici : sors à: Ventaile can't come in here: step out into the open air to call her.
textes.Ventaile plonge comme une pierre et te r: Ventaile dives like a stone and catches you in mid-air! She sets you down on the Wind Perch.
textes.Ventaile se laisse caresser les plumes d: Ventaile lets you stroke the feathers on her neck… but you'd need a saddle to ride her. King Thorgal, in Forgefer, spoke of the saddles of the ancient eagle-riders.
textes.Ventaile te regarde avec ses yeux d'or,: Ventaile looks at you with her golden eyes, then at your empty hands. She needs fish: go fishing (with Barnabé's rod) and come back.
textes.Verrou n°3 — rebrancher l'antivirus: Lock no. 3 — plug the antivirus back in
textes.Verser le pot de brun dans son godet (le: Pour the pot of brown into its slot (no. 5): E in front of the Stone Palette, in the middle of the clearing
textes.Verser une première couleur dans la Pale: Pour a first colour into the Stone Palette
textes.Versé de haut, mousseux, très sucré, à l: Poured from up high, frothy, very sweet, with fresh mint from the Fondouk garden. Restores one heart.
textes.Vert, comme lui ! Il va adorer !: Green, like him! He's going to love it!
textes.Veuillez libérer les lieux. Merci de vot: Please vacate the premises. Thank you for your understanding.
textes.Victoire ! Encore un exploit pour ma lég: Victory! Another feat for my legend! And for you too, a little.
textes.Vide. Gâchette près d'un objet pour le r: Empty. Trigger near an item to pick it up.
textes.Vieille-Dent ne bougera plus. Le marais: Vieille-Dent will never move again. The marsh holds its breath… Crochet will be pleased.
Vieille-Dent will eat no one ever again.
textes.Vieille-Dent, le crocodile géant du Mara: Vieille-Dent, the giant crocodile of the Drowned Marsh, took Crochet's hand years ago. Crochet wants someone to settle the score.
textes.Vieille-Dent… tu veux qu'on t'en débarra: Vieille-Dent… want us to get rid of him for you?
textes.Viens, je te retourne vers la fenêtre !: Come, I'll turn you toward the window!
textes.Vingt ans, cette graine dorée a dormi da: For twenty years, that golden seed slept in my treasure box, between a shark's tooth and a mother-of-pearl button. On sad evenings, I held it in the hollow of my hand: it was warm, like a little sun. I didn't know I was keeping it for someone.
textes.Vingt-deux ans, et toujours pas d'excuse: Twenty-two years, and still no apology.
textes.Violette, la jeune mage de la Guilde, ne: Violette, the Guild's young mage, can only cast lightning bolts, and they often hit her instead. According to an old book, three storm crystals, which grow at the top of the Fangs, would channel her lightning "forwards".
textes.Violette, si tu pouvais éviter de me fou: Violette, if you could avoid zapping me today, I'd appreciate it.
textes.Violette, vos cheveux… ils se dressent t: Violette, your hair… it's standing up all by itself.
textes.Visez avec la main droite, gâchette pour: Aim with your right hand, trigger to click, stick to scroll
textes.Visez un objet et appuyez sur la gâchett: Aim at an item and press the trigger, then “Use” or “Drop”
textes.Vite, vite ! Derrière le canapé ! … Bon,: Quick, quick! Behind the sofa! … Well, he may not come before tonight. Would you like a slice of cake in the meantime?
textes.Voici Germaine et l'ampli ! Et j'ai auss: Here are Germaine and the amp! And I've got the drumsticks too.
textes.Voici cinq navets dorés, Père Gaubert. D: Here are five golden turnips, Father Gaubert. Gently, I promise.
textes.Voici cinq objets des îles d'en bas, Orb: Here are five objects from the islands below, Orbe!
textes.Voici la bannière du chef gobelin, Sire: Here is the goblin chief's banner, Sir Tancrède.
Here is the seed of Yggdrasil, Your Majesty.
textes.Voici la puce holographique et la carte: Here are the hologram chip and the star chart!
Here is the Royal jelly heart, Master.
Here are the logs and the stones.
textes.Voici les cinq champignons féeriques, Mè: Here are the five fairy mushrooms, Mother Morel.
textes.Voici les matériaux pour le Glisseur, Io: Here are the materials for the Glider, Ionie.
Here are the plans for the Lisse-Center, Mamie.
Here are the three pieces of the map.
Here are the three moon shards.
textes.Voici les trois éclats du Cœur, et trois: Here are the Heart's three shards, and three astral crystals.
textes.Voici mes dix pièces. Je pose la main su: Here are my ten coins. Do I put my hand on the ball?
Here are your three sulfur crystals.
Here are three blocks of iron ore.
Here are three logs of twisted wood.
Here are three hundred coins. I'll buy it.
Here are three mushrooms from the Twisted Wood.
Here are three storm crystals, Violette.
Here are three flakes of eternal frost.
textes.Voici trois fragments de météorite, Zéni: Here are three meteorite fragments, Zenith.
textes.Voici trois lots de pièces de vélo, Rust: Here are three lots of bike parts, Rustine!
textes.Voici trois paniers de légumes, Lentille: Here are three baskets of vegetables, Lentille!
Here are three feathers of the wind.
Here are three tufts of fever grass.
textes.Voici un cristal de soufre : c'est là qu: Here is a sulfur crystal: this is where fire is born.
Here are your five moon mushrooms.
Here are your five ember flowers.
Here are your four flown-away books.
textes.Voici vos trois graines lumineuses, Phot: Here are your three glowing seeds, Photon.
Here are your three pages, Madame Olga.
textes.Voici votre chapeau à plume, Monsieur le: Here is your feathered hat, Baron.
Here is your sun rosary, sister. The Duchess gave it back.
textes.Voilà ! Héroïque ! Bon, je t'ai fait un: There! Heroic! Well, I made you a bit taller. And with a cape. You didn't have a cape? Now you do.
textes.Voilà ! Le quinzième toit sera le bon. T: There! The fifteenth roof will be the right one. Here, these glasses: kaleidoscopes. The whole world turns into a rose window. It's useless, it's marvellous, and it doesn't explode. Well, I think.
textes.Voilà la marchandise. Tout est forgé ici: Here's the merchandise. Everything's forged here, in the tree. You have {pieces} coins: choose wisely.
textes.Voir l'automate joueur d'échecs d'Ambroi: See Ambroise Échec's chess-playing automaton (Fair stand, to the south)
textes.Voir la Cascade Arrabbiata tomber dans l: See the Arrabbiata Falls pour into the sea
textes.Voir la Cascade d'Encre tomber de la fal: See the Ink Waterfall tumble from the cliff
textes.Voir le volcan cracher sa sauce: See the volcano spit out its sauce
textes.Voir nager les carpes de la Place des Ho: Watch the carp swim in the Hologram Square
textes.Voler ? Presque ! Léviter. C'est mieux :: Fly? Almost! Levitate. It's better: you don't bump into seagulls. To learn, you must first feel the wind in your hand. The wind loses feathers when it turns too fast: bring me three. They land where it blows the hardest: on the western hill, at the edge of the northern cliffs, and on the eastern cliff, above the sea.
textes.Vos livres envolés… je peux aider ?: Your runaway books… can I help?
textes.Vos navets… ils bougent, Père Gaubert ?: Your turnips… are they moving, Père Gaubert?
textes.Votre atelier n'a plus de toit ?: Your workshop has lost its roof?
textes.Votre caillou est devenu une clochette d: Your pebble has become a little silver bell!
textes.Votre phare a un problème ?: Is something wrong with your lighthouse?
textes.Vous ! Ne croyez pas que je ne sais pas: You! Don't think I don't know what you did.
textes.Vous allez me rembourser, j'espère !: You're going to pay me back, I hope!
textes.Vous avez aidé {qn} ! {Il} me l'a racont: You helped {qn}! {Il} told me all about it. I won't forget it, {surnom}.
textes.Vous avez assez bu pour aujourd'hui. Un: You've had enough to drink for today. A glass of water, and off to bed!
textes.Vous avez combien de chats ?: How many cats do you have?
textes.Vous avez eu l'occasion de lui parler, d: Have you had a chance to talk to them since?
textes.Vous avez fait la connaissance de {qn},: You've made the acquaintance of {qn}, I hear. What do you think?
textes.Vous avez frappé {qn} ? Ça ne se fait pa: You hit {qn}? That's just not done. Everyone's talking about it.
textes.Vous avez frappé {qn} ?! On m'a tout rac: You hit {qn}?! I've heard everything. You've got some nerve coming to talk to me.
textes.Vous avez frappé {qn}, à ce qu'on dit. J: You hit {qn}, so they say. I'm not saying it was deserved. I'm not saying it wasn't.
Word is you spoiled {qn}. Anyone who's kind to my folks is welcome at my place.
You look rushed off your feet.
textes.Vous avez offert {objet} à {qn} ? Tout l: You gave {objet} to {qn}? Everyone knows {il} can't stand that. I'm still laughing.
textes.Vous avez raison de ne pas juger trop vi: You're right not to judge too quickly.
textes.Vous avez tous la même tête…: You all have the same face…
textes.Vous avez vu le voleur de croissants ?: Did you see the croissant thief?
textes.Vous avez vu passer le voleur ?: Did you see the thief go by?
textes.Vous chantez tous les trois : « ♪ Tourne: You all three sing: “♪ Sunflower, sunflower, the moon watches you sleep… ♪”. It's a bit off-key, but very pretty.
textes.Vous chaussez les lunettes. Tout devient: You put on the glasses. Everything turns into coloured stars. You bump into a tree. You take them off.
textes.Vous feriez ça ? Hugo a perdu son allian: You'd do that? Hugo lost his wedding ring playing in the waves, near the beach hut. It must be buried in the wet sand. You'd need a shovel… and a lot of luck.
textes.Vous l'avez fait exprès ?: Did you do that on purpose?
textes.Vous levez la coupe bien haut. On croit: You raise the cup high. You almost hear, far away, the whole Games Clearing applauding.
textes.Vous m'avez acheté %d objet, pour %d piè: You've bought %d item from me, for %d coins.
textes.Vous m'avez acheté %d objets, pour %d pi: You've bought %d items from me, for %d coins.
textes.Vous m'avez dit que vous trouviez %s trè: You told me you found %s very nice.
textes.Vous m'avez dit que vous trouviez %s un: You told me you found %s a bit weird.
textes.Vous m'avez fait %d cadeau, le dernier :: You've given me %d gift, the last one: %s.
textes.Vous m'avez fait %d cadeaux, le dernier: You've given me %d gifts, the last one: %s.
textes.Vous mettez les oreilles de renard. Vous: You put on the fox ears. You feel like you can hear a little better. Somewhere, a rabbit is laughing.
textes.Vous ouvrez la boîte. Il n'y a rien deda: You open the box. There is nothing inside. The maker kept his word.
textes.Vous ouvrez le parapluie. L'hélice se me: You open the umbrella. The propeller starts to spin, your hair flies away… and you don't.
textes.Vous pourriez m'apprendre à soigner ?: Could you teach me to heal?
textes.Vous regardez l'heure. Il est… dans un m: You check the time. It's… in a moment. Or a little while ago. You put the watch away.
textes.Vous remontez le canard. Il fait « coin-: You wind up the duck. It goes “quack-quack-click” and waddles in your hand.
textes.Vous secouez le grelot : ding-ding ! Vou: You shake the bell: ding-ding! Suddenly you really want to swap something for something else.
textes.Vous soufflez de toutes vos forces. Sile: You blow with all your might. Absolute silence. Somewhere, a fish lifts its head.
textes.Vous tombez à pic ! Je préside le jury d: You've come just in time! I chair the Fair's jury, and every member of the jury has an invention in the competition. It's a small problem. I need the opinion of someone impartial: you. Go and see Prudence's mechanical piano, Basile's bubble machine and Ambroise's automaton. Talk to them, look closely, then come back and tell me what you think.
textes.Vous tournez la manivelle. Une brise dél: You turn the crank. A delightful breeze cools your head. You have an idea! … No, it's gone.
textes.Vous voulez l'entendre encore ?: Would you like to hear it again?
Would you like to hear it again?
textes.Vous voulez la suite ?: Would you like to hear the rest?
textes.Vous voulez que je vous parle de qui ?: Who would you like me to tell you about?
textes.Vous vous glissez sous la couette bleue: You slip under the blue quilt of the Cottage. The wisteria smells lovely. Somewhere, a frog croaks. Zzz…
textes.Vous vous êtes évanoui… Anouk, la guéris: You fainted… Anouk, the healer of Carène, treated you with seaweed and honey.
textes.Vous vous êtes évanoui… Aurore, la guéri: You fainted… Aurore, the healer, lays a glowing hand on your forehead. “There. All in order. Have a cup of stellar tea, Heavy-Foot.”
textes.Vous vous êtes évanoui… Dagna vous a tra: You fainted… Dagna dragged you to the Forgefer terrace.
textes.Vous vous êtes évanoui… Des Atlantes vou: You fainted… Atlanteans brought you back under the dome, in front of the palace.
textes.Vous vous êtes évanoui… Des aventuriers: You fainted… Some adventurers carried you back to the Grand-Place, and Mamie Rissole fed you a slice of pie. You feel better right away.
textes.Vous vous êtes évanoui… Des chasseurs ma: You fainted… Maya hunters carried you to Yaxché.
textes.Vous vous êtes évanoui… Des démons vous: You fainted… Demons carried you to the Great Square, and Mère Brasille gave you a spicy-pepper broth. It wakes you up!
textes.Vous vous êtes évanoui… Des fées vous on: You fainted… Fairies healed you with dew and songs.
textes.Vous vous êtes évanoui… Des pirates vous: You fainted… Pirates picked you up and dropped you off at the Doc's, who stitched you up without asking questions.
textes.Vous vous êtes évanoui… Des pêcheurs vou: You fainted… Fishermen brought you back by dugout canoe to Aztlán.
textes.Vous vous êtes évanoui… Le docteur Roux: You fainted… Doctor Roux treated you. You're now in Port-Azur's square.
textes.Vous vous êtes évanoui… Le professeur Bo: You fainted… Professor Boum revived you with a little shock (a very little one). You're now on the Cliquetis promenade.
textes.Vous vous êtes évanoui… Mère Sauge vous: You fainted… Mother Sage made you drink a tea that smelled of thyme. You're now in Cauldron Square, in Arcanelle.
textes.Vous vous êtes évanoui… Néferet vous a s: You fainted… Néferet healed you at the temple of Per-Hâpy.
