textes.Vous vous êtes évanoui… Pivoine, la rena: You fainted… Pivoine, the fox herbalist, had you sniff a vial of mist. You're now at the Moon Circle.
textes.Vous vous êtes évanoui… Un berger vous a: You fainted… A shepherd brought you back out into the open air, in front of the Wind Sheepfold.
textes.Vous vous êtes évanoui… Un caravanier de: You fainted… A passing caravaneer pulled you out of the tomb and gave you something to drink.
textes.Vous vous êtes évanoui… Vous voici de re: You fainted… You're back in the village.
You fainted… You're back in the village. A fisherman brought your boat back to the jetty.
textes.Vous vous êtes évanoui… Vous vous réveil: You fainted… You wake up on a couch in Pallet Square, under a patchwork blanket. Lentille hands you a bowl of soup: “Pay what you like. Drink.”
textes.Vous vous êtes évanoui… Zineb, la patron: You fainted… Zineb, the owner of the Fondouk, made you drink a very sweet tea. You're now in Lantern Square.
textes.Vous vous êtes évanoui… et réveillé au p: You fainted… and woke up at the foot of the ladder.
textes.Vous vous êtes évanoui… et réveillé sur: You fainted… and woke up on the Wind Landing, at the edge of the floating island.
textes.Vous vous êtes évanoui… et réveillé à l': You fainted… and woke up at the entrance of the hall. The red light of the Heart still beats.
textes.Vous vous êtes évanoui… et vous vous rév: You fainted… and you wake up in your bed, at the Wisteria Cottage. Someone tucked you in. Probably Pétronille. Or a very kind neighbor.
You've come to see me %d times.
textes.Vrai ?! Toi aussi ?! … Alors on n'a qu'à: Really?! You too?! … Then we'll just be scared together! That way we'll be less scared! Here, it brings good luck.
textes.Vziiiou ! Toi ! Avec le Glisseur d'Ionie: Vzziiiou! You! With Ionie's Glider! Finally, an opponent! Right. First, I need to see if you can handle yourself in the air. Go to the Zero-Gravity Garden, in the west, and do the glowing ring course. Set a record, any record: it's just to see if you can aim. Then… the real race. In the sky. Rings of light all around the island: under the plateau, between the islets, through the waterfalls of light, and back to the Spaceport. Me in my saucer, you in your Glider. First to arrive wins. Second pays for the ice creams. I love ice cream.
textes.Whoooo ! Le tapis t'emporte à reculons,: Whoooo! The belt carries you backwards, much faster than you can run. You have to switch it: the levers are at the console, near the entrance.
textes.Xan ? Pour descendre dans Xibalba ? Comm: Xan? To go down into Xibalba? Like the Twins?! … All right! But I'm hungry. I'm too hungry to lend you a mosquito. Ix Chab makes the best corn cakes in the square. Will you bring me one?
textes.Xan file vers les trônes et pique chaque: Xan flies toward the thrones and stings each Lord, one after another…
textes.Xan, tu obéis bien, d'accord ? Et tu rev: Xan, you'll behave, all right? And you'll come back! (He pats the gourd.) Goodbye, Xan…
textes.Xibalba, le royaume des Seigneurs de la: Xibalba, the kingdom of the Lords of Death.
textes.Xóchitl, la jardinière des chinampas, a: Xóchitl, the gardener of the chinampas, needs five bouquets of cempasúchil, the orange flowers that guide the souls of the dead, for the temple altars.
textes.Yggdrasil, l'Arbre-Monde, ne donne plus: Yggdrasil, the World Tree, hasn't produced any seeds for a hundred years: nasty plants have overrun its trunk. Queen Oriane would like the seed sleeping at the very top of the tree.
textes.Yo ! On répète pour le concert de samedi: Yo! We're rehearsing for Saturday's concert. We're missing a singer. Can you sing?
textes.Yvon, le pêcheur du lac, a peur des gren: Yvon, the lake fisherman, has been afraid of the giant frogs for forty years. There are more and more of them: they steal his fish, his bait and, once, his boat. He'd like someone to chase a few of them away.
textes.Z / S : avancer, reculer • Q / D : bar: Z / S: forward, reverse  •  Q / D: steer  •  approach a jetty or a beach to disembark
textes.Z / S : plus vite / plus lent (S arrête): Z / S: faster / slower (S stops), Q / D: turn, Space: climb, Ctrl: descend, E: land.
textes.Z / S : vitesse (S : sur place), Q / D :: Z / S: speed (S: hover), Q / D: turn, Space / Ctrl: climb / descend, E: land.
W to go up, S to go down.
textes.ZONE DE STOCKAGE\nCaisses à pousser. Ne:
STORAGE AREA
Crates to push. Do not push the robots.
textes.Zigomar, l'inventeur et artificier, n'a: Zigomar, the inventor and fireworks maker, has run out of sulphur for his Night of Lanterns rockets. He needs three sulphur crystals from the hot springs.
textes.Zip, zoum, scintille ! Ton Albatros a fa: Zip, zoom, sparkle! Your Albatros has molted: here is the Star Glider. It zips along like a happy thought. Don't exceed the speed of light, it's very frowned upon around here.
textes.Zohra, la poissonnière, veut faire son g: Zohra, the fishmonger, wants to make her big Friday tagine. She needs two fine sea bream, caught by someone other than the fish-market men.
textes.Zut ! J'étais si bien caché !: Darn! I was so well hidden!
textes.Zut. Je m'entraîne depuis trois semaines: Darn. I've been practicing for three weeks… Don't tell anyone, okay?
textes.Zzz… (Il renifle, sans ouvrir les yeux.): Zzz… (He sniffs, without opening his eyes.) … Honorine? (He opens one eye.) Oh! It's you! Thank you! I wasn't sleeping, you know. I was smelling. It's the best bread on the island. Tell her thank you. Tell her I wasn't sleeping.
textes.Zzz… gratte-moi le dos… plus à gauche…: Zzz… scratch my back… more to the left…
textes.Zéphyrine Plume m'apprendra la lévitatio: Zéphyrine Plume will teach me levitation if I bring her three wind feathers. Then I'll have to ring the bell at the top of the Leaning Tower.
textes.Zéro, le vieux balayeur de la Place des: Zéro, the old sweeper of the Hologram Square and the very first android of Neopolis, has lost his voice: his Z-Series voice chip gave out, and they stopped making them thirty years ago. Little Mio, his best friend, would so love to hear him tell his stories again.
textes.[color=#9aa7b0][i]PC : 1 à 4 pour choisi: [color=#9aa7b0][i]PC: 1 to 4 to choose a power, X to cast it. VR: B to cast, hold B to switch.[/i][/color]
textes.[color=#9aa7b0][i]PC : 5 à 0 pour choisi: [color=#9aa7b0][i]PC: 5 to 0 to select a spell, V to cast it, B to switch to the next. VR: left trigger to cast, hold to change.[/i][/color]
textes.[color=#9aa7b0][i]Énigmes, gardiens, por: [color=#9aa7b0][i]Riddles, guardians, doors, quests, hidden chests: the hero grows by completing them.[/i][/color]
textes.[i]Aucun pour l'instant. Rendez service,: [i]None yet. Do people a favour, and they will remember it.[/i]
textes.[i]Choisis un talent pour le lire. Les t: [i]Pick a talent to read it. The talents in a branch are learned in order, from top to bottom.[/i]
textes.a soufflé ses bougies du premier coup. B: blew out the candles in one go. Well, three.

textes.comment j'ai bâti la Mouette Têtue: how I built the Stubborn Seagull
textes.des crêpes au chocolat (il pleut, il fau: chocolate crêpes (it's raining, we need comfort)
textes.est venu, finalement ! Bon… il est repar: came after all! Well… off to fetch chairs again. Stay and dance with us!
textes.gagne… la même tête que d'habitude ! Bra: wins… the same face as always! Well done!

textes.la carte des Récifs de Feu: the map of the Fire Reefs

textes.la tour en ruine des Crocs: the ruined tower of the Fangs
textes.le Cristal du Couchant (la salle d'armes: the Crystal of the Dusk (the armoury, to the west)
textes.le Cristal du Levant (le beffroi, à l'es: the Crystal of the Dawn (the belfry, to the east)
textes.le Donjon des Mille Marches: the Dungeon of a Thousand Steps
textes.le cratère du Grand Brasier: the crater of the Great Blaze
textes.le parvis du Temple-Passoire: the forecourt of the Colander Temple

textes.loin d'ici (je peux le faire venir): far from here (I can have it brought)
textes.m'a demandé de soigner l'Arbre sacré: asked me to heal the sacred Tree
textes.ma forge dans le fromager: my forge in the kapok tree
textes.ouvrir le coffre du Cœur du Chant: open the chest of the Heart of the Song

textes.« ALERTE : DURITE ENDOMMAGÉE. CECI N'ÉTA: “ALERT: HOSE DAMAGED. THIS WAS NOT IN THE SPREADSHEET.” The screen turns bright red: OPTIMUS-LISSE switches to “VERY CROSS (POLITELY)” mode.
textes.« AU SECOURS ! » Un apprenti sorcier tou: “HELP!” An apprentice wizard circles his cauldron. On a chair, a frog glares at him, furious.
textes.« Alors l'Homme-Oiseau s'envola, le deux: “Then the Bird-Man took flight, the second, to seek the land beyond the waves.”
textes.« Au commencement, l'Œil du Soleil s'ouv: “In the beginning, the Eye of the Sun opened over the great waters, and the sea was warm.”
textes.« BIP. BONJOUR. INVITÉ. » Un petit robot: “BEEP. HELLO. GUEST.” A little copper robot rolls toward you, a tray in hand.
textes.« BONJOUR, VISITEUR NON AUTORISÉ. VOTRE: “GOOD DAY, UNAUTHORISED VISITOR. YOUR PRESENCE IS NOT OPTIMAL. LAUNCHING PROTOCOL: COURTEOUS DEMOLITION.” The ground shakes: the GREAT DIGGER unfolds, bucket raised, tracks creaking!
textes.« Bienvenue au Bureau de vente Lisse & F: “Welcome to the Lisse & Son Sales Office! The Lisse-Center: four hundred shops, zero squatters!”
textes.« Bruits de pluie, face A et face B »: “Rain Sounds, Side A and Side B”
textes.« Cent ans que la ronce m'étouffait. Cen: “A hundred years the bramble choked me. A hundred years without a seed. You gave me back my breath, little traveller.” The spirit opens its hands of light: a golden seed, veined with fire, rests there. “Take it to the fairies. In a thousand years, it will be a world.” A circle of light appears on the Crown: it will take you back to the glade.
textes.« Chaque île boit à mes racines. Prends: “Every island drinks from my roots. Take care of them, and they will take care of you.”
textes.« Chère maison, je te quitte pour une pl: “Dear house, I'm leaving you for a bigger one. It's not you, it's me. Well, mostly it's the mice.”
textes.« Crr… » fait le coffre en se léchant le: “Grr…” says the chest, licking its chops. The Great Book had warned you.
textes.« Dors, petit marteau, dors, / la forge: “Sleep, little hammer, sleep, / the forge still keeps its watch, / the stone keeps you warm, / sleep, little hammer.”
textes.« Défense d'entrer : chien méchant (troi: “No entry: beware of the dog (three times).”
textes.« ENCORE UN ? EXCELLENT CHOIX ! » Le rob: “ANOTHER ONE? EXCELLENT CHOICE!” The robot hands you a steaming bowl. It drew a smiley with the sauce.
textes.« ERREUR 404 : VICTOIRE INTROUVABLE. ACT: “ERROR 404: VICTORY NOT FOUND. ACTIVATING TURBO-CONCRETE MODE. THANK YOU FOR YOUR UNDERSTANDING.” Sparks everywhere: it's getting tired! Aim for the hoses when the bucket is stuck in the ground!
textes.« Entre, entre ! » Quelqu'un verse du th: “Come in, come in!” Someone pours tea from very high up, without spilling a drop.
textes.« Et c'est l'histoire d'un caillou… » To: “And so there's this pebble…” The whole room bursts out laughing before the end.
textes.« Et la Tortue, la dernière, porta les A: “And the Turtle, the last, carried the Elders to the shore. When the four speak in this order, the stone listens.”
textes.« Halte-là ! » … Ah non, c'est juste une: “Halt!” … Oh no, it's just armor on a dummy. Its knight is right next to it.
textes.« Ici a vécu Gaspard, inventeur de la so: “Gaspard lived here, inventor of the hot cold soup. He went to let the king taste it. He never came back. Neither did the king, by the way.”
textes.« Ici les Anciens ont enchaîné Nâga, le:
"Here the Ancients chained Nâga, the Serpent of the Abyss.
Three guardians, three eyes, one amulet:
may none ever bring them together."
textes.« Il range ton sac, il trouve les trésor: “It tidies your bag, finds the treasures, even does your homework.” — Mr. Fil
textes.« Ils sont cachés ! Trouve-les ! » chuch: “They're hiding! Find them!” whispers a little Moai. The rocks hold their breath.
textes.« J'ai beaucoup d'or, et de beaux habits: “I have lots of gold and fine clothes.”
textes.« Je n'ai pas menti, je n'ai pas volé, j: “I have not lied, I have not stolen, I have made no one cry.”
textes.« Je suis caché ! Cherche-moi ! » dit un: “I'm hidden! Come find me!” says a child's voice. The room is messy: there are hiding places everywhere.
textes.« Je suis le plus fort : j'ai vaincu tou: “I am the strongest: I have defeated all my enemies.”
textes.« Journal du capitaine Bourrache, jour 1: “Journal of Captain Bourrache, day 1: I buy this house. Day 2: a leak in the ceiling. Day 3: two leaks. Day 4: I'm going back to sea. It's drier.”
textes.« L'eau qui regarde le ciel »… le lac du: “The water that looks at the sky”… the crater lake?
textes.« L'homme. » Bébé, il marche à quatre pa: “Man.” As a baby, he crawls on all fours; grown, he walks on his two legs; old, with a stick. Good.
textes.« LISSE & FILS — Plan des étages. -1 : l: “LISSE & SONS — Floor plan. -1: the Offices. -2: the Assembly Line. -3: the Boiler Room. -4: the Automated Warehouse. -5: the President's Pit (no entry, especially for you).” Someone has added in marker pen: “and all the way down: the machine that wants to flatten Boucan”.
textes.« La Marguerite », « Vague 1 » à « Vague: “La Marguerite”, “Vague 1” to “Vague 6”, “Gérard” and… “Gertrude”? Well. It's noted. Thank you, really. Here, for your trouble.
textes.« La la laaaa ! » Cinq petits Moaïs chan: “La la laaaa!” Five little Moai sing in a half circle. Not all the same song.
textes.« La passe des Récifs de Feu est à l'est: “The pass through the Fire Reefs is east of the dwarves' island, facing the rising sun. Follow the map.”
textes.« Larsen ! », la compilation du festival: “Feedback!”, the compilation from the festival twenty years ago
textes.« Le Chant des Quatre Cloches. Qui voudr: “The Song of the Four Bells. Whoever would have the Crystal of the Dawn shall ring the belfry as the Sky Kings sang: the Wave bears the Sun; the Sun chases the Moon; the Moon calls the Wind.” Further down, in another hand: “The Crystal of the Dusk sleeps in the armoury. Its guardians never sleep.”
textes.« Le Puits des Abysses. Ici dort ce que: “The Well of the Abyss. Here sleeps what the Ancients have chained.”
textes.« Le chemin des Anciens suit le chant de:
"The path of the Ancients follows the song of the fresco.
Twice."
“The path of the Ancients follows the song of the fresco. Twice.” Every slab in the lake bears one of the four symbols.
textes.« Le royaume refleurit. Les fées chanten: “The kingdom blooms again. The fairies sing once more. Thank you, human.”
textes.« Le vent t'a vu passer, ici, là-bas, pa: “The wind has seen you pass, here, there, everywhere. The fairies will teach you to do the same.”
textes.« Les Poissons, les troisièmes, dansèren: “The Fish, the third, danced in his shadow to show him the way.”
textes.« Les deux » ?! … Un diplomate. On a un: “Both”?! … A diplomat. We have a DIPLOMAT in the house. … Fine. Here, for the trip. And off with you before we start arguing again.
“Dwarves don't like surprises. Knock hard at their door, but politely.”
textes.« Les quatre fleurs fleuriront quand cha: “The four flowers will bloom when each lives its season. Where the sun is born, all awakens. Where it reigns at noon, all blazes. Where it dies, all sheds its leaves. Where it never goes, all sleeps beneath the snow.” Below: spring, summer, autumn, winter.
textes.« Mille talents ! » grince le poids. (C': “A thousand talents!” creaks the weight. (It's written on it.)
textes.« Mmmm-mmm-mmm… oh. » Quark s'arrête de: “Mmmm-mmm-mmm… oh.” Quark stops humming. “How did you know?” (He never realised he was humming.)
textes.« Nous partons chercher fortune à Astral: “We're off to seek our fortune in Astralys. They say that up there, the streets are paved with crystal. If you're reading this, take what's in the chest: we won't need it anymore. — The Delaunay family”
textes.« Oh non ! Trouvée ! » Pixel sort de sa: “Oh no! Found!” Pixel comes out of her hiding place laughing, her antennae all blinking. “You have telescope eyes!”
textes.« Osiris. » Seth l'a trahi, Isis l'a ras: “Osiris.” Seth betrayed him, Isis gathered him together. Remember it, down below: his body is still scattered.
textes.« PLAN POUR CONQUÉRIR LE MONDE. Étape 1: “PLAN TO CONQUER THE WORLD. Step 1: get up early. Step 2: have a good breakfast. Step 3: … well, we'll see tomorrow.”
“Gone on vacation. Back soon. — 12 years later: not back yet. Vacations are nice.”
textes.« Pas mal, petit ! Mais Gorgoth n'a pas: “Not bad, kid! But Gorgoth hasn't shown his finest horns yet!”
textes.« Pluie d'été », des Gouttières et du Ca: “Summer Rain,” by The Gutters and Flower Camp, recorded at the last Feedback Festival. Spleen plays it when he thinks nobody's looking. He cries a little, every time.
textes.« Plus longue ! » « Plus BELLE ! » Deux: “Longer!” “More BEAUTIFUL!” Two dwarves squabble in front of a mirror.
textes.« Pépin ! » … Une petite voix répond der: “Pépin!” … A tiny voice answers from behind the trunk: “I'm here! I wanted to see the glowing mushrooms… and then it got all dark.” Pépin runs home to his mummy at the Great Market.
textes.« Quand la nuit soulève la mer, le jour:
“When the night lifts the sea, the day rises,
and the guardian awakes.”
textes.« Que les quatre serpents contemplent l':
"May the four serpents behold the Eye.
But no serpent turns alone."
“May the four serpents behold the Eye. But no serpent turns alone.” The channels in the floor lead from each serpent to the altar.
textes.« Qui vient là ? Un vivant ! » Minos, le: “Who comes there? A living one!” Minos, the judge, leans forward, and his serpent tail coils. "Answer three questions about your journey.
textes.« Rrrrr… pfff… » La pièce entière vibre: “Rrrrr… pfff…” The whole room gently vibrates to the rhythm of a stone snore.
“Rules of the Dungeon of a Thousand Steps. 1. Do not feed the slimes (they grow). 2. Do not pet the frogs (they swallow). 3. A chest that smiles is not a chest. 4. The blue crystals bring you back up here. The falls do not.” Signed: Odon, keeper and step counter.
textes.« Rê, le soleil. » Khépri le matin, Rê à: “Ra, the sun.” Khepri in the morning, Ra at noon, Atum in the evening. Every night, I travel in his barque until dawn.
textes.« Salut à toi, Hun-Camé, salut à toi, Vu: “Greetings, Hun-Camé, greetings, Vucub-Camé!” The two great Lords half rise: “So you know us… Enter our Houses, traveller. If you come out again, we shall play ball.” Behind them, the door sinks into the floor.
textes.« Salut à toi, grand Seigneur ! »… Tu as: “Greetings, great Lord!”… You greeted a WOODEN DUMMY. A terrible laugh rolls beneath the vault: all the Lords are mocking you. And from the ceiling, bats come loose!
textes.« Seul passera celui qui écrit le nom du: “Only he shall pass who writes the king's name as Thoth wrote it. The first sign on the left, the last on the right.”
textes.« Tes bras sont chargés, humain… Fais un: “Your arms are full, human… Make a little room in your bag: I have a map, coins and nectar for you.”
“Tlaloc is thirsty”? Then it's serious. (He takes from his kiln a blue jar with big round eyes, dips it in the lake and plugs it with a leaf.) There. Full of lake water, and don't spill it on the way.
textes.« Ton sac est trop plein pour ce que j'a: “Your bag is too full for what I have to give you, little traveller. Make some room.”
textes.« Trois bonnes réponses. Tu as bien rega: “Three right answers. You've watched your path well.” Minos sits back down and uncoils his tail. “Pass. The wind blows hard on the other side: shelter behind the pillars.”
textes.« Trois… deux… un… VZIIIOU ! » Comète dé: “Three… two… one… VZIIIOU!” Comète shoots off! Fly through all the rings (the next one glows gold) and get back to the starting ring before she does!
textes.« Tu as l'esprit clair, voyageur. Va : l: “You have a clear mind, traveller. Go: the door of Ra is open. But beware of Apophis, who waits for the barque of the sun at the bottom of the night.”
textes.« Tu l'as vue, toi, la mer ? » demande u: “Have you seen it, the sea?” asks a tiny stone voice.
textes.« Tu les as déjà ! Les chaussettes, ça n: “You already have them! Socks don't wear out if you don't walk in puddles. Do you walk in puddles?”
textes.« UN, DEUX, TROIS : GRIMACE ! » Rien ne: “ONE, TWO, THREE: GRIMACE!” Nothing changes on their stone faces. They look very proud.
textes.« Vous qui entrez ici, gardez l'espoir (: “You who enter here, keep hope (and take a coat).”
textes.« Vous qui entrez ici, laissez toute esp: “Abandon all hope, you who enter here.”
textes.« À qui trouvera ce mot : j'ai caché mes: “To whoever finds this note: I hid my savings in the chest, for my old age. I'm old now. And I forgot where the house was. If you find me, keep everything.”
textes.« … 98… 99… 100 ! » Quelqu'un fait des p: “… 98… 99… 100!” Someone is doing push-ups in the middle of the living room.
textes.À bientôt. Marche doucement : il y a des: See you soon. Walk softly: there are flowers everywhere.
All aboard! Left stick to sail.
textes.À bord ! Z / S pour avancer, Q / D pour: All aboard! W / S to move forward, A / D to steer.
textes.À cette heure-ci, je pense surtout au re: At this time of day, all I think about is lunch.
textes.À genoux ! … Bon, pas la peine, le sol e: Kneel! … Well, no need, the floor is cold. By the power vested in me by… myself, I name you Honorary Squire of Montjoie! Here is your pay.
textes.À l'ouest, c'est la Grotte des Champigno: To the west is the Bouncing Mushroom Cave. The big pink mushrooms make you bounce. Wheee!
Until the next tide! Or the one after. I'm in no hurry, I'm twenty-two years ahead.
textes.À la prochaine, {surnom}. Reviens avec d: See you next time, {surnom}. Come back with coins.
textes.À mains nues ? Tu changeras d'avis devan: Bare hands? You'll change your mind when you see my sword. It's expensive, but it's convincing.
textes.À mon âge, je mange lentement. Ça me lai: At my age, I eat slowly. It gives me time to take a second plate.
textes.À personne, et c'est bien ça le souci !: To no one, and that's the problem! It's Brioche. Ginger and white, like a golden brioche, see? Every morning at six, she comes down from the roof, takes ONE sardine from me, just one, very politely, and goes back up to eat it while watching me. She doesn't steal, she helps herself. She's dignified, that cat. More dignified than the mayor. But there it is: she has nobody. In winter, she sleeps against the harbour master's chimney, and Odette pretends not to see her. I can't take her, I have three floors and an allergic husband. You travel… A cat that travels, I think she'd like that. But she won't let anyone near her. Except… Pauline, the Grand Hotel's chambermaid, knits on the terrace: one day, Brioche came to play with her ball of yarn. She even purred. Go see Pauline!
textes.À quinze ans, je suis descendu au port a: At fifteen, I went down to the port with a bundle and a hammer. I learned iron from a blacksmith, wood from a carpenter, and money on my own. I'm the one who laid the keel of the Stubborn Seagull. Three years in the shipyard. On the day she sailed, the shipowner told me: “You built her, you fix her.” I came aboard. I shouldn't have.
textes.À tout le monde… Hmm. Oui. Peut-être. Mê: To everyone… Hmm. Yes. Perhaps. Even the best. Even… No. Let's change the subject. Gaston, change the subject.
textes.À vingt ans, je suis devenu cartographe: At twenty, I became the king's cartographer. He wanted the most accurate map in the world: I put in every tree, every pond, every cow. Eleven years of work. They stored it folded up in a barn, and the king asked me for a pocket version. During those eleven years, Mireille married the lighthouse keeper. At least he came home in the evenings. I shall say no more.
textes.Ça ? C'est un champignon des fées. Il po: That? It's a fairy mushroom. It grows in the circle behind the dune, on nights when the music is beautiful. If you nibble it, you take a trip… to the fairy kingdom, above the clouds, where the Yggdrasil tree grows. Here, take it. Up there, you'll arrive in a circle of mushrooms: when you want to come back, step inside it, and it will bring you back here, on the beach. (In your bag: “Use”.)
textes.Ça a marché !!! Maître ! Vous êtes redev: It worked!!! Master! You're yourself again! Thank you, thank you! Here, take this, it's a successful potion. I think.
textes.Ça avance, ça avance !: It's coming along, it's coming along!
textes.Ça fait huit cents ans que je fais la si: I've been napping for eight hundred years. It's a very, very big nap.
textes.Ça fait {absence}. Je croyais que les cr: It's been {absence}. I thought the crabs had got you. Or worse: Barnabé.
That sounds nicely gritty, right there.
textes.Ça joue fort ! Très fort ! Le lustre se: It's loud! Very loud! The chandelier swings in rhythm.
textes.Ça marche aussi ! Les plantes aiment tou: That works too! Plants love all kinds of music. Even slightly off-key whistling.
textes.Ça mord, en ce moment ?: Are they biting at the moment?
textes.Ça mord, par ici ?: Are the fish biting around here?
textes.Ça ne sent pas la soupe, aujourd'hui: It doesn't smell of soup today
textes.Ça ne sent pas la soupe, aujourd'hui…: It doesn't smell of soup today…
textes.Ça remue dans les bosquets… un groin ros: Something is rustling in the bushes… a pink and black snout appears, sniffs, and vanishes. Truffe is there, but he's shy. With his little bell, he'd recognise you!
textes.Ça rit tellement fort ici que la vaissel: The laughter is so loud here that the dishes rattle on the shelves.
textes.Ça ronfle. Fort. Sur une natte, un petit: Snoring. Loudly. On a mat, a little Moai sleeps, covered in moss.
textes.Ça réchauffe ! +1 de force pendant deux: It warms you up! +1 strength for two minutes.
textes.Ça sent bon par ici. Ça sent bon partout: It smells good around here. It smells good everywhere, actually.
textes.Ça sent l'huile et le brûlé. Au fond, un: It smells of oil and burning. At the back, a machine full of indicator lights blinks cheerfully.
It smells of beard oil and rivalry. In front of the mirror, two dwarves compare their braids.
textes.Ça sent la fumée et le vieux bois. « App: It smells of smoke and old wood. “Come closer, traveler,” says a stone voice, slow and gentle.
textes.Ça sent la menthe et le miel. Autour d'u: It smells of mint and honey. Around a low table, a family sips herbal teas from mismatched cups.
textes.Ça sent la menthe fraîche. Autour d'une: It smells of fresh mint. Around a small low table, cushions of every color.
textes.Ça sent la peinture fraîche. Des bâches: It smells of fresh paint. Tarps everywhere, a ladder, paint pots… A house in the middle of a makeover.
textes.Ça sent la peinture à l'huile. Des toile: It smells of oil paint. Canvases everywhere, and an artist squinting at you: “You! You have an interesting face!”
textes.Ça sent la soupe. Une soupe épaisse, mys: It smells of soup. A thick, mysterious soup… and oddly mineral.
It smells of hot chocolate and vanilla. Someone pours a brown, foamy liquid from one pot to another, from very, very high.
It smells of leather and knight's oil. A suit of armor shines against the wall.
textes.Ça sent le feu de bois, la noix de coco: It smells of wood smoke, coconut and grilled fish. At the back, a pile of stones smokes gently.
textes.Ça sent le gâteau chaud. Dans la cuisine: It smells like warm cake. In the kitchen, someone is taking a tray out of the oven.
textes.Ça sent le printemps et le volcan ! (Il: It smells of spring and volcano! (He kneads, he bakes, and the Eternal Oven purrs.) And there you go: three honey cakes, piping hot. One per head, mind! Don't eat them on the way.
That's better! Let's get back to it… gently.
textes.Ça va mieux depuis que tu passes. Ne t'h: Better since you started dropping by. Don't get used to it, I'm still an old bear.

Now that was a lovely crossing.

textes.… Ah, et si un jour tu pêches une vieill: … Oh, and if you ever fish up an old boot, bring it to me: I'll buy it.
… So the moon spoke to you, too. Listen carefully. When the elders brought back the Seal of Mists, they laid it at the bottom of the big pond, on a round stone, and closed the old sluice gate so the water would keep it. The sluice gate is a bronze mechanism on the west edge of the pond, and no one knows how to turn it anymore. If the Bronze Seal obeys you, it will turn it. When the water is low, wait for the moon: the seal shows itself only to her.
textes.… Après ? Après, c'est le travail des na: … After that? After that, it's dwarf work. Borin Barbe-de-Fer, at Forgefer, under the Fire Mountain. He knows how to engrave runes. Tell him Ursule sent you. He'll grumble. That's a good sign.
textes.… D'accord, je te le dis. C'est un petit: … Fine, I'll tell you. It's a little white dog! He hides them near the crates, at the end of the quay, by the lighthouse. But you won't scold him, will you?
textes.… De la brume. Bien. On trempe l'argent: … Mist. Right. You temper silver in it: it sings clearer. Here. A little silver bell. I made it for nothing. Now it's for you.
textes.… Des tournesols. De SON jardin. (Elle l: … Sunflowers. From HER garden. (She looks at them for a long time. A drop falls on a petal; it isn't the rain.) That old goat… She remembers I loved them, then. Wait. On the porch of my yurt, there's an umbrella. The most beautiful one I ever made, with sunflowers painted underneath. I made it for her fifty years ago, and I never gave it to her. Take it to her.
textes.… Elle a ronronné. Elle n'a jamais ronro: … She purred. She has never purred for anyone! Not even the high priest! Maybe you're… blessed?
textes.… Elle est meilleure que les miennes. Je: … It's better than mine. I quit. (Just kidding.)
… He said that? No. He didn't say that. He never says that. … Did he really say that?
textes.… Il a dit ça ? Vingt-deux ans… Bon. On: … He said that? Twenty-two years… Well. We'll see. Maybe. Someday. Not today.
textes.… Il s'appelle Amiral. … DEHORS, J'AI DI: … His name is Admiral. … OUT, I SAID!
textes.… Ils se sont endormis. C'est la troisiè: … They've fallen asleep. That's the third time this week.
textes.… Je vais faire semblant de ne pas avoir: … I'll pretend I didn't hear that.
… The mast went through the cork. The cork went through the window. Well. Let's say it's a submarine.
textes.… Merci. C'est ma grand-mère qui l'a tri: … Thanks. My grandmother knitted it. … OUT!
textes.… Merci. Vraiment. Bon. Tu chantes, main: … Thank you. Really. Right. You sing now.
textes.… Rien. On est en pierre : on parle très: … Nothing. We're made of stone: we talk very, very slowly. Come back tomorrow for the end of the sentence.
… You've heard of Vieille-Dent. Good. He sleeps at the bottom of the marsh, under the dead mangroves, to the west. The biggest crocodile the sea ever spat out. He kept my hand. I'm not asking you to bring it back to me. I'm asking that he never eat anyone again. If you do that… I'll owe you something. I don't like owing anything.
textes.… Une soupe aux boulons. C'est la troisi: … Bolt soup. That's the third time this week. Well, keep the bolts, they may come in handy.
